5ef58ca280186c7b28f4.title: Plumbing Procurement Operations Specialist
5ef58ca280186c7b28f4.description:
**Position Overview**

Eco Flow Plumbing is seeking an organized and detail-oriented Plumbing Procurement Operations Specialist to coordinate the purchasing and availability of plumbing materials, parts, tools, and equipment. This role supports daily service and project operations by processing purchase requests, obtaining supplier quotes, tracking orders, monitoring material availability, and coordinating deliveries with vendors and field personnel.

The ideal candidate has strong administrative and organizational skills, communicates effectively with suppliers and internal teams, and can help ensure that technicians and project crews have the materials they need to complete their work on schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing & Procurement Coordination**

* Process purchase requests for plumbing supplies, fixtures, fittings, piping, tools, and equipment.
* Request and compare supplier quotes based on pricing, availability, and delivery timelines.
* Prepare and submit purchase orders in accordance with company procedures.
* Verify order details, quantities, product specifications, and pricing before submission.
* Follow up on pending orders and purchasing requests.

**Supplier & Vendor Relations**

* Communicate with plumbing supply houses, manufacturers, and other vendors regarding orders and product availability.
* Request updated pricing, product information, and estimated delivery dates.
* Resolve routine purchasing issues, including incorrect items, shortages, damaged materials, and delayed shipments.
* Maintain professional relationships with suppliers and keep vendor contact information current.

**Inventory & Material Coordination**

* Monitor material availability and coordinate replenishment requests with warehouse or operations personnel.
* Track commonly used plumbing parts and supplies to help prevent shortages.
* Coordinate material transfers and deliveries to service locations or project sites.
* Maintain accurate records of inventory requests, received materials, and outstanding orders.

**Project & Field Operations Support**

* Coordinate procurement needs with dispatchers, service managers, technicians, and project coordinators.
* Help ensure materials are ordered in time for scheduled plumbing repairs, installations, and construction projects.
* Track special-order fixtures, equipment, and project-specific materials.
* Communicate order delays or substitutions to the appropriate internal teams.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain organized purchase orders, supplier quotes, invoices, and delivery records.
* Compare supplier invoices against purchase orders and receiving documentation.
* Report purchasing discrepancies and unresolved order issues to management.
* Prepare basic reports on purchasing activity, open orders, and material availability.
* Recommend improvements to procurement tracking and ordering procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Previous experience in purchasing, procurement, operations administration, inventory coordination, or a related role.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, email, and purchasing or inventory systems.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple orders and meet deadlines.
* Strong organization and follow-through.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a plumbing contractor, mechanical contractor, construction company, or plumbing supply distributor.
* Familiarity with plumbing materials, fixtures, fittings, piping, and common trade supplies.
* Experience preparing purchase orders and communicating with vendors.
* Knowledge of inventory tracking and invoice matching procedures.

**Core Competencies**

* Procurement and purchase order administration
* Supplier communication and coordination
* Plumbing material and product familiarity
* Inventory and delivery tracking
* Cost and invoice accuracy
* Organization and time management
* Problem-solving and cross-team coordination

**Interested candidates are encouraged to apply with a current résumé highlighting relevant experience in purchasing, vendor coordination, inventory management, construction administration, or plumbing operations.**

Pay: $63,700.00 - $76,800.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

d5f6a37bf28a07846a59.title: Operations Manager
d5f6a37bf28a07846a59.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

**Position Summary**

The Operations Manager is a member of the Store Management team, and as such, fulfills the company purpose of helping people on their path to better health by driving store execution and performance while building consumer loyalty to CVS/pharmacy through a focus on excellent customer service. Under the supervision of the Store Manager, the Operations Manager will maintain an engaged, productive store team through strong leadership, demonstrating initiative and leading by example.

The Operations Manager is responsible for supporting the Store Manager in the total leadership and strategic operation of a CVS/pharmacy store including:

* Overall store management, supervision, and policy implementation
* Sales and inventory management
* Employee staffing, training, and development
* Financial management
* Customer service leadership

Unlike the Store Manager in Training position, the Operations Manager position is not part of the CVS/pharmacy Retail Management Development Program. Operations Managers are not eligible for direct promotion to Store Manager. Candidates with a short-term goal of becoming a CVS Store Manager should instead apply for Store Manager in Training openings.

Essential Functions:

1. Management

Lead others and work effectively with store crews

Supervise, assign and direct activities of the store’s crew

Effectively communicate information to store crew and supervisors in an open and timely manner

Support Store Manager with actions plans for operational and service improvement

2. Customer Service

Assist customers with their questions, problems and complaints

Promote CVS customer service culture (greet, offer help, and thank)

 **Required Qualifications**  

* Deductive reasoning ability, advanced analytical skills and computer skills.
* Advanced communication skills, leadership, supervision, and influencing skill
* Ability to work a full-time flexible schedule, including some early morning, overnight and weekend shifts, to work overtime as needed, and to respond to urgent issues at the store when they arise

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience as a retail manager or supervisor

  
**Education**

High School diploma or equivalent preferred but not required.

**Anticipated Weekly Hours**

40

**Time Type**

Full time

**Pay Range**

The typical pay range for this role is:

$19.00 - $29.00

This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. The actual base salary offer will depend on a variety of factors including experience, education, geography and other relevant factors.

Our people fuel our future. Our teams reflect the customers, patients, members and communities we serve and we are committed to fostering a workplace where every colleague feels valued and that they belong.

**Great benefits for great people**

We take pride in offering a comprehensive and competitive mix of pay and benefits that reflects our commitment to our colleagues and their families.

  
This full‑time position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the physical, emotional, and financial well‑being of colleagues and their families. The benefits for this position include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement savings options, wellness programs, and other resources, based on eligibility.

Additional details about available benefits are provided during the application process and on Benefits Moments.

  
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on: 01/07/2027

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state and local laws.

667f16692c957451d566.title: Program_Coordinator_Code_Enforcement
667f16692c957451d566.description:
**DATE OF POSTING: November 8, 2026**

**TITLE:** Program Coordinator, Code Enforcement
  
**DEPARTMENT:** Code Enforcement
  
**SALARY RANGE:** $56,631.65 – $88,881.00, commensurate with experience
  
**UNION:** CWA
  
**WORK HOURS:** M-F 8:30 am – 4:30 pm (35 hrs/wk); occasional evenings
  
**EFFECTIVE:** Immediately
  
**BENEFITS:** The Township provides a comprehensive benefits package including

health insurance, dental, vision, paid leave, group life insurance, deferred
  
compensation program, and retirement benefits through the State of NJ Division of
  
Pension and Benefits.

  

**DUTIES DESCRIPTION:**  
  
Serves as office coordinator for the Code Enforcement Department and principal administrative and technical
  
support to the Construction Official, managing permit intake, records, fees, and public information under the
  
NJ Uniform Construction Code (N.J.A.C. 5:23).
  
  
Duties include but are not limited to:

* Coordinates daily office operations, workflow, and coverage; supports the Construction Official,

subcode officials, and inspectors; and helps guide clerical staff.

* Receives and checks permit applications for completeness and UCC administrative compliance,

notifies applicants of missing items, and routes complete applications to subcode officials.

* Calculates permit fees and processes and issues permits and certificates after authorization.

* Serves as liaison with the public, Township departments, contractors, design professionals, and NJ

DCA; explains permit procedures and provides application and inspection status.

* Schedules inspections and coordinates information among inspectors, applicants, and contractors.

* Collects fees, records daily receipts, and reconciles with Finance; monitors the department budget

and prepares purchase requisitions.

* Maintains department records, coordinates retention under State schedules, and coordinates OPRA

responses with the Township Clerk.

* Prepares correspondence and periodic reports; maintains office procedures, desk references, and

department web content.

* Performs other related duties as assigned.

  
**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred. A high school diploma or equivalent with advanced office training and

two (2) years of building permit (or comparable municipal permit, licensing, or records) experience, or
  
an equivalent combination, will be considered.

* NJ DCA Technical Assistant certification strongly preferred; if not certified at hire, must obtain it within

twelve (12) months as a condition of continued employment.

* Valid New Jersey driver’s license required.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, permit software, and web-posting tools; strong organization,

communication, and customer service skills; ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  
Bilingual ability desired.  

Complete the Application for Employment and Submit Resume and Cover Letter Online

http://www.plainsboronj.com/500/Employment-Opportunities

**The Township of Plainsboro is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

8e677cebb5ab7662c5b5.title: Senior Director of Innovation
8e677cebb5ab7662c5b5.description:
IntraFi is a financial services technology company that provides deposit placement and funding solutions to financial institutions across the United States. Through its network-based services, the company helps banks and other participating institutions manage deposit relationships, access funding opportunities, and address evolving liquidity needs.

With a focus on the banking industry, IntraFi operates in an environment where financial expertise, regulatory awareness, technology, and operational reliability are essential to delivering effective financial solutions.

Job Summary

The Senior Director of Innovation will lead strategic initiatives focused on financial product innovation, business process modernization, and technology-enabled growth. This position will identify opportunities to improve existing services, evaluate emerging financial technologies, and develop practical solutions that support business objectives and the needs of financial institution clients.

Working closely with executive leadership, finance, product, technology, risk, and business development teams, the Senior Director will oversee innovation projects from initial research and financial evaluation through implementation and performance assessment.

The ideal candidate combines experience in banking or financial services with strong strategic thinking, financial analysis, and cross-functional leadership. The ability to balance innovation with regulatory requirements, operational stability, and commercial value is essential.

Key Responsibilities

* **Innovation Strategy:** Develop and execute innovation initiatives aligned with corporate objectives, financial services market developments, and long-term business priorities.
* **Financial Product Development:** Identify opportunities to improve banking solutions, deposit-related services, and financial technology capabilities based on institutional client needs.
* **Strategic Planning:** Evaluate emerging technologies, market opportunities, and new business models to support product development and organizational growth.
* **Financial Analysis:** Assess project budgets, financial forecasts, development costs, potential returns, and investment requirements for proposed innovation initiatives.
* **Digital Transformation:** Lead initiatives involving workflow automation, financial data analytics, digital platforms, and operational process improvements.
* **Market Research:** Monitor banking industry trends, competitive developments, financial regulations, and changing client requirements.
* **Project Management:** Oversee innovation programs, establish project milestones, coordinate resources, and monitor execution against business objectives.
* **Risk & Compliance:** Collaborate with legal, risk, and compliance teams to evaluate regulatory considerations and operational risks associated with new solutions.
* **Cross-functional Leadership:** Partner with finance, technology, product, operations, and business development teams to move innovation initiatives from concept to implementation.
* **Performance Measurement:** Establish KPIs, evaluate financial and operational outcomes, and recommend adjustments to improve business value.
* **Executive Reporting:** Present innovation proposals, financial assessments, implementation progress, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field required. MBA or relevant advanced qualifications preferred.
* **Experience:** 8+ years of progressive experience in financial services, banking innovation, product strategy, digital transformation, or corporate strategy, including senior management responsibilities.
* **Financial Expertise:** Strong understanding of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, investment evaluation, and financial performance analysis.
* **Banking Knowledge:** Familiarity with commercial banking, deposit products, liquidity management, banking operations, or financial institution services.
* **Innovation Management:** Demonstrated experience developing new business initiatives, evaluating emerging technologies, and implementing operational improvements.
* **Technology Skills:** Familiarity with financial technology platforms, data analytics, business intelligence tools, process automation, and enterprise software systems.
* **Risk Awareness:** Understanding of banking regulations, financial compliance considerations, and operational risk management.
* **Strategic Leadership:** Ability to manage complex initiatives, lead cross-functional teams, and translate business opportunities into measurable outcomes.
* **Communication:** Strong executive presentation, stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and organizational leadership skills.
* **Work Environment:** Reliable high-speed internet, a professional remote workspace, and the ability to collaborate effectively with distributed teams and financial services stakeholders.

Pay: $179,000.00 - $231,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

50b73e9c3486dd64fdd2.company: University of California Office of the President
50b73e9c3486dd64fdd2.description:
**Location:** Oakland  
**Job ID:** 89895  
  
**Job Posting**  
  
**For UCOP internal applicants, please login to the internal candidate gateway at:** Jobs at UCOP
  
  
**UC OFFICE OF THE PRESIDENT**  
  
At the University of California (UC), your contributions make a difference. A world leader producing Nobel and Pulitzer Prize recipients with over 150 years of groundbreaking research transforming the world. Choose a career where you can leverage your knowledge, skills and aspirations to inspire and support some of the greatest minds in the world, and those who will follow in their footsteps. Working at the University of California is being part of a unique institution, and a vibrant and diverse community. At the University of California, Office of the President, we propel our mission through impactful work locally, in government centers and systemwide. We are passionate people, serving the greater good.  
  
The University of California, one of the largest and most acclaimed institutions of higher learning in the world, is dedicated to excellence in teaching, research and public service. The University of California Office of the President is the headquarters to the 10 campuses, six academic medical centers and three national laboratories and enrolls premier students from California, the nation and the world. Learn more about the UC Office of the President  
  
**Department Overview**  
As a security first organization, UC Digital Risk & Security (UCDRS) is part of the Digital Innovation & Technology (DigIT) Department. The UCDRS teams include UCOP local and system-wide information security and risk teams focused on providing cyber security services to the UC system. We maintain an innovative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.  
  
**Position Summary**  
Reporting to the Deputy Chief Information Security Officer, the Security Operations Manager is responsible for monitoring, detecting, protecting, and maintaining the security of data, systems, and networks at UCOP. This role includes managing the UCOP Security Operations team, monitoring the UCOP infrastructure for malicious activity, developing and implementing security processes and procedures, managing vulnerabilities, and coordinating security incident response. The Security Operations Manager will work closely with other units at UCOP, including infrastructure and application development teams, desktop engineering, and the service desk, to identify vulnerabilities, implement best practices, and ensure the security of the UCOP computing environment.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
50% Responsible for managing the daily activities of Security Operations security analysts who plan, design, develop, implement and maintain systems and programs to ensure the integrity, reliability and security of UCOP data and systems, and monitor and respond to threats to the UCOP computing environment. Additionally, this role provides mentoring to security personnel, drives continuous improvement, fosters an inclusive culture, and aligns the team with UCOP's mission and goals.  
  
25% Implements highly complex and broad-scale security controls to prevent unauthorized access or changes to institutional information, information systems, and / or network infrastructure. Responsible for providing research, analysis and solutions to address attempted efforts to compromise security protocols. Proactively addresses the negative impact on Office of the President caused by theft, destruction, alteration or denial of access of information. Advises departments on security prevention, best practices and secure software.  
  
10% Designs, configures and manages complex security systems including data loss prevention software, security information and event management systems, vulnerability scanners, and endpoint security agents. Administers security configurations to control access to information systems and networks including on premise and cloud environments.  
  
10% Directs incident response and forensic investigations and addresses and produces reports in response to highly complex or broad-scale security incidents. Investigate security incidents and reports to management regarding the causes and effects. Applies advanced IT security concepts, compliance and regulatory requirements, and policies and procedures to respond to and appropriately escalate security incidents.  
  
5% Additional duties as required  
  
**Experience**  
Required Qualifications  
Min 8 years of related IT work experience.  

Min 2 years of experience managing an information security organization.  

  
  
**Skills and Abilities**  
Required Qualifications  
Ability to lead a highly technical team.  

Advanced interpersonal skills to work effectively with both technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.  
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing, to include writing and preparing technical and executive reports, briefings, and recommendations.  
Ability to follow department processes and procedures.  
Advanced experience using IT security systems and tools and using those tools to apply security controls in a complex environment.  
Advanced experience analyzing, researching, and implementing threat intelligence and novel security concepts to improve overall security in a complex environment.  
Experience in incident response and digital forensics including data collection, examination, and analysis.  
* Experience with risk assessment, penetration test, and vendor risk management processes.

  
**Education**  
Required Qualifications  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training  

  
  
**Licenses and Certifications**  
Preferred Qualifications  

* CISSP

  
**Travel Requirements**  
5% Occasional travel to on-site meetings, trainings, and conferences.

a59e6f271051bd9f4620.title: Executive Director
a59e6f271051bd9f4620.description:
FinFolio is a financial technology company specializing in portfolio management and investment reporting software for financial advisors and wealth management professionals. Its technology helps investment firms manage portfolio data, monitor investment performance, streamline reporting, and improve operational workflows.

The company's focus on financial software and investment management technology creates opportunities to strengthen business operations, improve financial decision-making, and support the evolving needs of investment professionals.

Job Summary

The Executive Director will provide senior leadership across business operations, financial strategy, and organizational performance. This position is responsible for coordinating strategic initiatives, overseeing operational priorities, and ensuring that financial and business objectives are translated into effective execution.

Working closely with executive leadership, finance, product, and business development teams, the Executive Director will evaluate financial performance, improve operational processes, and identify opportunities to strengthen business efficiency and commercial growth.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in financial services or financial technology, experience managing business operations, and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives while maintaining financial discipline.

Key Responsibilities

* **Executive Management:** Oversee strategic business initiatives, establish operational priorities, and coordinate execution across departments.

50ef3066e4f1bb0d5b21.title: AI Operations & Delivery Manager
50ef3066e4f1bb0d5b21.description:
Most construction and trades businesses run on a dozen disconnected tools, a lot of spreadsheets and the owner's memory. We're changing that with AI. We need someone who loves AI, is technical enough to work with APIs and automations, and is so organized that nothing slips through. If this sounds like you, keep reading You get a little thrill from a clean task board where every item has an owner and a date. You use AI tools every day because they make you faster and better, not because it's trendy. You can sit with a developer, read a basic piece of code or an API response, and know whether it's right. And you'd rather be judged on results than on hours. About us Omadli Group is an AI and data company. We help construction and trades businesses run on one connected system, so their office, field, finance and sales data work together instead of living in separate tools. We're an AI-first team: bots support every seat, including the founder's. People do the work that needs judgment, relationships and care. AI does the drafting, sorting, summarizing and repetitive work around it. Our founder is a CPA with 20 years across accounting, data and AI: numbers have to tie out, processes have to be written down, and "I think it's done" isn't the same as "it's done." The mission of this role Make sure every commitment we make, to clients and to each other, ships on time and at high quality, with AI doing as much of the work as it reliably can. You'll turn sold work into delivered work, run day-to-day operations, coordinate our builders, and give our founder her time back. What you'll own (outcomes, not tasks) - Delivery that lands: every engagement has a clear scope, plan, owners and dates, and ships when we said it would. - A task board you could hand to anyone: one owner, a due date and a next step on every task. - Bot-plus-human workflows: decide what AI does, what a person checks, and which tool fits, then make it standard. - AI quality control: review AI output for accuracy, completeness, tone and numbers before it reaches a client. - Client rhythm: weekly updates, well-run meetings, same-day recaps. - Team rhythm: daily updates, 1:1s and follow-through; coach a small, mostly junior team. - Capacity honesty: know who has room for what and flag overload early. - Security and access hygiene: no credentials in chats or documents; access matches the team. - Working with builders: translate client needs into clear technical requests, then test before anyone calls it done. Your first 30 / 60 / 90 days - 30 days: you know every client, team member and tool; the board is clean; daily updates run without reminders. - 60 days: deliverables ship on agreed dates, every client gets a weekly update, and you've shipped two bot-plus-human workflows with written instructions. - 90 days: the founder spends no regular time on day-to-day delivery, and you have a simple delivery playbook plus estimated vs actual effort data. Must-have - 3+ years in operations, delivery or project management for client work. - Real AI fluency: daily use of LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Grok), good prompting, and workflows you've built where AI and people share the work. - You can judge AI output and design checks to catch made-up facts and wrong numbers. - A bit technical: APIs, automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make), dashboards, spreadsheets, and reading basic code. - Extremely detailed and organized; you've owned a project management tool end to end. - Clear, confident English for client-facing work with US business norms. - Based in the US, Canada or Europe, with 4-5 hours daily overlap with US Eastern time. - If outside the US: proven experience with US clients or companies. - Good security habits. Nice-to-have - Construction, trades or field-service experience and software. - QuickBooks, HubSpot, Microsoft 365/Teams, Notion, AI meeting-notes tools. - Built or ran AI agents, voice bots or chat assistants in a business. - Coached junior team members across time zones. Who this isn't for - Someone who wants a pure strategy or "AI advisor" role without day-to-day ownership. - Someone who waits to be told what to do next or finds detailed tracking tedious. - Someone who uses AI without checking the output. - Candidates outside the US with no US client or company experience. How we hire Application, 15-minute intro call, strengths assessment, values and experience interview, paid test project, final call with the founder, reference check, offer. How to apply We're hiring for attention to detail. Apply on Indeed with your resume, and answer the screening questions: a) Which US Eastern hours can you work each day? If you're outside the US, which US clients or companies have you worked with, and what did you deliver? b) Describe one workflow you designed where AI and people share the work. How did you check the AI's output? c) Give 3 bullet points on what you'd do in your first week with a messy task board where many items have no owner or due date. d) Which AI tool do you use most, and one thing you wish it did better? Omadli Group welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

Pay: $3,500.00 - $6,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Which US Eastern hours can you work each day? If you are outside the US, which US clients or companies have you worked with?
* Describe one workflow you designed where AI and people share the work. How did you check the AI's output?
* Give 3 bullets on your first week with a messy task board.
* Which AI tool do you use most, and one thing you wish it did better?

*South Key is conducting a confidential search for a Head of Operations for one of its clients.*

**Head of Operations, Wealth Management Service Delivery**  
Remote (U.S.; Eastern or Central time zone preferred) · Full-time · Reports to the COO  
Starting base salary $150,000 plus bonus

**About the company**

We are a growing operations partner to registered investment advisors. Our team works as an extension of our clients' staff, handling financial planning support, investment operations, new business processing and client service so advisors can focus on their clients and their growth.

**The role**

The Head of Operations is a leadership role, accountable for service delivery, quality, capacity and team performance across all of our client firms. You will lead a remote team of 20+ across client service, investment operations and financial planning, and build the team-lead layer beneath you.

You will stay close to daily operations, but you will lead through your team leads and managers rather than doing the work yourself. This is not a working-supervisor role. Over the next year, you will build an operation that can support significant client growth.

**What you'll do**

Service delivery and quality  
- Own timely, accurate delivery across all operations service lines.  
- Set service standards, quality controls and escalation procedures.  
- Track turnaround times, SLA commitments, errors, NIGOs, rework and client feedback, and fix the root causes of recurring problems.  
- Serve as the senior escalation point for significant delivery issues.

Team leadership  
- Lead, coach and develop team leads and staff with clear responsibilities and performance expectations.  
- Run consistent training, performance reviews and accountability.  
- Partner with recruiting to define staffing needs, interview candidates and onboard new hires.  
- Build career paths, cross-training and backup coverage that support retention.

Capacity and delivery economics  
- Keep a forward-looking 60–90 day view of workload, staffing, skills and available capacity.  
- Measure capacity and put the right staffing structure in place, including team-lead and manager roles, as the business grows.  
- Recommend hiring and resource allocation based on demand, service requirements and financial impact.  
- Balance productivity with quality and sustainable workloads.  
- Make sure new client start dates line up with operational readiness.

Process improvement and onboarding  
- Build, standardize and document core workflows while allowing for differences between client firms.  
- Improve workflows to reduce manual work, errors and unnecessary handoffs, partnering with the technology team on automation and system changes.  
- Own operational readiness for new client engagements: staffing, training, workflows and handoffs.

Reporting  
- Maintain a weekly operations scorecard covering quality, service levels, capacity, staffing and delivery risks.  
- Turn performance data into clear actions, owners and deadlines, and own the department's quarterly priorities.

**What you'll bring**

* 3–5 years of direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, performance management and staffing decisions. Project leadership alone is not enough.
* Experience overseeing multiple operations functions, such as client service, new business and account opening, money movement, investment operations and financial planning support.
* Experience developing team leads or managers who run their own teams.
* A track record of building and scaling an operation, not only maintaining one: building processes, improving workflows, measuring capacity and putting the right staffing structure in place as the organization grew, with measurable improvements in turnaround time, accuracy, productivity or service levels.
* Experience leading operations or advisor services in wealth management at an RIA. Custodian candidates are welcome if they have led advisor-facing service operations and understand how independent RIAs operate across client service, new business and investment operations.
* Hands-on knowledge of advisory firm workflows: account opening, transfers, custodian requirements, client service and operational accuracy.
* RIA candidates: experience at a firm with more than $500M AUM. $1B+ is preferred.
* Experience leading remote teams.
* Direct, collaborative communication and confidence handling difficult performance conversations.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Salesforce, Redtail and common custodian platforms.
* Workflow automation or process-improvement experience.
* Experience with a structured operating or accountability framework (for example EOS).

**Your first 90 days**

* Get to know the team and each client's delivery requirements.
* Assess immediate service, staffing and coverage risks.
* Clarify responsibilities and escalation paths across operations.
* Set baseline metrics and weekly reporting.
* Build a 60–90 day capacity forecast and a prioritized improvement plan.

**How to apply**

c085256acd778af3da27.title: Director of Revenue Operations
c085256acd778af3da27.description:
Founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, Treasury Prime is a financial technology company that provides the infrastructure connecting banks, fintech companies, and businesses building modern financial products.

Its banking technology platform enables financial institutions to manage embedded banking programs, support payment processing, and establish direct relationships with fintech partners. Through its banking network and software infrastructure, Treasury Prime helps banks expand customer relationships, attract deposits, generate fee income, and manage their financial technology partnerships.

The company operates at the intersection of banking, software, and financial services, where commercial growth depends on strong relationships, reliable technology, and a clear understanding of financial performance.

Job Summary

The Director of Revenue Operations will be responsible for improving how Treasury Prime manages its commercial performance, revenue forecasting, and sales operations.

This position will work closely with sales, finance, marketing, and executive leadership to establish reliable revenue reporting, improve pipeline visibility, and strengthen the processes that support customer acquisition and business growth.

We are looking for an experienced revenue operations professional who understands the financial realities of selling technology to banks and financial institutions. The right candidate should be comfortable working with complex sales cycles, analyzing revenue performance, and helping commercial teams make better decisions based on accurate financial and operational data.

Key Responsibilities

**Revenue Operations Management**

Oversee revenue operations processes across sales, business development, and customer account management. Establish consistent practices for opportunity tracking, revenue reporting, and commercial performance measurement.

**Revenue Forecasting and Financial Analysis**

Partner with finance leadership to develop revenue forecasts, evaluate sales performance, and monitor recurring revenue, contract values, and customer profitability. Identify changes in financial performance and provide recommendations to senior management.

**Sales Pipeline Management**

Maintain accurate visibility into the sales pipeline, including opportunities involving banks, fintech companies, and enterprise clients. Evaluate conversion rates, deal progression, and sales cycle performance to support more reliable forecasting.

**CRM and Business Systems**

Manage the effectiveness of Salesforce and related revenue operations tools. Improve data accuracy, reporting standards, workflow automation, and coordination between commercial and financial systems.

**Commercial Performance**

Analyze customer acquisition costs, sales productivity, revenue growth, and account performance. Work with commercial leadership to identify operational improvements and opportunities to increase revenue efficiency.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

Coordinate with finance, sales, marketing, and customer success teams to ensure revenue processes remain consistent from initial business development through contract execution and ongoing account management.

**Strategic Planning**

Support annual revenue planning, sales capacity analysis, commercial budgeting, and performance reviews. Provide financial and operational insights that help leadership evaluate business priorities and allocate resources effectively.

**Executive Reporting**

Prepare revenue reports, financial performance summaries, and commercial forecasts for executive leadership. Present findings clearly and identify areas requiring management attention.

Qualifications & Requirements

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. An MBA or relevant advanced qualification is preferred.

**Professional Experience**

A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, financial planning, business operations, or commercial strategy. Previous experience managing revenue operations within a financial technology, banking software, or enterprise SaaS company is strongly preferred.

**Financial Expertise**

Strong knowledge of revenue forecasting, financial modeling, budgeting, revenue recognition principles, profitability analysis, and financial performance reporting.

**Revenue Operations Experience**

Extensive experience with sales pipeline management, CRM administration, commercial reporting, sales performance analysis, and revenue planning. Candidates should understand how long enterprise sales cycles affect forecasting and business performance.

**Technical Skills**

Advanced proficiency in Salesforce, Microsoft Excel, financial reporting tools, and business intelligence platforms such as Tableau or Power BI. Experience with SQL and revenue analytics systems is highly desirable.

**Industry Knowledge**

Understanding of financial technology, banking partnerships, embedded finance, payment processing, or enterprise financial software is preferred.

**Leadership and Communication**

Demonstrated ability to work with executive leadership, finance teams, and commercial departments. Strong analytical judgment, communication skills, and the ability to turn complex financial data into practical business recommendations are essential.

075a210378cfbcec86de.title: Senior Manager, HR Technology and People Operations
075a210378cfbcec86de.description:
SEE how you can make a difference! Be part of an innovative company that cares about its associates and helps members enjoy the wonders of sight through healthy eyes and vision.
  
  
About Versant Health
  
  
Versant Health is a leading managed vision care company dedicated to making healthy vision a reality for everyone. Through our Davis Vision® and Superior Vision® networks, our purpose is to make healthy vision a reality for everyone by improving access to care and education in the communities we serve. Fueled by our mission to improve members' lives with easy-to-use vision benefits rooted in choice, value, and care, we believe that everyone has the power to become anything they set their sights on.
  
  
Position Summary
  
We are seeking a Senior Manager, HR Technology & People Operations to provide strategic and operational leadership across our HR technology ecosystem and key People Operations functions.
  
This role serves as the business owner and subject matter expert for Dayforce and related HR platforms, with responsibility for ensuring our HR systems, workforce data, payroll-related processes, controls, and workflows are accurate, secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business priorities.
  
The Senior Manager will partner across People & Culture, Finance, Information Technology, Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and external providers to strengthen governance, reduce risk, improve processes, and deliver an effective employee and manager experience.
  
This is an opportunity for an experienced HR technology and operations leader to shape how technology, data, payroll governance, and People Operations work together across the organization.
  
What You’ll Do
  
Lead HR Technology Strategy & Governance
  

* Lead the HR technology strategy and roadmap in alignment with organizational and People & Culture priorities.
* Serve as business owner and primary subject matter expert for Dayforce and related HR technology platforms.
* Establish governance for system configuration, integrations, releases, testing, security, data, workflows, documentation, and change management.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technology, automation, reporting, integration, and process solutions.
* Advise leadership on system capabilities, risks, dependencies, regulatory considerations, and investment priorities.

Own HR Systems, Security & Data Governance
  

* Direct the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of Dayforce across HR, Payroll, Time and Attendance, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Onboarding, Workforce Management, and reporting.
* Oversee security roles, user access, workflows, integrations, organizational structures, business rules, and system controls.
* Lead system releases, enhancements, testing, production changes, complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and vendor escalation.
* Establish data governance and quality standards to protect the accuracy, completeness, consistency, security, and integrity of workforce data.
* Partner with Information Security and GRC on access reviews, least-privilege practices, segregation of duties, system risk, and remediation.

Strengthen Payroll & Payroll Tax Governance
  

* Provide governance and oversight for payroll operations to support accurate, timely, controlled, and compliant payroll processing.
* Oversee payroll readiness, calendars, controls, exception management, approvals, escalations, and payroll-impacting system configuration.
* Provide governance over payroll tax administration, including tax setup, registrations, agency notices and issues, filing-related activities, remediation, and vendor escalation.
* Identify recurring payroll and tax issues and drive sustainable resolution through root cause analysis, clearly defined ownership, and documented controls.
* Partner with Payroll, Finance, and external providers on reconciliations, reporting, funding, General Ledger requirements, and compliance obligations.

Lead People Operations & Continuous Improvement
  

* Provide leadership for assigned People Operations processes, ensuring accurate execution, compliance, strong controls, and effective employee service.
* Establish operating procedures, service standards, process ownership, escalation protocols, quality controls, and business continuity practices.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process maps, checklists, control documentation, and cross-training for business-critical processes.
* Build team capability through coaching, knowledge transfer, clear performance expectations, and functional leadership.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex People Operations, payroll, payroll tax, HR technology, and workforce data matters.
* Drive simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across HR technology and People Operations.

Deliver Workforce Reporting, Controls & Audit Readiness
  

* Lead workforce reporting and analytics across headcount, turnover, retention, hiring, payroll, labor costs, time and attendance, and other workforce measures.
* Establish standardized reporting definitions, validation, reconciliation, and quality-control processes.
* Support internal and external audits, financial controls, benefits audits, security reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify technology, data, process, and control risks and lead remediation efforts.
* Translate technical, payroll, compliance, and workforce information into clear, decision-ready recommendations for leadership.

Manage Vendors & Cross-Functional Delivery
  

* Manage HR technology, payroll, payroll tax, background screening, and other People Operations providers, including service performance, risks, escalations, and contractual obligations.
* Evaluate vendor solutions and operating changes for privacy, security, compliance, data access, integration, and business continuity considerations.
* Lead complex projects from requirements and solution design through testing, implementation, change management, stabilization, and transition to operations.
* Coordinate dependencies and decisions across People & Culture, Finance, IT, Information Security, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and external providers.

What You’ll Bring
  
Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 8+ years of progressively responsible experience in HR technology, HRIS, People Operations, payroll, or related functions.
* At least 3 years of leadership, people management, or significant enterprise program ownership experience.
* Demonstrated experience working with enterprise HCM platforms and complex HR technology environments.
* Strong analytical, project leadership, vendor management, communication, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Ability to translate complex technology, data, payroll, and compliance matters into practical business recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Hands-on Dayforce experience strongly preferred.
* Experience with multi-state payroll and payroll tax administration.
* Experience with HR technology integrations, system security, workforce reporting, controls, data governance, and audit support.
* Advanced degree preferred.
* Professional certification such as SHRM-SCP, SPHR, CPP, PMP, Prosci, or a comparable credential preferred.

What Success Looks Like
  
In this role, you will help create an HR technology and People Operations environment that is:
  

* Reliable: Workforce and payroll data are accurate, timely, and trusted.
* Controlled: Security, access, payroll, tax, and operational processes have clear governance and accountability.
* Scalable: Systems and processes support organizational growth and evolving business needs.
* Efficient: Manual work and unnecessary complexity are reduced through standardization and automation.
* Insightful: Leaders have access to reliable workforce information that supports better decisions.
* Employee-focused: Technology and processes make it easier for employees, managers, and People & Culture teams to get work done.

**Key Areas of Accountability:** HR Technology | Dayforce | People Operations | Payroll & Tax Governance | Workforce Analytics | Controls & Compliance | Vendor Governance
  
  
Versant Health provides vision care to 38 million members nationwide! To ensure your continued success we provide opportunities for advancement and development. Our associates remain engaged through a comprehensive compensation and benefits package which includes health and dental insurance, tuition reimbursements, 401(k) with company match, pet insurance and FREE vision insurance for you and your family

eabbf9e603c1a299c613.title: Claims & Recovery Manager
eabbf9e603c1a299c613.description:
Zeeba operates a growing national fleet of commercial vehicles across multiple U.S. markets. We are hiring a Senior Subrogation and Claims Specialist to own recovery and the insurance interface end to end, treating recovery with discipline and urgency. This role owns the claims lifecycle from first notice through resolution: liability and coverage decisions, repair review, total loss versus repair decision input, and aggressive recovery across insurance, customer, and subrogation channels. It is currently a hands-on operator role, not a process-design or oversight-only seat. The successful candidate is direct, organized, and persistent, comfortable holding carriers, shops, and at-fault parties accountable, and able to build rapport that expedites recovery while escalating when needed.

### **About Zeeba Automotive Group Inc**

Zeeba is a leading fleet management company dedicated to providing our clients with the best solutions for their transportation needs. Our Services Include vehicle acquisition, maintenance and repair, fuel management, telematics, and compliance, all aimed to help fleet managers to optimize their fleet operations.

Our mission is to help reduce the carbon footprint we all leave on this planet when we use inefficient modes of transportation. Why use multiple vehicles for the same journey when one vehicle can transport the same group of people to their destination. Our vehicles help keep the environment clean by reducing the number of vehicles on the road, and our white-glove service along with our latest state-of-the-art technology sets us apart from others. We want to create solutions where the customer wins, the community wins, and the company wins.

Our Core Values:

Integrity: Doing the right thing is always the right thing to do.

Accountability: Leadership starts from being on the ground floor and in the trenches.

Respect: Empathy is at our core, and identifying others' needs is how we operate in servant leadership.

Flexibility: We aren't stuck in our ways, and we understand the changing times. We must adapt to meet the needs of our customers.

Community: Community is when there is common unity. We are here to connect others who want to connect with experiences.

### **Description**

**Primary Areas of Ownership**

* Claims lifecycle end to end: first notice, liability and coverage decisions, and resolution.
* Recovery across insurance, customer, and subrogation channels.
* Repair estimate and supplement review, including catching inflated or improper repairs.
* Total loss versus repair decisioning tied to asset value and residual.
* Carrier and adjuster relationships, and the escalation path when needed
* Customer Certificate of Insurance (COI) review.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own claims from first notice through resolution, making liability and coverage decisions with documentation and discipline.
* Prepare and pursue subrogation like litigation: evidence, documentation, and timelines, using rapport to expedite and escalate when needed.
* Review repair estimates, photos and supplements for accuracy and quality.
* Review final repair work checking for quality and verify repair process completion.
* Make repair versus total loss decisions based on asset value, residual, and reconditioning economics, negotiating repair costs directly.
* Maximize recovery yield across insurance, customer, and subrogation, reducing leakage.
* Maintain carrier and vendor relationships that speed cycle time, and hold them accountable on quality, cost, and responsiveness.
* Track and report recovery metrics, cycle time, and outstanding claims for executive visibility.

**Preventative Systems**

Beyond resolving claims, this role builds the systems that help mitigate them and protect recoverable value:

* Pre and post-rental inspection standards with documented proof of condition, to properly assign and support liability when damage occurs.
* Repair network scorecards and audits to identify vendor specific quality or integrity concerns.
* Monitor repairs to identify vehicle specific damage trends, collaborate with Fleet Operations and Customer Success teams to help reduce repeat claims.
* Monitor and escalate open and aging claims to determine actions needed to push for resolution.
* Monitor customer specific files to identify opportunities to communicate and inform them on claims reducing strategies for safer fleet management.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Recovery yields across all insurance claims.
* Subrogation cycle time and collection rate.
* Leakage reduction on total loss and repair evaluations.
* Repair estimate reductions.
* Reduction of aging claim closure days.

**Requirements and Qualifications**

**Experience.** Multiple years in claims, subrogation, and recovery, ideally in fleet, rental, leasing, or auto insurance. Track record owning claims end to end and driving recovery.

**Skills.** Claims and coverage knowledge, subrogation discipline, repair estimate review, total loss evaluation, carrier negotiation, and documentation rigor.

**Preferred background.** Strong claims and recovery experience in a vehicle-centric business.

**Travel:** Must be willing and able to travel 15% to 20% across the U.S. when required.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This role is structured as a revenue-generating position. Earnings scale with recovery performance and are not capped.

**Base Salary**: $70,000 to $75,000 based on experience

**Performance Incentive:** Paid quarterly, tied to role KPIs. Because recovery is long-tail, incentives pay quarterly as claims resolve rather than monthly.

**Incentive is earned on:** A percentage of insurance and subrogation dollars actually recovered, paid on collected amounts, not claimed amounts.

**Total Possible Yearly Compensation**: $105,000 to $120,000. Specific percentages and KPI thresholds will be finalized in a working session using actual claims data.

All incentive is paid quarterly on confirmed, collected dollars, reconciled against accounting.

**Also included:**

* Annual performance bonus
* Equity participation based on company programs and role level
* Employer-paid health coverage, paid time off, and company holidays
* Travel reimbursement

#### **Salary**

$70,000 - $75,000 per year

We’re looking for an experienced and approachable Director of Operations to manage the day-to-day operations of our financial services business. This is a hands-on role for someone who can see the bigger picture while staying close enough to the details to understand where support is needed.

Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work across departments are essential.

40afb71137572749d929.title: Program Delivery Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution
40afb71137572749d929.description:
**Become a part of our caring community**
=========================================

Humana’s Consumer Product Management team is seeking an experienced Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, to join working remote anywhere in the US. In this role, you'll serve as a critical delivery connector across Insurance Product Management, Growth and Strategy, and the functional teams responsible for bringing Medicare Advantage products to market. You'll translate portfolio priorities into structured programs, clear milestones and coordinated workstreams that support accurate, timely and compliant execution. If you enjoy turning big-picture strategy into well-managed programs and helping teams deliver successfully, this role is for you.

As the Program Deliver Lead, Benefit Enablement & Execution, you'll lead complex bid initiatives and enterprise projects that span product strategy, benefit design, regulatory requirements, operational readiness, technology and process enablement. This includes coordinating initiatives such as benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, plan naming, service area expansion and the evaluation of new product and benefit opportunities.

You'll also help strengthen how Product Management operates. You'll establish practical delivery disciplines, maintain governance and program documentation, improve processes and tools, and provide timely training as requirements change. Through research, analysis and cross-functional leadership, you'll help teams understand complex issues, evaluate implications and move toward clear, executable decisions.

This is a highly collaborative individual-contributor role for someone who can create clarity from ambiguity, lead complex work without relying on formal authority and keep multiple teams aligned through demanding Medicare Advantage and CMS delivery cycles.

**Key Role Functions**

**Lead Medicare Advantage Bid Initiatives**

* Partner with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management and functional teams to define objectives, scope, deliverables, decision points and measures of success for bid-related initiatives
* Lead coordinated delivery of initiatives involving benefit standardization, portfolio segmentation, product guiding principles and other enterprise or portfolio priorities
* Translate strategic direction into executable workplans, milestones, dependencies, ownership and decision requirements
* Establish delivery approaches that create consistency across portfolios while allowing for appropriate product, market and regulatory differences
* Facilitate cross-functional discussions needed to evaluate options, surface tradeoffs and move initiatives toward timely decisions
* Monitor initiative progress and ensure key decisions, dependencies and risks are identified before they affect bid submissions or downstream implementation
* Capture lessons learned and incorporate them into future bid and product cycles

**Lead Feasibility Assessment and Decision Support**

* Lead structured evaluation of proposed products, benefits and portfolio opportunities across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology, system and financial considerations
* Define the questions, information and functional expertise needed to assess whether an opportunity can be executed accurately and within required timelines
* Bring together subject-matter experts to identify dependencies, constraints, assumptions, unresolved questions and downstream impacts
* Distinguish between identified facts, assumptions and areas requiring additional validation so leaders can make informed decisions
* Develop clear recommendations and decision-support materials that explain options, risks, tradeoffs and execution implications
* Facilitate alignment among partners with different priorities while recognizing that final product, financial or strategic decisions remain with the appropriate accountable leaders
* Maintain documentation of recommendations, decisions, rationale, owners and follow-up actions

**Lead Enterprise Research and Product Impact Analysis**

* Lead research and analysis related to Stars, Clinical, Regulatory Compliance, the Complaints Tracking Module and other enterprise priorities affecting Medicare Advantage products
* Identify relevant product, member, regulatory, operational and delivery implications
* Synthesize complex information into concise findings, recommendations and decision points for Product Management leaders and partner teams
* Evaluate how enterprise initiatives could affect benefit design, product processes, portfolio priorities, filings, systems or the member experience
* Serve as the Product Management program delivery lead on assigned enterprise initiatives
* Coordinate Product Management participation, consolidate feedback and ensure Product requirements and impacts are represented accurately
* Communicate conclusions, open questions and recommended actions in a format appropriate for working teams and senior leaders

**Own Program Governance and Delivery Discipline**

* Maintain program documentation for active portfolio opportunities, including objectives, scope, status, decisions, risks, dependencies, accountable owners and next steps
* Gather requirements and prepare backlog opportunities so they are sufficiently defined for prioritization and future planning
* Establish appropriate governance routines, status reporting, decision logs, risk tracking and escalation approaches for assigned initiatives
* Create clear visibility into program health, milestone performance, unresolved decisions and delivery risks
* Ensure commitments and decisions are documented and communicated to affected teams
* Provide concise and actionable updates to Product Management leaders and cross-functional stakeholders

**Improve Processes, Tools and Ways of Working**

* Partner with Process Improvement, Program Delivery and Product Management teams to create, maintain and improve process documentation, templates, workflows and delivery standards
* Evaluate existing processes to identify unclear handoffs, unnecessary complexity, recurring defects, manual activity and opportunities for standardization
* Lead implementation of practical improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency, transparency and user experience
* Identify opportunities to use tools such as Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot, SharePoint and other approved technologies to reduce administrative work and improve access to information
* Partner with technology and process owners to evaluate solutions and support responsible implementation
* Establish appropriate controls, documentation and ownership so process improvements are sustainable
* Measure the effectiveness of changes and adjust approaches based on user feedback and delivery results

**Build Product Management Capability**

* Provide timely training, guidance and support to Product Managers as processes, tools, systems and requirements change
* Translate complex process or regulatory changes into clear instructions, practical examples and job aids
* Determine the appropriate training approach based on the complexity, timing and impact of the change
* Facilitate working sessions that help teams understand new expectations and apply them consistently
* Provide technical and process guidance to associates working across related programs and workstreams
* Reinforce disciplined documentation, milestone management, issue escalation and adoption of standard processes
* Gather feedback after implementation and refine training or documentation where additional clarity is needed

**Use your skills to make an impact**
=====================================

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional healthcare experience
* 7+ years of relevant healthcare, health plan, product management, or related experience
* Demonstrated experience leading complex projects, programs or processes across multiple functional areas
* Experience establishing delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, governance and risk-management approaches
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive alignment without formal authority
* Experience researching complex business, regulatory or operational topics and translating findings into clear recommendations
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to distinguish facts, assumptions, risks and unresolved questions
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor information for working teams, functional partners and senior leaders
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver through ambiguity, changing requirements and compressed timelines
* Advanced proficiency with Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and related digital collaboration tools

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Medicare Advantage product management, program delivery, implementation or operational experience
* Experience with the annual Medicare Advantage bid cycle, benefit design, service-area expansion or product implementation
* Knowledge of CMS Medicare Advantage requirements, bid processes, PBP or HPMS
* Experience evaluating product or benefit feasibility across regulatory, operational, system, clinical and financial considerations
* Knowledge of Stars, the Complaints Tracking Module, member experience or regulatory compliance programs
* Experience developing or managing enterprise milestone calendars, governance routines, decision logs or program dashboards
* Experience with process documentation, workflow design, training development or change enablement
* Experience using Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot or similar tools to improve processes, reporting or administrative efficiency
* Process improvement experience or training, including Lean, Six Sigma or another structured improvement methodology
* Experience presenting complex findings, recommendations and program risks to senior leaders

**Additional Information**

* **This role typically operates on Eastern Standard Time business hours.**
* **The work follows the annual Medicare Advantage and CMS regulatory cycle. Certain periods of the year require additional flexibility, including extended hours and occasional weekend work, to meet critical regulatory and business deadlines**

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Create clarity from complexity.** Translate broad portfolio priorities, regulatory requirements and enterprise initiatives into clear objectives, deliverables, milestones and accountability
* **Connect strategy to execution.** Help teams understand how bid initiatives, benefit decisions and process changes support portfolio goals, member value and operational readiness
* **Lead without relying on authority.** Build alignment, maintain momentum and create shared accountability across teams with different responsibilities and priorities
* **Use sound judgment.** Evaluate complex issues across product, regulatory, operational, clinical, technology and financial considerations and clearly explain the reasoning behind recommendations
* **Enable good decisions.** Bring together the right information and expertise, clarify tradeoffs and help accountable leaders reach timely, executable decisions
* **Anticipate rather than react.** Identify dependencies, risks and emerging requirements early enough for teams to respond effectively
* **Deliver reliably.** Maintain accurate plans, governance records and milestone calendars and follow through until commitments are completed or appropriately escalated
* **Communicate for the audience.** Provide the right level of information to working teams, functional partners and senior leaders at the right time
* **Keep work simple.** Reduce unnecessary complexity, clarify ownership and use technology to make processes easier, faster and more reliable
* **Strengthen the operating model.** Leave processes, tools, documentation and delivery standards stronger and more sustainable after each initiative
* **Learn and adapt.** Use feedback, performance information and lessons learned to improve future planning and execution
* **Maintain a member-centered perspective.** Consider how product and delivery decisions ultimately affect the clarity, quality and reliability of the member experience

**How You'll Lead**

How you achieve results matters as much as what you deliver. You'll model Humana's values by being Caring, Curious and Committed, and you'll put the Humana Way into practice by living the Golden Rule, keeping work simple, playing to win, keeping your eyes on the horizon and playing as one team.

You'll listen before assuming, seek diverse perspectives and remain open to learning. You'll turn complexity into clarity, focus teams on meaningful outcomes and identify opportunities to replace manual work with technology-enabled solutions. You'll establish clear endpoints, anticipate risks and adjust as conditions change. You'll explain recommendations and decisions transparently, build trust across organizational boundaries and create shared accountability for outcomes that help people achieve their best health.

**Role Expectations**

* Operate with substantial independence within established Product Management, Medicare Advantage, regulatory and enterprise strategies
* Serve as a subject-matter resource for complex program delivery, bid enablement, process activation and cross-functional execution
* Determine the appropriate methods, delivery approach, priorities and timelines for assigned programs with minimal instruction
* Exercise independent judgment on complex program and delivery issues while recognizing when decisions must be elevated to accountable leaders
* Lead through influence and technical guidance rather than through direct people-management authority
* Direct and coordinate the work of cross-functional contributors for assigned initiatives while remaining accountable for program integration and delivery
* Manage multiple complex programs and workstreams with competing timelines, stakeholders and dependencies
* Translate complex research, regulatory information and functional input into clear recommendations and execution plans
* Influence functional strategies and operating practices by identifying recurring issues and recommending sustainable improvements
* Maintain a forward-looking view of program needs while remaining accountable for near-term milestones and deliverables
* Use advanced digital tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Teams and approved automation or reporting platforms, to manage work and communicate effectively
* Adapt quickly as priorities, requirements and business conditions change

**Key Partnerships & Reporting Relationship**

You'll report to the Director, Insurance Product Management and work closely with Growth and Strategy, Insurance Product Management, Process Improvement and Program Delivery, Stars, Clinical, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, Technology and other enterprise and functional partners.

This role does not have direct people-management responsibility; however, you'll lead through cross-functional influence and program ownership.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.  
Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

**Scheduled Weekly Hours**

40

**Pay Range**

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.  
$115,200 - $158,400 per year  
This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

**Description of Benefits**

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-11-2026

**About us**
============

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.
