f21f682e052c9fe8245b.description:
Environmental Technician – Asbestos, Lead & Mold

*California | Field-based, with remote administrative work as assigned*

About McKenna Environmental, Inc. (MEI)

MEI is an established environmental consulting company serving industrial, commercial, municipal, and institutional clients, with occasional residential assignments. We provide environmental assessment, sampling, and monitoring services and value responsive client service, technical accuracy, collaboration, and continued professional development. MEI does not perform asbestos, lead, or mold abatement or remediation.

Position Summary

The Environmental Technician performs field investigations, environmental sampling, documentation, and related project monitoring for suspected asbestos-containing materials, lead-containing materials, and mold or moisture-related concerns. Work is performed in accordance with project scope, applicable requirements, MEI procedures, and the technician’s current training, credentials, and authorized level of supervision. Opportunities for advancement and additional certifications are available.

Primary Responsibilities

· Perform asbestos, lead and mold samples by collecting material, dust, soil, air, and other environmental samples as authorized by the project scope, applicable law, and the technician’s certifications; document representative locations and conditions.

· Prepare accurate field logs; label samples consistently; maintain chain-of-custody records; package and coordinate delivery to qualified laboratories.

· Capture clear, correctly identified photographs and record material description, sample location, condition, and other report-relevant observations using MEI field forms and procedures.

· Operate, inspect, clean, calibrate, and maintain sampling equipment and personal protective equipment (PPE), as applicable.

· Observe applicable site safety rules, hazard assessments, exposure-control procedures, respiratory protection requirements, and project-specific safety protocols; promptly report incidents and unsafe conditions.

· Communicate professionally with clients, project managers, laboratories, contractors, and colleagues; escalate unexpected conditions or scope changes.

· Assist with report preparation, laboratory result tracking, field-data quality checks, records management, and other administrative project activities.

Required Qualifications

· High school diploma or equivalent; relevant college education or technical coursework is preferred.

· Valid California driver’s license and ability to travel reliably to assigned sites, subject to applicable law and MEI driving requirements.

· Current credentials appropriate to assigned work. For asbestos consulting/site surveillance work subject to California certification requirements, a current Cal/OSHA CSST (or CAC) certification is required; MEI may consider qualified candidates for a limited, supervised role while pursuing credentials, where lawful.

· For regulated lead hazard evaluations, a current CDPH Lead-Related Construction Sampling Technician or Inspector/Assessor certification appropriate to the assigned duties is required. A Sampling Technician works under the direction of a certified Inspector/Assessor and cannot independently perform full lead hazard evaluations or clearance inspections.

· Ability to follow technical procedures, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly, and use common digital tools for field forms, photographs, email, and reports. Comfortable using current technology and apps

Preferred Qualifications

Current AHERA training, additional asbestos or CDPH lead certifications, experience with building-material and air sampling, moisture meters and other assessment instruments, chain-of-custody procedures, laboratory coordination, technical report writing, and environmental field monitoring. Relevant safety and respiratory protection training is also valued.

Schedule, Travel & Work Setting

Field-based assignments are primarily in Ventura and Santa Barbara counties, with occasional work elsewhere in Central and Southern California. Technicians are generally dispatched to job sites rather than reporting daily to an office. Schedules vary with project needs; occasional early starts, extended days, and overnight travel may be necessary. Some reporting and administrative work may be completed remotely. All work time, applicable travel time, meal and rest periods, and approved business expenses will be handled in accordance with California law and MEI policies.

Physical and Safety Requirements

The essential functions may involve standing, walking on uneven surfaces, using stairs or ladders when properly trained and authorized, carrying sampling equipment, working in occupied and unoccupied buildings, and wearing required PPE. Assignments may involve dust, moisture-damaged spaces, or other environmental hazards; appropriate controls and training are required. MEI will consider reasonable accommodations to enable qualified applicants and employees to perform essential functions.

Compensation & Benefits

Anticipated compensation: $60,000–$90,000 annualized equivalent, depending on experience, applicable certifications, and role level. Position is anticipated to be nonexempt (hourly), with applicable overtime paid in accordance with California law. Benefits identified by MEI include health insurance, dental insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid training, and mentorship, subject to plan terms and eligibility.

Equal Employment Opportunity

MEI is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without unlawful discrimination, harassment, or retaliation. Reasonable accommodation is available during the application process and employment as required by law.

Pay: $28.85 - $43.27 per hour

Expected hours: 32.0 – 40.0 per week

* Paid time off
* Paid training
* Safety equipment provided

Security Supervisor – Distribution CenterAbout interr

interr is a global security services provider with deep experience protecting complex environments across logistics, distribution, manufacturing, corporate, and retail sectors. We combine **high-touch service, disciplined operations, and smart technology** to deliver security solutions that go beyond traditional security services.

At interr, our people are our greatest asset. We invest in leadership, professionalism, and accountability—because **the right people, in the right place, at the right time** make all the difference.

Position Overview

interr is seeking a **Security Supervisor** to support daily security operations at a large distribution center. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for supervising security officers, ensuring consistent execution of post orders, and maintaining a safe, secure, and professional environment.

Working closely with the Security Manager, the Security Supervisor will provide direct oversight of assigned shifts, support officer development, respond to incidents, and ensure that security services consistently meet interr's standards and client expectations.

The ideal candidate is a **dependable, confident, and approachable leader** who leads by example, understands the importance of customer service, and can make sound decisions in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Supervise day-to-day security operations during assigned shifts, including patrols, truck gate operations, and incident response.
* Provide direct leadership, coaching, and guidance to security officers, ensuring professionalism, accountability, and consistent performance.
* Ensure officers follow interr standards, post orders, safety procedures, and client-specific requirements.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for security-related matters during assigned shifts, escalating significant issues to the Security Manager.
* Conduct shift briefings, post inspections, and routine checks to ensure operational readiness.
* Monitor officer attendance, punctuality, uniform standards, and overall performance.
* Coordinate coverage, post assignments, and staffing adjustments to maintain required security coverage.
* Respond to incidents, emergencies, and security concerns, ensuring appropriate documentation, communication, and escalation.
* Oversee visitor processing, truck check-in and check-out, and perimeter security activities.
* Review daily activity reports, incident reports, and operational logs for accuracy and completeness.
* Assist with onboarding, training, and development of new and existing security officers.
* Identify operational challenges and recommend improvements to the Security Manager.
* Maintain positive working relationships with client personnel, facility leadership, and other stakeholders.
* Promote a culture of professionalism, teamwork, accountability, and exceptional customer service.

Qualifications

* **2–3 years of security experience**, with at least **1 year in a lead officer or supervisory role** preferred.
* Previous experience in a **distribution center, warehouse, logistics, or industrial environment** strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate security officers in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to remain calm, professional, and decisive during incidents and emergencies.
* Experience preparing incident reports, maintaining operational logs, and using basic reporting systems.
* **Experience with yard management software (YMS) preferred.**
* Ability to work independently while following established procedures and management direction.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
* Current New Jersey **SORA certification**, or ability to obtain and maintain certification as required.

Physical & Work Requirements

* Ability to stand, walk, and conduct security patrols for extended periods.
* Ability to respond promptly and appropriately to incidents and emergencies.
* Comfortable working indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to work in an active distribution center environment with vehicle and pedestrian traffic.
* Flexibility to work nights, weekends, holidays, and overtime as operational needs require.

What interr Offers

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* Health, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* Training, leadership development, and career advancement opportunities.
* A professional, supportive, and people-first work environment.
* Opportunities to grow within an expanding organization with a strong global foundation.

Why Join interr?

At interr, **Security Supervisors are more than shift leaders—they set the standard for professionalism, accountability, and service excellence.**

We believe great security operations start with great people. If you take pride in leading by example, supporting your team, and delivering exceptional service, we want to hear from you.

**Built around people, powered by technology.**

f418d539c5dee12687a1.title: Operations Coordinator - Marketing Agency
f418d539c5dee12687a1.description:
**In order to be considered for this full-time, remote position, candidates must live in Colorado. Contractors and 3rd-party firms need not apply.**

### **Join a Rapidly Expanding Team as an Operations Coordinator of a Growing Digital Marketing Agency!**

Are you the person who keeps everything moving, follows up before anyone has to ask, and loves a clean system? Tree Ring Digital is looking for an Operations Coordinator to keep our internal operations organized, our pipeline current, and our follow-up consistent, so our CEO can stay focused on clients and growth.

You will work directly alongside our CEO and business development lead, taking the day-to-day operational work off their plates and owning it from start to finish. From managing inbox follow-up and confirming meetings to keeping HubSpot accurate and our own social media active, you will be the reason details get handled and opportunities get followed up. If you are organized, a strong communicator, and energized by seeing your work help a company grow, this role has real room to grow with you.

Tree Ring Digital is a Denver-based, top-rated digital marketing agency with a culture that's hard to beat. We're like-minded professionals who share common passions, appreciate unique ideas, enjoy each other's company, and love what we do. Our well-established, creative team thrives in a fast-paced environment while maintaining an excellent work/life balance.

**Essential Functions/Responsibilities (including, but not limited to):**

**Executive & Operational Support:**

* Manage the CEO's inbox follow-up, routing team and client emails to the right people so nothing waits on the CEO unnecessarily
* Confirm meetings, schedule introductions, and keep the CEO's calendar organized
* Set up and maintain internal accounts, shared folders, and vendor tools as the team grows
* Place and track print orders and other operational requests
* Keep internal documentation, templates, and process notes current

**HubSpot & Pipeline Support:**

* Enter new contacts, companies, and deals in HubSpot after calls with the CEO and business development lead
* Keep deal stages, tasks, and notes accurate and current so the pipeline always reflects reality
* Enter and organize contact lists from conferences and networking events
* Flag stalled deals and overdue follow-ups so they get handled
* Send a weekly summary of follow-ups completed, HubSpot updates, and open items

**Follow-Up & Brand Support:**

* Send thank-you notes and follow-ups after podcast appearances, and leave reviews for shows we appear on
* Handle strategic partner and post-event follow-up using established templates and voice
* Manage light social media for Tree Ring Digital's own accounts, including the content calendar, posting, and engagement
* Coordinate with our design and content team members on Tree Ring Digital materials
* Help onboard and support interns and new team members as the team grows

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills:**

* 2+ years of experience in administrative, operations, or coordinator roles
* Hands-on HubSpot experience (required): contacts, deals, pipelines, and tasks
* Strong written communication that is professional, clear, and on-brand
* Comfortable with Google Workspace, Slack, and social media scheduling tools
* Agency or small business experience is a plus

**Ability to:**

* Stay organized across multiple priorities without losing detail
* Own a task from start to finish without needing constant check-ins
* Follow up consistently and communicate proactively when something is unclear or delayed
* Learn new tools and processes quickly
* Work independently in a remote environment while staying connected to the team

**Soft Skills That Matter:**

* Reliable and consistent, so the team can count on you to follow through
* Detail-oriented without getting stuck on perfection
* Positive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in seeing the whole team win
* Calm and adaptable when priorities shift
* Curious about how a digital agency runs and grows

**What This Role Is NOT:**

* Not project coordination (our website project coordinators manage client projects and deadlines)
* Not accounting, billing, or collections (our accounting team handles those)
* Not closing sales or writing proposals (the CEO and business development lead handle those)
* Not client marketing execution or client social media management (our marketing specialist and team handle client work)
* Not graphic design (our design team creates visual materials)

**What We Offer the Right Candidate:**

This is a full-time, remote position paying $24-28 per hour depending on experience, with a 40-hour work week. You can work from anywhere in Colorado, with no office requirement.

Full-time employees are eligible for medical insurance with a company contribution, dental and vision with the employee premium fully covered, six paid holidays, paid sick leave, and paid vacation after your first year. You'll work with tools including HubSpot, Slack, and Google Workspace.

We know the holiday season is a unique time to start something new. Our plan is to use the slower weeks to train you so you're fully up to speed when the new year kicks off. For the right person, this role can grow into a Senior Operations Coordinator position or toward client relationships or business development as the company grows. Join a team where people genuinely love working because of our flexible remote environment, laid-back yet professional culture, and colleagues who have each other's backs. We are committed to creating a diverse environment and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

**Ready to keep a growing agency organized and moving forward? Apply today.**

*We appreciate your excitement, but please no calls to our office. Only applications received through our online portal will be considered.*

3ea9a1aae46c60b92af6.title: Field HR Coordinator
3ea9a1aae46c60b92af6.description:
**About Wonder**

Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.

Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on-site by our culinary team and served hot.

Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale.

*Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.*

**About The Opportunity**

All Wonder team members deliver quality customer service while maintaining a clean, safe, and stocked with the products our customers need. As a HR Coordinator, this means:

* Being friendly, professional, and supportive of internal customers (store leadership, HR, and team members) and external customers.
* Engaging in safe work practices and leading others by example.

The HR Coordinator reports to the site HR Manager and supports leadership through a wide range of HR and administrative duties related to staffing, scheduling, talent acquisition, compliance, payroll, and team member engagement.

**The Impact You Will Make**

1. Employee Lifecycle, Recruiting & Onboarding

* Support recruitment activities- posting requisitions, screening candidates against established qualifications, coordinating interviews.
* Coordinate preemployment requirements.
* Conduct new-hire orientations, send welcome communications, and prepare onboarding materials, employment documents, tax forms, and schedules.
* Coordinate with managers, IT, and Facilities to arrange employee access, email accounts, software access, identification badges, and assigned lockers.
* Maintain the new-hire badge report, coordinate badge production with Facilities, and manage locker assignments and related records.
* Track onboarding progress and verify completion of required compliance, security, and initial training.
* Communicate with managers regarding temporary employees and track assignment status.

2. Timekeeping, Payroll & Workforce Administration

* Review and reconcile employee timecards, attendance records, missed punches, and payroll-related information for accuracy and completeness.
* Research discrepancies, coordinate corrections with managers, and submit required adjustments through established approval processes.
* Maintain attendance and scheduling-related records and provide administrative support for workforce tracking.
* Respond to routine employee payroll and timekeeping inquiries, escalating unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate channels.
* Monitor outstanding transactions and follow up to support accurate, timely payroll processing.

3. HR Reporting, Data Management & Recordkeeping

* Prepare, maintain, and distribute recurring and ad hoc HR administrative reports for the site, and Field HR.
* Compile staffing, headcount, scheduling, attendance, turnover, and other workforce metrics requested by leadership.
* Maintain accurate employee information, personnel files, HRIS records, and required compliance documentation.
* Collect, verify, complete as authorized, and upload Form I-9 documentation into Workday, following applicable requirements.

4. Employee Services, Communication & Engagement

* Serve as an accessible first point of contact for employees and managers regarding routine HR policies, payroll, benefits, onboarding, and administrative processes.
* Assist employees with Workday navigation, benefits enrollment procedures, and access to HR information and resources.
* Coordinate employee recognition activities, engagement initiatives, and workplace communications.
* Maintain HR communication boards, HR-related spaces, orientation and training areas employee notices, and accessible information resources.
* Provide professional, responsive, and confidential service to employees, leaders, and external partners, escalating matters when appropriate.
* Coordinate administrative aspects of workers’ compensation cases
* Support accurate, timely documentation and communication related to workplace incidents, while maintaining confidentiality.
* Escalate sensitive employee matters, compliance concerns, and cases requiring interpretation or managerial decisions.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, training schedules, documentation requests, and routine administrative activities across supported groups.

**What You Bring To The Table**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent
* At least two years of administrative, HR operations, payroll, workforce coordination, or related experience.
* Practical experience supporting workers’ compensation claims administration, documentation, or case coordination.
* Experience handling confidential employee information and maintaining accurate records.
* Experience with timekeeping, attendance tracking, payroll reconciliation, or related workforce administration.
* Proficiency with Workday, Looker, and other HRIS systems
* Ability to work effectively with hourly employees, frontline management, and cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications

* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Bilingual in English and Spanish preferred.
* Previous HR administrative experience in manufacturing, production, distribution, logistics, or another high-volume hourly workforce environment.
* Experience with Workday or comparable HRIS platforms.
* Experience supporting recruiting, onboarding, and employee orientation programs.
* Experience preparing recurring HR or workforce reports for multiple business functions.

Key Competencies

* This is a full-time, on-site position based in Swedesboro, New Jersey,
* The facility operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Schedule flexibility is required to support workforce needs, including occasional early morning, evening, or weekend coverage.
* Work is performed primarily in an administrative setting with periodic presence in active production and distribution areas, where noise, equipment activity, and applicable safety procedures are part of the environment.
* Occasional travel may be required for meetings, training, or support of neighboring facilities (less than 10%)
* The position may require occasional movement of office or training materials, including items weighing up to 40 pounds, with appropriate assistance or accommodation as needed.

What Success Looks Like

* Success in this role means delivering accurate and timely HR administration, supporting a smooth employee onboarding experience, maintaining dependable payroll and workforce records, responding effectively to employee and leadership needs, and ensuring that administrative requests and compliance-related tasks are completed or appropriately escalated. The HR Coordinator contributes to operational continuity by providing dependable processes, clear communication, and consistent follow-through across the teams they support.

**Swedesboro:** $23.75/hr - $28.50/hr

Wonder uses geographic-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience.

**Benefits**

The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands.

Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here.

**A Final Note**

At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

**We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

Our focus is on building an incredible, hard charging Team and on providing them with the opportunity to do the best work of their careers. In short, we’re motivated to take on the hardest problems in the development of new medicines – this is **Work That Matters**.

**Collaboration**

*Before reading the job post, we encourage you to watch this* *video* *about our company.* *It gives you an inside look at how we started, the team and culture that made us successful, and where we're going. It's easy to read a job post and apply, but people often wonder about the culture and whether they would fit in. If you want to call Harrow your home and genuinely want to be part of a family and something big, then we encourage you to click this link and get to know us.*

  

**Who is Harrow?**

Harrow (Nasdaq: HROW) is a leading provider of ophthalmic disease management solutions in North America. Harrow is an incredible entrepreneurial company – where we celebrate the ability of every member of the Harrow Family to be the CEO of their job. Harrow's values have driven interest over the past decade in attracting high-performing professionals in a variety of disciplines. Members of our Harrow Family often express their pride in being a part of our commitment to (1) innovation, (2) patient access to affordable medicines, and (3) our track record of having never turned down an ophthalmologist doing mission work around the world – *providing free medicines in support of mission work aimed at giving or maintaining the gift of sight to those most in need*. We encourage you to learn more about Harrow and its unique culture to see if you're the right person to help contribute as we build a truly exceptional company, one we are all so proud of!

Harrow's ophthalmic pharmaceutical portfolio is one of the most comprehensive in the industry, including:

* **An expanding** **Retina Portfolio** including IHEEZO®, TRIESENCE®, BYOOVIZTM, and OPUVIZTM
* **A** **broad Dry Eye Disease product line**, led by VEVYE® and bolstered by well-known adjacent ocular surface disease products such as FLAREX® and FRESHKOTE®
* **A peri-operative Surgical product line**, led by TRIESENCE®, and BYQLOVITM
* **A Rare and Specialty product line**, which includes various high-need and utility products such as ILEVRO®, NATACYN®, and VERKAZIA®
* **A robust internal development pipeline** with multiple late-stage candidates, including MELT-300, MELT-210, H-N08, and CR-01

**Marketing Operations Coordinator**

*Harrow | Reports to: Head, Marketing & Commercial Operations*

Keeps the marketing budget, contracts, sponsorships, and speaker programs running on time and in compliance.

* Bachelor's degree; 1–3 years in marketing, marketing operations, or a related field; pharma or healthcare a plus.

=================

* Remote (U.S.)

==========

dd8721cd9621507d69c8.title: Logistics Delivery Specialist & Warehouse Operations Technician
dd8721cd9621507d69c8.description:
**A day in the life**
---------------------

You start your morning by checking the day's run sheet, loading parts and materials, and inspecting a company vehicle before heading out for time-sensitive deliveries to customers and our other facilities. After drop-offs, you return to assist with shipping and receiving, organize inventory across storage locations, and lend a hand building skids and loading crates. In the afternoon, you might assemble valves and regulators or complete safety checks on regulators after training—work that directly supports our sales organization. When the Facilities Manager needs a hand, you're there—whether it's supporting daily building operations or helping set up and clean up for corporate events. Throughout the day, you keep the workspace safe, orderly, and compliant with company, customer, and DOT requirements.

### **What you'll do**

* Operate company vehicles, including DOT trucks, to deliver parts and materials to customer sites and shuttle goods between facilities.
* Load and unload trucks with a focus on safety and efficiency.
* Execute shipping and receiving transactions; move, organize, and maintain inventory across storage areas.
* Assist with packaging, skid building, and crate loading.
* Perform safety checks on regulators (post-training) and assemble valves, regulators, and related products to support sales.
* Support the Facilities Manager with daily operations and provide setup/teardown assistance for corporate events.
* Work occasional overtime or adjusted schedules as needed for deliveries, inventory tasks, and events.
* Maintain a clean, organized, and safe environment; follow all company and customer safety policies; meet DOT and customer safety requirements.

### **Qualifications**

#### **Basic**

* High School Diploma.
* 2+ years of driving experience with a valid Driver's License and an insurable driving record.
* 1+ years of shipping and receiving experience.
* 2+ years in roles requiring high attention to detail.
* 2+ years supporting internal or external customers.
* 2+ years working with general shipping and receiving concepts.

#### **Preferred**

* Trade school education and/or technical training.
* Forklift operating experience.
* Background in warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, or industrial settings.
* Experience with inventory control and material handling processes.
* Mechanical or technical experience, including the use of hand tools.

### **Physical demands**

* Lift and move materials weighing up to 50 pounds safely.

### **Tools and vehicles**

* Service Truck
* Flatbed Truck / Pickup Truck

### **Proficiencies**

* Driver's License
* Machine Building/Assembling
* Shipping/Receiving
* Inventory Control

### **Why you'll love working here**

We are proud to be an employee-owned organization. Through our ESOP, every team member shares in the growth and success of the company, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and long-term rewards.

Enjoy a standout culture, a fantastic work environment, and competitive benefits including premium medical coverage, a 401(k) match, tuition reimbursement, and other unique incentives.

### **Recruiting and submissions**

When receiving e-mails from a Proconex or Valspec recruiter, you will only receive e-mails from addresses ending in @proconexdirect.com, @proconex.netor @valspec.net. Any other domains are impersonations and should be ignored.

Any third-party unsolicited resume submission(s) will immediately become the property of Proconex. Proconex will not pay any fee to a submitting employment agency, person, or entity unless a signed agreement is established.

### **Compliance**

#### **Employment Contingency**

* Successful completion of a DOT physical and drug screen is required prior to the start of employment.

Candidates must be legally eligible to work in the United States without company sponsorship. Also, we are not interested in working on a corp-to-corp basis with other companies at this time.

Proconex is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status or any other protected class. We are committed to providing a professional environment free of any discrimination or harassment, and we are proud to be a Drug-Free Workplace.

aab2331b656c2aab1c18.title: Customer Success Team Lead
aab2331b656c2aab1c18.description:
**About the role**

For decades, World Book has supplied reference content to school and public libraries and media centers. Now we are moving into K-12 classroom instruction with ClassMate, a supplemental, cross-curricular nonfiction literacy platform for grades 6–8. It helps content-area teachers build literacy into the science, social studies and math units they already teach.

The Customer Success Lead spans both sides of that business. You lead the team that renews World Book Online for schools and libraries, and you personally manage a small book of strategic library and media services accounts. You also lead ClassMate implementation: how new districts get launched, adopted and renewed. That makes this a key role in World Book's move into instruction.

**What you'll do**

**Lead the World Book Online renewal team**

* Manage and coach an experienced Customer Success team that renews World Book Online for school and library customers.
* Own the team's renewal retention, and keep activity, quotes and Salesforce stages current across every account.
* Make sure every rep is progressing to performance goals.

**Manage strategic library and media services renewals**

* Personally own a small book of high-value accounts, including statewide and large-system library contracts.
* Renew them on time and grow them, as the senior relationship World Book holds with each one.

**Lead ClassMate implementation**

* Own the process that takes new districts from contract to launch, adoption and renewal.
* Lead kickoffs, and train principals and teachers in person and online.
* Work with World Book's Curriculum, Product, Operations and Sales teams so every launch is ready on time.
* Use what each implementation teaches us to improve the next one, and build the process so it can scale as ClassMate grows.

  

**What you bring**

**Required**

* Experience implementing K-12 instructional software in schools and school districts.
* K-12 classroom teaching experience.
* Experience leading or coaching a customer success, account management or renewals team.
* A record of owning renewals and a retention number for school, district or library accounts.
* Experience leading live training for teachers and principals, in person and online.
* Daily working use of Salesforce or equivalent CRM.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Teaching or instructional coaching in grades 6–8.
* Hands-on rostering and sign-on setup with district IT (Clever, ClassLink, other).

  

**Compensation, location and travel**

* **Base salary:** $55,000 a year.
* **On-target earnings:** $85,000 a year. This role is also eligible for a referral bonus on ClassMate deals.
* **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits: medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, paid time off, and professional development support.
* **Location:** [Remote, US / Chicago area].
* **Travel:** Up to 25% for strategic account visits and in-person ClassMate launches.
* **Reports to:** Vice President, Sales.

  

*World Book is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

6deacf4ddc91c0a9a1ff.title: Customer Success Manager II
6deacf4ddc91c0a9a1ff.description:
**About Versapay \uD83D\uDE80**

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.

By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

**How you’ll have a massive impact here – and on your career:**

As a Customer Success Manager for our Software Solutions team at Versapay, you will manage long-term relationships across a book of business by becoming our customers' trusted Versapay advisor. In this role, you will build strong relationships with our customers, develop a deep understanding of their business, and explore ways that Versapay products can support their objectives.

You’ll also leverage the growing expertise of the entire ERP system to anticipate and resolve problems that allow a customer to grow with us. To accomplish this, you’ll need 5+ years of experience in a customer success role and customer sales role in a SaaS based company as well as B2B merchant services experience.

### **What you'll do:**

* **Own the customer lifecycle:** Seamlessly transition customers from their onboarding journey, focusing on long-term adoption and success, and growing the installed base revenue number. Facilitate training and enablement sessions, regular cadence calls and Executive Business Reviews (EBR's) with customers.

* **Drive growth and retention**: Build and maintain Strategic Account Plans in collaboration with your customers, including retention and growth strategies. Create shared KPI's that are reviewed, mapped, and measured.

* **Advocate for the customer:** Interact with sales, professional services, and product team members on projects to connect client wishes to the larger business strategy. Effectively represent your customers in driving product development for new integrations and features.

* **Resolve customer problems:** Maintain visibility into customer issues and requests in partnership with our Customer Care team, ensuring customers are updated regularly. Act as a point of escalation for high-severity requests and work cross-functionally to drive resolution.

* **Propose improvements:** Coordinate with other teams across our organization to propose scalable improvements to our customer journey. Identify problems that affect multiple clients and forecast what those trends mean for future attrition.

### **What you'll bring to the team:**

* 5+ years’ experience in a SaaS based Customer Success role.

* Background in Fintech software solutions, preferably accounts receivable

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Economics, or related field.

* **Customer Obsession:** Resolute focus on the needs of the customer above all. Views problems through the customer’s lens first, basing decisions and prioritization around their needs. Asks curious questions to understand the 'why' behind customer needs and the impact on their business.

* **Agility:** Highly adaptive in the face of ambiguous and complex problems, taking a flexible and resourceful approach to new challenges. Able to seamlessly alternate between various tasks and roll with the punches when things change.

* **Follow-through:** High motivation, bias to action and strong prioritization. Can work proactively and independently to bring all assigned work to completion with speed and accuracy.

* **Empathy:** Able to relate to others with a different view or experience. Quickly keys into the needs of customers or collaborators, demonstrating sensitivity in responding to challenges.
* **Collaboration:** Assertive with humility, demonstrating an ability to lead change in a positive way. Maintains high standards for verbal and written communication and is always professional under pressure.
* **Analytical thinking:** Leverages experience and expertise to quickly identify and comprehend complex problems. Adept at understanding how technical things work and walking someone else through the details. Data-driven mindset, utilizing objective measures to assess success and improvement opportunities for customers.

The salary range above reflects base salary only. Total OTE ranges from $93k-$112k USD

c05d9b9998a95f1065f1.title: Health, Safety & Environmental Director
c05d9b9998a95f1065f1.description:
**SUMMARY CONTINUED**

The HSE Director serves as the organization's senior HSE authority and principal advisor to executive leadership on occupational safety, environmental compliance, regulatory matters, risk management, and incident prevention.

The position oversees HSE operations supporting commercial shipbuilding, U.S. Navy and federal shipbuilding programs, repair activities, and associated industrial operations. Prior experience supporting naval or federal shipbuilding projects is highly desired, along with familiarity with applicable NAVSEA requirements, particularly the NAVSEA 8010 Manual. Strong working knowledge of OSHA Construction (29 CFR 1926) and Maritime/Shipyard Employment (29 CFR 1915) regulations is essential.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. HSE Leadership and Strategic Management**

* Provide strategic leadership and direction for the shipyard's comprehensive HSE programs, policies, procedures, and initiatives.
* Establish and implement HSE objectives, performance measures, and continuous improvement strategies aligned with organizational goals and operational requirements.
* Advise executive leadership and operational management on significant HSE risks, regulatory obligations, emerging safety concerns, and corrective actions.
* Promote a proactive safety culture emphasizing leadership accountability, employee engagement, hazard recognition, and incident prevention.
* Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Human Resources, Facilities, and other departments to integrate HSE requirements into operational planning and execution.
* Develop and manage departmental budgets, staffing plans, resources, and organizational capabilities to support current operations and future shipyard expansion.
* Ensure HSE organizational capabilities, staffing, training, and operational controls are sufficient to support expanding U.S. Navy and federal shipbuilding programs.

**2. Occupational Health and Safety**

* Direct the development, implementation, and enforcement of occupational health and safety policies, procedures, and safe work practices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable OSHA regulations, with particular emphasis on Construction Standards (29 CFR 1926) and Maritime/Shipyard Employment Standards (29 CFR 1915), including the ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements to commercial shipbuilding, naval construction, ship repair, facility construction, and other industrial activities.
* Oversee workplace inspections, hazard assessments, job safety analyses, incident investigations, and corrective action programs.
* Establish effective controls for high-risk shipyard activities, including hot work, confined and enclosed space entry, working at heights, lifting operations, hazardous energy control, and industrial equipment operations.
* Ensure appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements are established, communicated, implemented, and enforced.
* Direct occupational health initiatives addressing industrial hygiene, respiratory protection, noise exposure, hazardous substances, and other workplace health hazards.
* Develop and monitor leading and lagging safety performance indicators to identify trends, evaluate program effectiveness, and drive improvements.

**3. Environmental Compliance and Management**

* Provide oversight of environmental compliance programs to ensure adherence to applicable Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (PA DEP), and other federal, state, and local requirements.
* Direct programs addressing hazardous waste management, air emissions, stormwater management, wastewater discharge, spill prevention, and pollution control.
* Ensure required environmental permits, inspections, monitoring activities, regulatory submissions, and reporting obligations are maintained.
* Oversee environmental audits, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support environmentally responsible shipyard operations through pollution prevention, resource conservation, and sustainable operating practices.

  

**4. Regulatory Compliance, Naval Programs, and Management Systems**

* Serve as the primary organizational representative for HSE-related regulatory inspections, investigations, inquiries, and compliance matters.
* Maintain effective working relationships with applicable regulatory agencies, industry organizations, and external stakeholders.
* Direct the development, implementation, and maintenance of HSE management systems consistent with ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 standards.
* Oversee internal audits, management reviews, corrective actions, and certification activities.
* Ensure compliance with applicable U.S. Navy, NAVSEA, Department of Defense, and federal contracting safety and environmental requirements.
* Provide HSE oversight for naval and federal shipbuilding programs, ensuring applicable contractual safety requirements are incorporated into shipyard procedures, operational planning, and workforce training.
* Direct the implementation and oversight of applicable NAVSEA 8010 Manual requirements, including industrial ship safety, fire prevention, hot work controls, fire watch requirements, emergency preparedness, and coordination with Navy representatives.
* Maintain familiarity with applicable NAVSEA Standard Items, including Standard Item 009-07 where contractually applicable, and ensure appropriate compliance processes are established for assigned naval contracts.
* Coordinate with Navy representatives, government inspectors, program management, and production leadership regarding HSE compliance, inspections, corrective actions, and contractual requirements.
* Monitor changes in applicable legislation, regulatory standards, Navy requirements, and industry best practices, and implement necessary program updates.

  

**5. Emergency Preparedness and Response**

* Direct the development, implementation, and maintenance of shipyard emergency preparedness and response programs.
* Oversee fire prevention, emergency response planning, evacuation procedures, incident command coordination, and emergency response training.
* Coordinate with local fire departments, emergency medical services, law enforcement, and other external emergency response organizations.
* Ensure appropriate emergency response personnel, equipment, procedures, and capabilities are maintained to support shipyard operations, including naval construction activities.
* Oversee emergency exercises, drills, and evaluations to assess preparedness and identify opportunities for improvement.

  

**6. HSE Training and Workforce Development**

* Provide oversight of HSE training programs, including new employee orientation, regulatory training, supervisor development, and specialized safety qualifications.
* Ensure employees and subcontractors receive appropriate HSE instruction and training for their assigned responsibilities.
* Establish processes to maintain required training records, qualifications, and certifications.
* Promote workforce engagement and management accountability through safety communication, awareness initiatives, and continuous education.
* Develop the professional capabilities of HSE managers, supervisors, coordinators, and other departmental personnel.
* Ensure specialized training and qualification requirements associated with naval and federal shipbuilding contracts are identified, implemented, and maintained.

  

**7. Incident Management and Workers’ Compensation**

* Direct the investigation and analysis of occupational injuries, illnesses, near misses, environmental incidents, and significant safety events.
* Ensure effective root cause analysis, corrective action development, and follow-up verification.
* Oversee workers' compensation administration, including injury reporting, claims coordination, case management, and return-to-work initiatives.
* Coordinate with Human Resources, Legal, insurance providers, and other stakeholders regarding occupational injury and claims management.
* Maintain accurate HSE records and ensure timely completion of required regulatory, contractual, and management reports.

  

**8. Departmental Management and Operational Support**

* Provide leadership, supervision, and professional development for HSE management and staff.
* Establish departmental priorities, performance expectations, work schedules, and resource allocations.
* Ensure adequate HSE support and field coverage across shipyard operations, shifts, and work locations.
* Support new construction programs, naval projects, facility expansion, and operational changes through appropriate HSE planning and risk assessments.
* Prepare and present HSE performance reports, management briefings, and recommendations to executive leadership.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

  

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* **Strategic Leadership:** Ability to develop and execute comprehensive HSE strategies aligned with organizational objectives.
* **Regulatory Expertise:** Strong working knowledge of OSHA Construction (29 CFR 1926), Maritime/Shipyard Employment (29 CFR 1915), environmental regulations, and applicable federal shipbuilding requirements.
* **Naval Shipbuilding Compliance:** Demonstrated understanding of NAVSEA safety requirements, particularly NAVSEA 8010, including fire prevention, hot work management, and applicable contractual safety obligations.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels and with government representatives.
* **Decision-Making:** Sound judgment and the ability to make timely, risk-based decisions in complex industrial environments.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong analytical, investigative, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* **Leadership and Accountability:** Ability to establish expectations, develop personnel, and promote consistent compliance with HSE requirements.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Ability to address competing operational priorities while maintaining regulatory compliance and safety standards.
* **Organizational Management:** Strong planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and project management capabilities.
* **Adaptability:** Ability to respond effectively to changing operational demands and emerging risks.
* **Professional Integrity:** Demonstrated commitment to ethical conduct, regulatory compliance, and employee well-being.

  

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Provides overall leadership and management of the Health, Safety & Environmental Department, including departmental managers, supervisors, coordinators, specialists, training personnel, and emergency response staff.

Responsibilities include workforce planning, recruitment, performance management, professional development, departmental budgeting, and allocation of personnel and resources.

  

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Safety and Health, Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible professional experience in occupational health, safety, and environmental (HSE) management, preferably within shipbuilding, ship repair, maritime, heavy manufacturing, construction, or similarly complex industrial environments.
* Minimum of 7 years of demonstrated HSE management or leadership experience, including responsibility for supervising HSE personnel, directing comprehensive safety and environmental programs, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting operational leadership.
* Experience supporting commercial shipbuilding, naval or federal shipbuilding programs, or other highly regulated industrial operations is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated professional experience supporting U.S. Navy, Department of Defense, or federal shipbuilding, ship repair, or maritime construction programs is required.
* Strong working knowledge and demonstrated practical application of OSHA Construction Standards (29 CFR 1926) and OSHA Maritime/Shipyard Employment Standards (29 CFR 1915) is required.
* Strong working knowledge of NAVSEA 8010 requirements, including industrial ship safety, fire prevention, hot work management, fire watch requirements, and associated operational controls.
* Familiarity with applicable NAVSEA Standard Items, federal contracting requirements, and Navy-specific safety and environmental compliance obligations.
* Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, and managing comprehensive HSE programs within heavy industrial, maritime, or construction environments.
* Working knowledge of applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations.
* Experience managing departmental personnel, budgets, and organizational resources.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and related business reporting tools.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Safety Professional (CSP) certification is highly preferred. Other recognized professional certifications, such as Safety Management Specialist (SMS), Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST), Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH), or equivalent credentials, will also be given strong consideration.
* Direct HSE leadership experience within a major U.S. shipyard performing naval construction or repair.
* Experience coordinating with NAVSEA, Navy program offices, government inspectors, and federal contracting representatives.
* Experience implementing or maintaining ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management systems.
* Experience leading HSE programs in a large, multi-shift industrial workforce.
* Familiarity with industrial hygiene, environmental permitting, emergency response management, and workers’ compensation administration.

  

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

The position operates in both office and active shipyard environments.

Workplace exposures may include industrial noise, temperature extremes, vibration, dust, welding fumes, smoke, hazardous materials, and other conditions commonly associated with heavy industrial operations.

Duties may require working outdoors in varying weather conditions and accessing vessels, dry docks, fabrication shops, production facilities, and other industrial work areas.

Appropriate personal protective equipment must be worn in designated areas.

Hanwha Philly Shipyard is a tobacco-free facility.

  

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

The physical demands described are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of the position.

The position may require prolonged walking or standing, climbing stairs and ladders, bending, stooping, accessing vessels and elevated work areas, and navigating uneven industrial surfaces.

The employee must be able to safely access operational areas of the shipyard and perform necessary inspections and evaluations.

Employment may be contingent upon successfully completing applicable job-related medical evaluations consistent with company policy and applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

  

**POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK**

This is a full-time, exempt, safety-sensitive management position.

The position generally follows a regular business schedule; however, flexibility is required to support shipyard production schedules, multiple shifts, weekend operations, emergencies, and other operational requirements.

Occasional travel may be required for company business, regulatory matters, professional development, and industry-related activities.

  

**OTHER DUTIES**

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive listing of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications.

Duties, responsibilities, and work assignments may be modified at any time based on organizational and operational requirements.

The recruitment, selection, employment and training of employees during employment, shall be without discrimination because of race, color, religion, national origin, gender or age-except that the applicant must meet the minimum age requirement. Hanwha Philly Shipyard does not, and will not, discriminate because of the disability of such individual.*

be5ff425aa5a1323589d.title: Senior PMO Business Analyst - Automation, Analytics & AI (Sr. BA - AA & AI)
be5ff425aa5a1323589d.description:
Job Description
  
  
The core responsibility of this role is a hands-on project delivery partner and PMO lead for emerging technology, AI, and automation in support of major change initiatives/projects in GCTO. The role will also help coordinate PMO tracking and reporting, and work to ensure technology best practices are being applied across initiatives. They will apply data stewardship and data governance principles in the management of applications. The incumbent may also identify, evaluate, build, pilot, and scale digital, AI, and automation solutions that support GCTO.
  
  
**Primary responsibilities for the role include:**  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
PMO project coordination
  
  

* Contribute to the ongoing management of strategic process improvement initiatives within GCTO.
* Provide general and project support to project managers by promoting cross-initiative alignment and best practice sharing.

AI/Automation strategy & intake
  
  

* Partner across HQ Ops and GCTO functions to surface priority pain points and high-value opportunities for automation, analytics, and AI.
* Lead development of business cases including problem definition, options analysis, solution scope, resource/cost estimates, benefits/KPIs, risks, and compliance considerations.
* Align local opportunities with GCTO priorities; verify with relevant GCDI/central repositories and teams if there are for similar tools to avoid duplication; summarize reuse opportunities and recommendations as appropriate.

Solution design & delivery
  
  

* Lead and drive the end-to-end delivery of tools and solutions (e.g., dashboards, workflow automation, AI-assisted processes) using appropriate platforms and methods.
* Responsible for escalation to centralized assessment when project requirements exceed local capability or scale.
* Translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and oversee build, testing, validation, and controlled deployment; ensure security, privacy, and quality.

Project reporting, tracking & analytics
  
  

* Develop or oversee development of project analytics and visualization (e.g., GCTO Project Catalog, GCTO Change Management Dashboard, GCTO Pilot Tracker, etc) to track deadlines, deliverables, resources and timelines.
* Define and track project success metrics (e.g., cycle-time reduction, accuracy, adoption/satisfaction, cost avoidance/FTE savings) and embed learning loops for continuous improvement.

Governance, compliance & change
  
  

* Ensure solutions comply with ICH GCP, Company policies, and local regulations; partner with Compliance/Legal as needed.
* Maintain project tracking and provide periodic updates via relevant governance forums; support RRO governance processes.
* Lead change management efforts, including training plans, communications, and stakeholder engagement; contribute to capability uplift in data literacy and digital ways of working.

Collaboration & solution scaling
  
  

* Serve as a PMO liaison with functional representatives, Automation/Analytics/AI partners, and when required, IT and external vendors for integration and support.
* Share learnings and reusable assets with other functions and project teams; assess and adapt project-specific tools for local use.

**Educational Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in a life science discipline, business analytics, computing science, engineering, or related field.

**Required Experience:**  

* Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in data/analytics, process improvement, or technology-enabled transformation within life sciences/healthcare or a comparable regulated environment which includes:
* Successfully designing and delivering automation/analytics/AI-enabled solutions (e.g., dashboards, RPA/workflow automation, AI/ML pilots) that produced measurable improvements.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, with hands-on project management in a matrix environment.

**Preferred Experience:**  

* Experience working across multiple functions or on cross-functional process improvement initiatives.
* Exposure to integrations with IT/data science teams.
* Familiarity with clinical trial processes and operational metrics.
* Compliance/regulatory: understanding of ICH GCP and applicable quality and data protection requirements.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**  

* Business process modeling and requirements techniques: e.g., process mapping, user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications
* End-to-end product and solution ownership mindset: with accountability for value delivery across the full solution lifecycle (ideation, MVP, rollout, scaling, maintenance, and retirement).
* Data literacy and analytics: ability to translate business questions into metrics; hands-on with BI tools (e.g., Power BI/Tableau) and data querying basics (SQL or equivalent).
* Automation/AI awareness: practical experience with workflow automation/RPA platforms; exposure to AI/ML use cases and constraints in clinical operations.
* Program/project management: planning, prioritization, risk/issue management, and delivery at pace; comfortable with Agile/Lean practices.
* Communication & influence; ability to influence across functions and present technical topics to non-technical audiences.
* Change enablement: stakeholder engagement, training, and adoption support.
* Problem-solving & critical thinking: structured analysis, hypothesis-driven approach, and pragmatic delivery mindset.

**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Automation, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analytics, Process Improvements, Project Management, Risk Management, Solutions Delivery, Stakeholder Communications, Workflow Automation

OneSource Support Specialist ensure patient treatment compliance and provide resolutions to non-clinical treatment issues for patients through communication and collaboration with both internal cross-functional partners and external stakeholders.

**You will be responsible for:**• Providing exceptional initial onboarding experience and long term adherence support• Share materials on the disease, diagnosis, community resources and treatment support • Maintain and communicate up-to-date knowledge of the resources available as needed, including approved external resources• Place the required welcome calls to patients to introduce the OneSource program and confirm required/requested support• Communicate Benefit Investigation (BI) results with patients and HCP and help interpret them, as needed• Inform patient of financial support eligibility based on available programs• Enroll patient in Alexion financial assistance programs as eligible or refer to external support programs as appropriate• Proactively conduct routine and/or year-end reverification of coverage outreach by working with patients and caregivers, healthcare providers, insurance companies, and Alexion colleagues• Connect patients to the Alexion patient community and inform them about available advocacy groups for their disease• Assist patients in receiving required vaccinations either through Alexion or other vaccination locations• Efficiently navigate CRM documentation and other required record keeping during all patient interactions as to maintain high visibility into patient case status • Properly and immediately report Adverse Events during any customer interactions in the PV Event Reporting Tool• Act as the primary coordinator of all HCP needs across onboarding from case creation to product delivery and ongoing support through lifetime of product use• Coordinate with other appropriate HCP facing roles and cross functional partners to respond to questions from physicians and office staff and address any issues • Communicate with HCPs to confirm required/requested support or obtain missing information• Proactively and effectively consult with and engage the appropriate internal cross functional partners to resolve barriers quickly • Maintain working understanding of the reimbursement process, and leverage knowledge to communicate with internal and external stakeholders while insurance approval is being obtained and work with appropriate field specialists for denial/appeal support• Trigger initiation of adherence program on conclusion of onboarding and connect with patients through defined channels for the determined touchpoints based on product-specific programs• Educate prescribed patients and their caregivers regarding how to prepare for and what to expect during the long-term adherence of the Alexion product or switching from one Alexion product to another• Provide emotional support for patients and caregivers on continued administration of Alexion products

Will also be crucial to:• Develop compliant and collaborative professional relationships with all relevant internal and external customers including but not limited to Patient Education Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, Regional Account Managers, Customer Operations Representatives, Medical Accounts, Access Specialists, Specialty Pharmacies, Site of Care staff, and office coordinators• Effectively escalate access issues by informing the right stakeholders of actions to be taken to resolve any pending items in a timely manner• Collaboratively work with and share responsibilities with other Alexion members and external partners members for pull through of the target patient and HCP experience• Participate in any role appropriate cross functional collaboration work (e.g.Hypercare calls, regional cross functional meetings, One Alexion meetings)• Participate in other project work as needed

**You will need to have:**• Associates Degree Required• Minimum of 3 to 5 years Case Management OR recognized equivalent of education and experience (e.g. contact center, nursing, social service support, healthcare customer service, insurance reimbursement, patient advocacy, etc.) • Well-developed, effective communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills, as well as data entry/computer literacy skills• Ability to work independently, be goal-directed and have strong organizational skills• Must be flexible as well as easily adapt to a changing work environment which will require ongoing maintenance/training of job-related skills/activities• Must be willing to adjust work schedules in response to department needs.• The duties of this role are generally conducted in an office environment. As is typical of an office-based role, employees must be able, with or without an accommodation to: use a computer; engage in communications via phone, email, video, and electronic messaging; engage in problem solving and non-linear thought, analysis, and dialogue; collaborate with others; maintain general availability during standard business hours.We would prefer for you to have:• BA/BS Degree is preferred; patient contact center or patient support program experience is a plus• Excellence at communicating over the phone and handling phone systems and/or experience in a call recorded environment • Familiarity with the relevant legal and regulatory components of the pharmaceutical and biotech industry• Rare disease experience a plus• Deep understanding of insurance coverage and reimbursement processes• Familiarity with managed care and particularly “buy and bill” therapy as well as with reimbursement for infused therapies• Experience dedicated to assisting patients/caregivers • Demonstrated success working within high performing cross-functional teams• Strong empathetic, communication and listening skills• Ability to act with urgency, flexibility, and creativity to quickly get patients on therapy• Strong organizational skills and ability to adapt to change and react constructively in a high-energy and fast paced environment• Demonstrates initiative, teamwork, and accountability

*The annual base salary for this position ranges from $82,000 to $124,000. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.*
