3b3ad6af9b9604da5d29.description:
**Job Description**

At WSFS Bank, we empower our Associates to grow their careers, guide our customers to secure their financial futures, and actively support our Communities so they can fully thrive. Careers with WSFS Bank offer an inclusive and supportive culture, competitive salaries, advancement opportunities, and more. We are the region's locally headquartered bank and wealth management company. We are honored to consistently be named a Top Workplace by our Associates, who make a difference every day for the people, businesses, and Communities we serve. We Stand For Service® is more than part of our name, it’s our mission and our purpose.

The Facilities Maintenance Specialist is responsible for performing a wide range of maintenance, repair, inspection, and facility support services to ensure the safe, efficient, and professional operation of company-owned and leased facilities. This position will be primarily stationed at a designated home location but must maintain the flexibility and availability to travel between facilities as needed to support operational requirements, preventive maintenance programs, special projects, emergencies, and coverage needs. The incumbent will perform routine and corrective maintenance activities, coordinate with vendors and contractors, and provide exceptional customer service while maintaining a safe and productive workplace environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform routine maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting of building systems, fixtures, furniture, and equipment.
* Complete work orders related to plumbing, electrical, HVAC, carpentry, lighting, painting, and general building maintenance.
* Conduct preventative maintenance inspections and activities in accordance with established schedules and procedures.
* Perform facility walkthroughs to identify maintenance, safety, housekeeping, operational, and appearance-related issues requiring attention.
* Respond promptly to maintenance requests and service calls while ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Perform light plumbing repairs including faucet, toilet, sink, and fixture maintenance.
* Conduct minor electrical repairs including replacement of light fixtures, lamps, ballasts, switches, outlets, and related components.
* Perform carpentry and repair work including door adjustments, hardware replacement, furniture repairs, and minor construction activities.
* Coordinate and escort contractors, vendors, and service providers while ensuring compliance with company policies and site requirements.
* Assist with building inspections, site assessments, and facility condition evaluations.
* Support office moves, reconfigurations, furniture installations, workstation adjustments, and space planning projects.
* Perform day porter services as needed, including conference room setups, stocking common areas, workplace appearance inspections, and response to routine facility requests.
* Monitor facility systems and equipment and report deficiencies or recommended improvements to management.
* Assist with emergency response activities and participate in business continuity and facility recovery efforts when required.
* Support safety initiatives by identifying potential hazards and ensuring corrective actions are completed in a timely manner.
* Maintain maintenance records, inspection documentation, work order updates, and inventory records accurately and timely.
* Monitor inventory levels of maintenance supplies, tools, and equipment and submit replenishment requests as needed.
* Travel between company facilities to provide maintenance support, project assistance, emergency response, and operational coverage.
* Maintain company-issued tools, equipment, and vehicles in a safe and professional manner.
* Support Facilities Management with special projects, workplace improvements, and other assignments as directed.
* Maintain flexibility to support maintenance operations, facility services, day porter functions, mail services activities including sorting, distributing, collecting, processing, and delivering incoming and outgoing mail, packages, accountable items, interoffice correspondence, and courier shipments, as well as other operational priorities based on business needs.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required.
* Technical, vocational, or trade school training in facilities maintenance, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, carpentry, or related field preferred.
* Minimum of three (3) years of commercial building maintenance, facilities maintenance, property operations, or related experience preferred.
* Working knowledge of basic electrical, plumbing, HVAC, mechanical, and building maintenance practices.
* Experience utilizing computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) or work order management software preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Ability to safely operate maintenance tools, equipment, ladders, and related devices.
* Must be willing and able to travel regularly between company facilities within the assigned geographic region.
* Must maintain reliable transportation and the flexibility to adjust work locations based on operational needs, staffing requirements, emergency situations, and special projects.
* Valid driver's license with a satisfactory driving record.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to lift, carry, push, and pull materials, equipment, and supplies weighing up to 50 pounds.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, stoop, kneel, climb ladders, and perform repetitive physical activities throughout the workday.
* Ability to safely perform maintenance work in office, warehouse, and operational environments.
* Ability to operate company vehicles or personal vehicles for business purposes in accordance with company policy.
* Ability to respond to emergencies and perform work in varying environmental conditions as required.

WSFS Bank will only consider candidates who are presently authorized to work for any employer in the United States and who will not require work visa sponsorship from WSFS Bank now or in the future in order to retain their authorization to work in the United States.

Headquartered in King of Prussia, PA, Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS) is one of the nation’s largest and most respected providers of hospital and healthcare services. Since our founding in 1979, UHS has grown steadily into a premier Fortune 500® corporation perennially recognized by multiple esteemed national rating entities. Through its subsidiaries, UHS operates inpatient acute care facilities, inpatient behavioral health facilities, outpatient and other facilities, nationwide virtual behavioral health services, an insurance offering, a physician network and various related services with physical locations in the U.S., Puerto Rico, Ireland and United Kingdom. www.uhs.com.

The Corporate IS Department is seeking a dynamic and talented Associate System Administrator.

As part of a team of more experienced staff, the **Associate System Administrator** supports Behavioral Health Division employees including corporate, local, and remote staff by troubleshooting and maintaining servers, PCs, and peripheral equipment. Works closely with team members to identify and implement resolutions to customer support incidents. Collaborates with senior programming, engineering and application support staff on design and implementation of approved projects. 32ec8d55d0b7a1cfd1e4.title: Administrative Coordinator
32ec8d55d0b7a1cfd1e4.description:
Overview:

The Events and Outreach Coordinator is an integral team member who provides high level administrative support to the Chair and Department Manager, ensuring the smooth daily operations of the office. In this crucial role, the incumbent will play a pivotal part in facilitating and enhancing office efficiency and supporting the broader team's work. Their responsibilities encompass maintaining a strong sense of integrity and financial stewardship, offering departmental support, acting as the seminar coordinator and faculty recruiting coordinator, an administrator for NSF REU programs that come into the department, and the coordinator for the Princeton Catalysis Initiative.

The Events and Outreach Coordinator will independently coordinate all research seminars; oversee billing and membership activities for the department's corporate affiliates program; maintain departmental directories and distribution lists; create content for the department's website; provide administrative and grants support for an NSF REU program and the Princeton Catalysis Initiative, be the primary point of contact for administrative planning and financial coordination of faculty recruiting efforts within the department.

Some night and weekend work required to support events.

Responsibilities:

Faculty Recruiting and Reappointments: Plans on-site visits for junior and senior candidates, managing a roster of ten to twenty individuals from December to May. Processes reimbursements for candidates following the visits. Assists the Chair's assistant with planning for senior faculty and second junior faculty visits. Maintains meticulous financial records for end-of-year reconciliations.

Seminar Planning: Independently coordinates all logistics and provides on-site management for departmental seminars (3-5 per week). Arranges travel and lodging for speakers, books conference rooms and auditorium, prepares and distributes seminar announcement email messages. Coordinates speaker schedule with multiple faculty meetings and meal arrangements with students, postdocs, and faculty. Sets up presentation technology/AV equipment. Updates departmental web page with seminar announcements on a weekly basis, using WordPress. Processes speakers' business travel reimbursements. Plans 5-10 yearly larger symposiums for guests including seminar, reception, and faculty dinner. To review the current roster of seminars, please visit the current events schedule at https://chemistry.princeton.edu/department/seminars-events.

Princeton Catalysis Initiative Support: Assists the Director with compiling application materials for annual grant cycle. Oversees website development, including content and details of affiliated people e.g., adding people, updating titles or contact information, etc. Adds news stories or PCI-supported publication announcements. Publishes calls for proposals and annual symposium materials, including pre-symposium announcements - listing speakers, and post-symposium stories documenting the symposium. Handles all logistical planning for the annual PCI Symposium. Responsible for guest travel and lodging arrangements, meals, AV set-up, developing printed materials, and processing for a multi-day symposium with external attendees. Trains student hosts for the event and provides day-of on-site event management. Upon the completion of the symposium, receives, compiles, organizes, and disseminates all proposals to the faculty review committee. Visit https://pci.princeton.edu/ to learn more about the Princeton Catalysis Initiative.

NSF REU Administrative Support: Supports faculty with pre and post award responsibilities for NSF Research Experience for Undergraduates Program. Administers the application website and maintains student records. Handles financial onboarding and payments for participants, as well as all payments for expenses related to the program. Compiles data related to students’ educational and career outcomes, and advancement per NSF guidelines. Ensures that programming and logistics follow University guidelines for undergraduate summer programs. Completes NSF annual report for review by faculty and helps to prepare renewal applications. Assists student services team with other summer programming responsibilities as needed.

Industrial Associates Program: Manages the administrative aspects of the Industrial Associates Program. Keeps track of membership rates and processes annual invoices. Deposits payments from members. Maintains a shared spreadsheet with membership information relevant to the department's business office. Administers membership benefits, including library access and course registrations. Information about the Industrial Associates Program can be found at https://chemistry.princeton.edu/research-facilites/industrial-associates-program.

Departmental Event Planning and Community Management: Organize all departmental events commissioned by the Chair, including but not limited to holiday dinners and luncheons, faculty colloquia, alumni receptions, and other ad hoc events. Assists the Administrative Services Manager and Manager for Educational Programs, Outreach, and Events with community-building events for postdocs and graduate students. With the department manager and Chair's assistant, plans logistics for faculty and staff meetings, including scheduling, room bookings, and food ordering. Maintains and updates all department directories and email distribution lists (for over 400 people).

Support undergraduate course exam prep including making and supervising exam copying for large service courses.

Assists with other departmental responsibilities as needed.

  
Qualifications:

* Required qualifications include:
  + Associates or other 2-year degree
  + 1-3 years of relevant experience
  + Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, flexibility, and the ability to multi-task
  + Excellent and professional verbal and written communication skills
  + Exceptional diplomatic skills, and the ability to remain calm under pressure
  + Attention to detail, accuracy and the ability to set priorities are critical
  + Proficiency with Microsoft Suite is required, including experience and proficiency in the use of functions in Excel
  + Understanding of budgets and financial statements
* Preferred qualifications include
  + Experience and competence in maintenance/updating of content management systems (CMS) such as Wordpress
  + Basic proficiency in image and photo editing software
  + Familiarity with Princeton University business applications, helpful (Concur, PeopleSoft, etc.)

Princeton University is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

The University considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's qualifications, work experience, education/training, key skills, market, collective bargaining agreements as applicable, and organizational considerations when extending an offer. The posted salary range represents the University's good faith and reasonable estimate for a full-time position; salaries for part-time positions are pro-rated accordingly.

If the salary range on the posted position shows an hourly rate, this is the baseline; the actual hourly rate may be higher, depending on the position and factors listed above.

The University also offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees. Please see this link for more information.

9098b211474a9fe88f9b.title: Administrative Operations Coordinator
9098b211474a9fe88f9b.description:
**Operations Coordinator – WIIRE**

**About WIIRE**

WIIRE® (Women Invest in Real Estate) exists to help women become W-2 optional through real estate investing. Through our membership community, podcast, events, education, and partnerships, we serve thousands of women across the country who are building businesses and designing lives they love.

Our flagship offer, The WIIRE Community, is a membership that combines an 8-week CEO Framework with live coaching calls, hot seats, cohort huddles, expert calls, and a tight-knit community of women doing real deals.

We're a small team that practices what we teach: real systems, honest numbers, and a life that isn't run by the business.

**The Role**

The Operations Coordinator is the person who makes things happen behind the scenes at WIIRE. You'll own the majority of implementation work across our website, email, community platform, launches, and member experience, turning plans into live, polished, on-time deliverables.

Title: Operations Coordinator

Reports to: Operations Manager

Type: Full-time (40 hours/week), W-2 employee

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm Central

Location: Remote (must work Central time hours); bonus points if you're local to Tucson/Phoenix, AZ

Salary: 52,000–62,000 per year, DOE

Travel: Approximately quarterly, for retreats and in-person events

Start date: January 2027

*This role joins our weekly team meeting on Tuesdays at 10:00 am CT. During launches, you'll also support occasional evening webinars.*

**What you'll do**

Your responsibilities will include, but aren't limited to the following.

**Member experience (Mighty Networks)**

* Onboard and offboard members and track renewals
* Manage the main client-facing inbox, giving members timely customer service and tech support
* Keep the community calendar, announcements, course lessons, and call replays up to date
* Track engagement and live attendance, and follow up with unengaged members
* Coordinate surprise-and-delight gifts for members

**Email and website**

* Prep, proof, and schedule emails in Kit, and build forms, tags, rules, and automations
* Update copy, photos, and freebies on our Squarespace site and Netlify landing pages, build new pages, and set up redirects

**Launches**

* Set up ThriveCart and Stripe products, launch emails, and launch-related website updates
* Build and maintain Zapier automations
* Track daily KPIs during the live launch window
* Fulfill bonuses and giveaways

**Webinars and live calls**

* Coordinate cohort calls and guest speakers, including Zoom setup and tech testing
* Prep and polish slide decks for grammar, formatting, and consistency
* Provide behind-the-scenes support during live webinars
* Edit, catalog, and share replays

**Events (retreats and Summer Camp)**

* Coordinate venues and vendors ahead of each event
* Provide on-site support with materials, meals, welcome baskets, setup, and day-of deliverables

**Podcast**

* Support the Women Invest in Real Estate podcast with guest coordination, scheduling, planning, and admin

**Sponsors, affiliates, and testimonials**

* Serve as the point of contact for sponsors, help create sponsorship plans, and deliver sponsor and affiliate commitments on time
* Pull and catalog member testimonials for marketing

**General administration**

* Support payment processing
* Handle other administrative tasks that keep the business running

**Tools you'll use**

You don't need to be an expert in every tool on day one, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly and confidently.

* Project management and communication: Monday, Slack, Zoom
* Docs, sheets, email, file storage: Google Suite
* AI: Claude
* Website: Squarespace, Netlify
* Email marketing: Kit (ConvertKit)
* Community and courses: Mighty Networks
* Checkout and products: ThriveCart & Stripe
* Automation: Zapier
* Design: Canva
* Calendar invites: AddCal

**\*Bonus points** for in-depth experience using Claude in your day-to-day work.

**Who thrives in this role**

The right person for this role finds deep satisfaction in getting things done well. You'll likely recognize yourself here if:

* **You're detail-obsessed.** You catch the broken link, the typo in the subject line, and the automation tag that's one letter off, before a member ever sees it.
* **You follow through.** When something is on your list, it gets done, and you close the loop without being chased.
* **You stay calm under deadlines.** Launch weeks get busy. You can juggle competing priorities, re-sort your list on the fly, and keep your cool when a checkout page breaks an hour before cart opens.
* **You love a good system.** You naturally document how you do things, build checklists and SOPs, and look for ways to make the next time easier.
* **You figure things out.** When you hit a wall, you search the help docs, test a fix, and come back with a solution (or a clear, specific question) instead of just the problem.
* **You communicate proactively.** You flag risks early, give status updates without being asked, and are comfortable in Slack-first async work.
* **You take ownership and use good judgment.** You know when to make the call yourself and when to check in first.
* **You're comfortable running things behind the scenes.** You prefer not to be the star of the show.
* **You're coachable.** You welcome feedback, ask questions, and get better every week.
* **You care about the member experience.** You understand that every email, replay, and onboarding step shapes how our members feel about WIIRE.
* **You're warm and team-oriented.** You fit a small, collaborative, down-to-earth team that takes the work seriously but has fun doing it.
* **You keep things confidential.** You'll see member information, financials, and launch plans, and you handle them with discretion.
* **You're flexible.** You're happy to jump in on an evening webinar during launch or pack a bag for a retreat.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Experience in operations, project coordination, or online business support (virtual assistant, operations coordinator, launch support, or similar)
* Hands-on experience with at least one email marketing platform (Kit preferred) and one website builder (Squarespace preferred)
* Experience supporting a digital product, course, or membership launch
* Strong written English, with a sharp eye for grammar and formatting
* Comfort working in a project management tool (Monday preferred) and communicating primarily through Slack
* Availability Monday–Friday, 8:00 am–5:00 pm Central, plus occasional evening webinars during launches
* Ability to travel approximately quarterly (typically over the weekend)

**Bonus points**

* In-depth experience using Claude to speed up writing, research, documentation, or workflows
* Experience with live event coordination
* Experience with Mighty Networks, ThriveCart, or Zapier
* Experience editing video or managing webinar replays

**Benefits and how to apply**

**Benefits:**

* **Holidays:** All Federal holidays off, including a week for Thanksgiving & a week for Christmas
* **Paid time off:** 2–3 weeks of PTO per year
* **Flexible schedule:** Need to take an afternoon off for an appointment or family commitment? No problem. As long as your work is done before you step away, there's no need to make up the hours.

*Please note that this role does not include health insurance or company-provided equipment. You'll need your own computer and reliable internet.*

**To apply,** click the **Apply Now** button below to fill out our application form.

**Apply Now: https://jobs.wiire.com/**

*WIIRE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members.*

Pay: $52,000.00 - $62,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote

1d16b1c41d24d0dd819e.title: Associate Director, Infrastructure & Operations Solution Delivery Partner
1d16b1c41d24d0dd819e.description:
The Infrastructure and Operations Solution Delivery Partner is a leadership role responsible for building and running the horizontal delivery and service management engine of the I&O function. The role will partner with IT Business Partners, Platform and Service Leads, EPMO, Finance, Enterprise Architecture, Information Security, Testing and Validation, and business-aligned Solution Delivery Partners to convert enterprise demand into prioritized, working infrastructure, enabling capabilities and workplace services.

  
  

Core Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  
  

**Platform Lifecycle Management**

* Coordinate end-to-end delivery activities for assigned platforms and services in partnership with Platform and Service Leads. from strategy, ideation, and demand intake through roadmap planning, delivery, release, operations, continuous improvement, and eventual retirement - in partnership with the Platform and Service Leads, who own their platforms' lifecycles.

* While remaining curiously connected to all areas of IT which come together to provide services to stakeholders, support adoption of Lean-Agile, SDLC, and delivery management practices across Infrastructure & Operations teams.

* Establish disciplined capacity vs demand and dependency management practices that balance speed to value, operational risk, cybersecurity, resilience, and the discipline required in a regulated environment.

* Ensure IT Service Introduction, Release Management, and Change-and-Adoption discipline for new and materially changed platform and service capabilities, ensuring operational readiness before go-live, including SLAs/OLAs, support models, CMDB and asset data, runbooks, monitoring, capacity, continuity, security, training, documentation, and backout plans.

* Coordinate with Platform and Service Leads to ensure alignment of roadmap dependencies and delivery timelines.so shared capabilities, dependencies, sequencing, and operating-model implications are resolved before they become delivery or service risks.

* Coordinate cross-functional teams and stakeholders to support successful delivery outcomes.- Delivery Managers, Platform Leads, Product Managers, Service Leads, Service Managers, engineers, architects, and supplier teams - shaping a culture of accountability, candid collaboration, quality, and continuous improvement.

* Prepare and communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership and governance forums and cross-functional governance forums on a regular cadence.

* Partner with Information Security, Testing and Validation, Quality, and Compliance to ensure infrastructure and workplace capabilities meet applicable GxP, validation, privacy, security, records management, and audit requirements.

**Horizontal Delivery Across I&O Platforms and Services**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for IT Business Partners, Business-Aligned Solution Delivery Partners, the Finance Team, IT Strategic Planning, PMO, and Testing and Validation

* Given a platform and services model, coordinate delivery across Hybrid Cloud Services, Digital Workplace, and Enterprise Service Management platforms and services, as well as other platforms and services that may be built in the future. These include cloud and on-premises infrastructure, platform engineering, hosting, compute, storage, backup, recovery, network connectivity, and infrastructure automation; endpoint platforms, collaboration and productivity services, identity-enabled workplace experiences, device lifecycle, mobility, and employee technology support, with a focus on secure and reliable user experiences; ITSM service catalog, request fulfillment, workflow automation, CMDB, asset and configuration practices, knowledge management, and service reporting.

* Ensure cross-platform initiatives are planned and executed as integrated services rather than isolated tower deliverables, with explicit dependencies, shared milestones, acceptance criteria, operational ownership, and measurable outcomes. By working with other teams, ensure a similar seamless and cross-platform experience through communication, coordination, and planning.

* Coordinate delivery across globally distributed teams and a mix of employees, contractors, strategic vendors, and managed service providers, maintaining clear accountability for outcomes and handoffs.

**Demand Management & Portfolio Planning**

* Establish, improve, and run the demand management process for I&O, ensuring enterprise and platform needs are captured, qualified, prioritized, sequenced, and mapped to delivery capacity and enabling capabilities.

* Ensure demand visibility and clear prioritization as well as appropriate capacity planning for absorbed and paid services. Participate in platform finance and budgeting, forecasting, tracking, and variance analysis

* Facilitate quarterly roadmap planning across Hybrid Cloud Services, Digital Workplace, and Enterprise Service Management, aligning strategic outcomes, lifecycle obligations, service health priorities, technical debt, funded initiatives, and capacity constraints.

* Partner with Platform Leads, Service Leads, PMO, Enterprise Architecture, and Finance to translate roadmaps into practical project and delivery plans, with clear scope, outcomes, dependencies, estimates, milestones, funding, resources, and accountable owners.

* Drive work estimation, project scoping, capacity and resource planning, and prioritization providing leadership with credible commitments and explicit trade-off analysis when demand exceeds available capacity.
  

  

**Qualifications**

Knowledge / Experience and Skills:

* 7-10 years of progressive IT experience, with 3-5 years leading infrastructure, operations, service management, or technology delivery initiatives
* Broad experience delivering and operating enterprise infrastructure and end-user technology services across cloud and data center platforms, networks, workplace technologies, ITSM/ESM, automation, observability, resilience, and managed services.
* Track record working in a highly regulated environment with a disciplined ITIL-based service design and service delivery approach
* Strong track record delivering initiatives using Lean-Agile, SDLC, Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe practices across globally distributed platform, product, and service teams; SAFe experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience participating in or facilitating quarterly planning, platform roadmap development, portfolio prioritization, dependency management, and delivery planning at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with IT Service Design, Service Introduction and operational readiness for infrastructure, workplace, and enterprise service management capabilities.
* Demonstrated success in demand management, work estimation, project scoping, capacity planning, prioritization, and senior stakeholder management.
* Project and program budget planning and management experience.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills with the ability to translate technical delivery matters for business and executive audiences.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and managing stakeholder relationships at all organizational levels.
* Strong analytical and systematic problem-solving abilities.
* Experience in regulated or GxP environments preferred.
* **Customer-Focused** : Anticipates user needs and delivers practical, value-driven solutions.
* **Accountable:** Own delivery planning and execution for a designated infrastructure domain or service portfolio.
* **Innovative** : Challenges the status quo and champions new ideas.
* **Collaborative** : Builds strong partnerships across disciplines and cultures.
* **Ethical** : Demonstrates integrity and aligns with Otsuka's corporate values.
* **Resilient** : Adapts quickly to new challenges and shifting priorities.
* Provides guidance, coaching, and training to colleagues within a discipline.
* **Matrix Leadership:** Ability to lead through influence across Delivery Managers, Platform Leads, Product Managers, Service Leads, Service Managers, engineers, architects, and supplier teams to orchestrate portfolio-level outcomes without direct reporting authority.
* Experience working with globally distributed business and IT teams, especially in Japan, EU, and India.
* Up to 15-20% travel is required, based upon business needs.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (required).
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Administration (MBA with a technology focus), or a related discipline (preferred).

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* ITIL 4

* PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI

* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe Agilist, SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE), PO/PM, Lean Portfolio Management, or SAFe Practice Consultant (SPC)

* Cloud and infrastructure certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Cisco, VMware, or equivalent

* ServiceNow, IT asset/configuration management, enterprise architecture, or product management certifications (advantageous)

* Vendor-specific certifications relevant to cloud, workplace, service management, automation, observability, network, or infrastructure platforms

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

We do not require any financial, credit card or bank account information and/or any payment of any kind to be considered for employment. We will also not offer you money to buy equipment, software, or for any other purpose during the job application process. If you are being asked to pay or offered money for equipment fees or some other application processing fee, even if claimed you will be reimbursed, this is not Otsuka. These claims are fraudulent and you are strongly advised to exercise caution when you receive such an offer of employment.

Otsuka will also never ask you to download a third-party application in order to communicate about a legitimate job opportunity. Scammers may also send offers or claims from a fake email address or from Yahoo, Gmail, Hotmail, etc, and not from an official Otsuka email address. Please take extra caution while examining such an email address, as the scammers may misspell an official Otsuka email address and use a slightly modified version duplicating letters.

To ensure that you are communicating about a legitimate job opportunity at Otsuka, please only deal directly with Otsuka through its official Otsuka Career website https://vhr-otsuka.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/External .

Otsuka will not be held liable or responsible for any claims, losses, damages or expenses resulting from job recruiting scams. If you suspect a position is fraudulent, please contact Otsuka’s call center at: 800-363-5670. If you believe you are the victim of fraud resulting from a job recruiting scam, please contact the FBI through the Internet Crime Complaint Center at: https://www.ic3.gov , or your local authorities.

Otsuka America Pharmaceutical Inc., Otsuka Pharmaceutical Development & Commercialization, Inc., and Otsuka Precision Health, Inc. (“Otsuka”) does not accept unsolicited assistance from search firms for employment opportunities. All CVs/resumes submitted by search firms to any Otsuka employee directly or through Otsuka’s application portal without a valid written search agreement in place for the position will be considered Otsuka’s sole property. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired by Otsuka as a result of an agency referral where no pre-existing agreement is in place. Where agency agreements are in place, introductions are position specific. Please, no phone calls or emails.

0a4536f10d79ecf1d31d.description:
* Fresno, CA, United States
* Remote Available
* Sales
* JOB220562

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program. Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the daVinci Clinical Sales Representative .

**Essential Job Duties**

**Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)**

* Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
* Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
* Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
* Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

**Clinical & Technical Support**

* Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

* Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
* Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
* Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

* Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
* Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
* Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
* Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

**Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)**

* Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
* Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
* Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
* Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

**Escalation & Customer Issue Management**

* Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
* Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
* Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

**Market & Clinical Insights**

* Collect and communicate customer feedback *and experiences* to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.
* Assist in field action activities when necessary.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role
* Clinical experience is preferred.
* Experience as a robotics coordinator, surgical assistant, and/or surgical nurse plus industry experience strongly preferred.
* Understanding of soft tissue anatomy & procedures.
* Exhibit a working knowledge of typical hospital policies.
* Excellent communication, teaching, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in high-pressure environments (managing multiple ORs) and coordination of multiple tasks at one time.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and complex procedures.
* Team oriented with a commercial mindset.
* Willingness to travel up to 40%. Primary travel will be within a CSM team.
* Ability to travel within a Clinical Sales Manager team geography, supporting multiple hospitals.
* Flexibility to support early starts, after-hours cases, and weekend procedures based on customer need and territory utilization.

**Required Education and Training**

* Associates degree. Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Degrees in (RN, PA, NP, RT, or other clinical credentials) are welcomed.

**Working Conditions**

* Ability to stand for extended periods and provide in-person case support within an operating room (OR) environment, which includes pushing, pulling, lifting and squatting.

### **Additional Information**

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay + CIP, benefits, and equity. The target pay rate for this position is:

**Base salary region 1:** $115,500

**Base salary region 2:** $105,000

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on
  
business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.
  
Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the
  
candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.

Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:

Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.

We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target base compensation ranges are listed.

**Base Compensation Range Region 1:** $100,300 USD - $135,700 USD
  
**Base Compensation Range Region 2:** $85,300 USD - $115,300 USD
  
**Shift:** Day
  
**Workplace Type:** Remote - This job will be remote and/or the job is designed to be performed outside of the office. Employees will come onsite when requested by the leader.

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

The Contact Center Supervisor plays a pivotal role in leading our contact center team, ensuring the effective and efficient management of operations related to prior authorization services for healthcare companies. This role is essential in upholding Evolent Health’s commitment to excellence in service delivery, optimizing processes, and supporting our mission to enhance the quality of care while reducing costs. * Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide constructive feedback, and address performance issues to maintain a motivated and high-performing team.

* Monitor daily contact center operations to ensure adherence to service levels and quality standards, in line with Evolent Health’s commitment to operational excellence.
* Implement and manage processes that enhance efficiency and effectiveness in handling prior authorization requests.
* Analyze call metrics and other performance indicators to identify trends, areas for improvement, and implement necessary corrective actions.

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Proficient in contact center software and CRM systems.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

**The opportunity:**
--------------------

The best events feel effortless. Making them that way is where you come in. As Events & Conventions Coordinator, Corwin, you'll bring Corwin Institutes, conferences, conventions, and webinars to life for educators, school leaders, and district partners. You'll keep in-person, virtual, and hybrid events on track, from registration and travel to vendors, materials, and onsite support. And you'll team up with Marketing, Sales, Editorial, and Operations to turn every event into new connections, visibility for Corwin's books and professional learning, and real opportunities for Sales. If you love turning a long checklist into a memorable experience, we'd love to hear from you, whatever path brought you here.

**What you will help achieve:**
-------------------------------

* Events that feel organized, welcoming, and worth attending, from the first invite to the final follow-up.
* More educators discovering Corwin books, authors, and professional learning services.
* Leads and insights that turn into timely sales conversations.
* Better events every time, shaped by attendee feedback and results.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

* Coordinate logistics for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, including venues, registration, travel, catering, audiovisual needs, and vendors.
* Keep calendars, timelines, checklists, schedules, and run-of-show documents current.
* Partner with the Director of Events to manage details and communications for authors, speakers, presenters, and facilitators.
* Create event materials, signage, and attendee communications with Marketing and Design, and promote events through email, social, web, and Cvent.
* Plan trade show and convention booths, shipping, materials, product orders, staffing schedules, and author signings.
* Help weave Corwin books and professional learning services into conference programming and customer engagement.
* Capture leads, keep attendee and prospect data accurate in the CRM, and prepare event briefs and attendee lists that help Sales follow up fast.
* Track expenses and invoices, and manage book shipments and supplies with Warehouse, Customer Service, and Operations.
* Provide onsite support at major events, solving issues so attendees, presenters, and colleagues have a great experience.
* Share registrations, attendance, feedback, and results in post-event reports, and keep partners updated on progress and open items.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* 1–3 years of experience supporting events, conferences, webinars, trade shows, or marketing programs, in any industry.
* Strong organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through.
* Experience with event logistics such as registrations, vendors, travel, or expense tracking.
* The ability to juggle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt when priorities shift.
* Clear written and verbal communication, plus a collaborative, customer-focused approach.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and comfort learning registration, CRM, email marketing, or project management tools.

**Helpful, but not essential:**
-------------------------------

* Experience in K-12 education, educational publishing, education technology, or professional learning.
* Familiarity with conferences for educators, school administrators, and district leaders.
* Experience with event promotion, lead capture, CRM updates, or sales follow-up.
* A degree in marketing, communications, event management, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* An interest in events that share books, educational resources, or professional learning.

**Work and travel:**
--------------------

Expect to travel about 4–6 weeks a year for conventions, Corwin Institutes, and other company events. Some events may include evening or weekend work.

**Why join Sage?**
------------------

* Work with colleagues who care about education, evidence, and helping ideas reach the people who need them.
* Contribute in a collaborative, international organization with room to learn, grow, and shape how we work.
* Access a comprehensive benefits package.

**An inclusive opportunity**
----------------------------

We know that strong candidates do not always meet every preferred qualification. If this role interests you and you can demonstrate many of the capabilities described, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience, different career paths, and the perspectives people bring from varied backgrounds and communities.

Sage is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the process, please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

Sage is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs.

**How to apply**
----------------

Ready to create events educators remember? Apply through Sage Careers and share a resume that highlights the events and programs you've helped bring to life. Not sure you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We'd love to learn what you'd bring.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact **hr.resume@sagepub.com** All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

**Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:**

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

904a67983cda499f5b52.title: Operations Director – Individual Events & Scouting
904a67983cda499f5b52.description:
**Operations Director –Individual Events & Scouting**

**Company:** Perfect Game Inc.  
**Department:** Event Operations & Scouting  
**Position Type:** Full-Time  
**Travel:** Extensive travel required  
**Reports To:** Senior Leadership / Executive Management  
**Location:** To be determined based on company needs

**Position Overview**

Perfect Game Inc. is seeking a highly organized, driven, and experienced Operations Director – Individual Events & Scouting to lead the planning, execution, and continued development of individual baseball events and scouting operations across the country.

This role is responsible for overseeing the operational execution of individual player events, including player showcases, prospect camps, identification events, and other assigned baseball programming. The Director will work closely with internal departments, event staff, scouts, coaches, facility partners, and external stakeholders to deliver a consistent, professional, and high-quality experience for players, families, college recruiters, professional scouts, and participating organizations.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational leadership, baseball knowledge, scouting experience, event management expertise, and the ability to manage multiple events and teams in a fast-paced, travel-intensive environment.

This individual will be expected to establish operational standards, develop and support event personnel, improve efficiency, maintain quality control, and help drive the continued growth and success of Perfect Game's individual event and scouting operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Individual Event Operations & Execution**

* Oversee the planning, preparation, staffing, and execution of individual player events, showcases, prospect camps, and other assigned programming.
* Ensure events are delivered professionally, efficiently, and consistently across all assigned markets and regions.
* Develop and maintain standardized event operating procedures, timelines, checklists, staffing plans, and communication protocols.
* Coordinate event logistics, including facilities, field assignments, equipment, technology, staffing, player check-in, scheduling, and on-site execution.
* Monitor event readiness and identify potential operational issues before they affect the participant experience.
* Conduct on-site event visits and operational reviews to evaluate execution, staff performance, and compliance with company standards.
* Establish post-event reporting procedures to evaluate results, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions.
* Work collaboratively with event directors and regional personnel to manage scheduling changes, weather-related disruptions, facility issues, and other operational challenges.

**2. Scouting Operations & Player Evaluation Support**

* Oversee the operational side of scouting activities associated with individual events, ensuring appropriate staffing, scheduling, technology, and evaluation workflows.
* Collaborate with scouting leadership to align event execution with player identification, evaluation, and recruitment objectives.
* Help establish consistent processes for collecting, validating, organizing, and distributing player information and event results.
* Support the effective use of player profiles, performance data, verified measurements, video, and other scouting-related information.
* Ensure scouting personnel have the resources, schedules, communication, and event support necessary to perform their responsibilities effectively.
* Coordinate with internal teams to maintain the integrity, accuracy, and timely processing of event data and player evaluations.
* Assist with the implementation of scouting-related initiatives, operational improvements, and new event formats.
* Maintain appropriate separation between operational responsibilities and independent scouting judgments, with player evaluations remaining subject to established scouting standards.

**3. Leadership, Staffing & Personnel Development**

* Lead, support, and develop event operations personnel, including event directors, coordinators, on-site staff, and other assigned team members.
* Establish clear expectations, performance standards, accountability measures, and communication practices.
* Assist with recruiting, onboarding, training, and evaluating event personnel.
* Build staffing plans that support event volume, geographic coverage, participant demand, and budget requirements.

* Maintain flexibility to support weekend events, early-morning schedules, evening activities, and changing travel requirements.

* Evaluate current operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, scalability, and service quality.

* Identify opportunities to control costs without compromising event quality, safety, or the participant experience.

**About us**

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.  
More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

37d96bc2409a3d998c37.description:
Why us?:

Philadelphia is where American independence first took root—a bold, vibrant spirit that still defines the city today. At the center of it all is Logan Square, home to the Logan Hotel, a destination that blends lively urban energy with curated luxury.

With its striking art collection, refined service, and bespoke experiences tailored to every guest, the Logan Hotel offers an unparalleled journey into elegance and sophistication.

Our associates play a vital role in bringing this experience to life. They anticipate guest needs, create personalized moments, and support one another to deliver exceptional hospitality every day.

If you have a passion for hospitality, a mindset driven by service, and a desire to make a difference in the lives of others, The Logan Hotel may be the perfect place for you.

  
Job Overview:

The Food and Beverage Administrative Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to F&B leadership, the Sales and Marketing Manager, and outlet managers. This hourly position assists with payroll and tip sheet preparation, reporting, correspondence, menu production, events, and departmental projects. The coordinator maintains accurate records, handles sensitive information confidentially, and helps the team meet deadlines while providing warm, professional service.

Qualifications:

TITLE: Food and Beverage Administrative Coordinator

DEPARTMENT: Food and Beverage

REPORTS TO: Food and Beverage Leadership

POSITION STATUS: Hourly

Customer Service Focus

Support a culture that makes the ordinary extraordinary by communicating promptly and professionally with guests, associates, and business partners and helping the team deliver thoughtful, consistent hospitality.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Payroll and Tip Sheet Support

* Gather and review time punches, time notes, schedules, and supporting records for completeness; identify missing information or discrepancies and follow up with managers and associates.
* Assist with preparing payroll information, including overtime, paid time off, holiday, sick, bereavement, and other pay adjustments; route questions and corrections to the appropriate manager or payroll representative.
* Compile and reconcile tip sheets, tip pool and gratuity allocation records against applicable reports and approved procedures; flag discrepancies for management review before submission.
* Maintain organized, confidential payroll and tip documentation and assist with meeting payroll deadlines.
* Assist managers with collecting information related to scheduling or timekeeping requirements, including Philadelphia Fair Workweek requirements, and refer questions to management or Human Resources.

Sales Marketing and Events Support

* Assist the Sales and Marketing Manager with guest and client email correspondence, inquiries, follow-up, and organization of leads, using approved information and escalating pricing, contracts, and commitments for management approval.
* Maintain event calendars and files; prepare and organize event materials, BEO packets, menus, and related documents, and communicate updates to the appropriate managers.
* Assist with the coordination and execution of private dining, promotions, special events, and other activities as directed.
* Support marketing projects, promotional materials, and social media content and scheduling in accordance with brand guidelines and manager approval.

F&B Administrative and Operational Support

* Prepare, proofread, print, and organize menus, inserts, signage, training materials, and other documents; confirm current pricing and content with the responsible manager.
* Support F&B managers with email correspondence, guest follow-up, scheduling of meetings, recordkeeping, and other administrative tasks.
* Compile and organize sales, labor, attendance, inventory, and other operational reports; assist managers with basic calculations, spreadsheets, and tracking.
* Coordinate assigned projects, track deadlines and outstanding items, and communicate progress or obstacles to the appropriate manager.
* Participate in meetings and assist with other departmental duties as assigned.

Supervisory Duties

None. This position supports managers and does not independently supervise associates or approve payroll, tip allocations, contracts, or other management decisions.

Position Qualifications

Education and Experience

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* One to two years of administrative, hospitality, payroll, sales support, or related experience preferred.

Knowledge and Skills

* Strong organization, accuracy, follow-through, and ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Professional written and verbal communication and a warm, service-oriented approach.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook; ability to learn payroll, timekeeping, point-of-sale, and event management systems.
* Comfort with basic math, percentages, reconciliations, and spreadsheet data.
* Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential associate, payroll, guest, and business information.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate across departments, and seek guidance when needed.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

Work is performed primarily in an office and restaurant environment and involves computer work, sitting, standing, walking, and occasional movement of supplies or event materials. Duties may include working in active restaurant or event spaces and assisting with events as scheduled. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

***World Class Medicine.***  
***Purpose-Driven Partnership.***

Veritas Veterinary Partners offer exciting career opportunities in state-of-the-art facilities across the U.S. Our hospitals are staffed by board-certified specialists, create a collaborative environment where you can work alongside like-minded, caring professionals. If you're passionate about veterinary medicine, this is your chance to thrive in a dynamic, high-quality setting.

At Veritas Veterinary Partners, our mission is to build a network of trust and opportunity for veterinary professionals nationwide. We specialize in supporting Specialty and Emergency care hospitals, aligning with your unique goals and medical standards. Veritas, founded by Thomas Scavelli, DVM, DACVS, is dedicated to recruiting top-tier talent and fostering collaboration within our community. With a focus on exceptional care, we bring together highly trained veterinarians, technicians, and teammates committed to our patients' well-being.

We believe in ***Truth in Medicine and Trust in Partnerships***, ensuring we always provide the highest standard of care. Come join us and make a meaningful impact on the community you serve.

**GSVS VETERINARY EMERGENCY CARE TOMS RIVER** is excited to announce we are hiring Client Service Representative to support our clinic!
  
**Why GSVS:** We are not your typical veterinary hospital! We know the winning recipe to maintain the care and compassion that our patients depend upon us for, is to create a safe and supportive space for you to put your skills to use, develop new skills, and be a part of our highly collaborative, fun, and friendly team! We are proud of our company culture and positive staff engagement within a fast paced, learning environment; and our associate employment longevity is proof of our commitment to take care of one another, and provide the highest standard of care to the patients we serve.

**Position Summary**

Veritas Veterinary Partners seeks a warm, professional and highly organized client experience representative to serve as the face of a partner hospital. The client experience representative is the first person clients encounter and the last they see before leaving, making this role central to how Veritas Veterinary Partners is perceived and experienced.

This position operates at the front desk and is responsible for delivering exceptional in-person and phone-based client service, managing billing and payment processes and supporting all aspects of the client journey from arrival through departure.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Client Arrival and Check-In**

* Greet clients and patients warmly upon arrival, creating a welcoming and reassuring first impression in what is often a stressful situation.

* Complete accurate check-in processes including verifying client and patient information, confirming appointment details and notifying clinical teams of patient arrival.

* Manage the reception area and waiting room, communicating wait time updates to clients proactively and with empathy.

* Answer incoming phone calls promptly and professionally, routing calls, taking messages and providing information within scope.

* Maintain an organized and professional front desk environment throughout the shift.

**Financial Transactions and Billing**

* Present financial estimates clearly and with compassion, ensuring clients understand charges associated with their pet's care.

* Process payments accurately using approved payment methods including credit, debit, CareCredit and payment plans.

* Reconcile end-of-shift transactions and report discrepancies to the supervisor or manager.

* Provide clients with information about payment options and direct complex financial questions to the financial liaison or supervisor.

* Maintain accurate client account information within the practice management system.

**Discharge and Follow-Up**

* Coordinate client discharge by ensuring all paperwork, prescriptions and discharge instructions are complete and clearly communicated.

* Schedule follow-up appointments and referrals as directed by the clinical team.

* Reinforce key discharge instructions with clients in plain accessible language, ensuring they leave with a clear understanding of home care expectations, medication schedules and when to seek follow-up care.

* Send appointment reminders, follow-up communications and client satisfaction outreach as directed.

* Document all client interactions and transactions accurately in ezyVet or other designated systems.

* Contribute to a collaborative team culture by remaining open to feedback and coaching, and supporting teammates to deliver a consistent and exceptional client experience.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum one year of experience in a client-facing, customer service or reception role in a professional environment.

* Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills with a warm and professional demeanor.

* Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

* Basic proficiency with computer systems, scheduling platforms and point-of-sale or billing software.

* Reliability, punctuality and a consistent professional presence at the front desk.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a veterinary, human health care or similarly client-intensive service environment.

* Familiarity with ezyVet, Impromed, AVImark or similar practice management software.

* Background in hospitality, luxury service or patient-facing health care reception.

* Experience processing payments, presenting financial estimates or working with CareCredit or similar financing products.

**Our CIRCLE Values**

At Veritas Veterinary Partners, we harness the hearts, minds and effort of our teammates, united in our CIRCLE of Core Values, to help us unlock our full potential.

* **Compassion —** We lead with heart in every interaction. For our patients, this means attentive care. For clients, it means guiding them with understanding. For each other, it means creating a culture founded on respect and trust.

* **Integrity —** We always do what's right. Through accountability, honesty and transparency, we uphold the highest ethical and medical standards and honor the trust placed in us in every decision.

* **Respect —** The best outcomes come from working together with heart and valuing every perspective. By honoring each other's expertise, we create an environment where collaboration thrives and ideas emerge at every level.

* **Community —** We harness the strengths of our people to build a culture where everyone is seen, heard and valued. This unity fosters trust across teams and assures clients their pets are cared for by one team.

* **Leadership —** We set the standard for exceptional care by combining sharp minds, medical expertise and compassion. Through best-in-class tools, collaboration and a growth mindset, we uphold our role as leaders in specialty and emergency veterinary care.

* **Evolution —** We stay curious, adaptable and seek ways to elevate patient care. By committing to a growth mindset and supporting each other, we unlock the fullest potential of individuals, teams and our organization.

**Work Environment**

This position is onsite full-time at a partner hospital. The role is based at the front desk and requires extended periods of standing and sitting, frequent in-person and phone interaction with clients and the ability to remain composed in high-volume and emotionally charged situations.

The client experience representative will regularly interact with clients in varying states of stress, grief or urgency related to their pets and must consistently model calm, empathetic professionalism. Exposure to clinical noise, animal handling near reception areas and emergency arrivals is expected. Hours include evenings, weekends and holidays consistent with hospital operating hours.

**Schedule:** Wednesday - Saturday, 11pm - 9am

  

**GSVS is proud to offer the following benefits:**

* Competitive salary based on your level of experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance, with HSA option- some plans paid 100%
* Maternity/Paternity leave
* Retirement Plan – 401K with employer match
* Licensing fees paid for credentialed technicians
* Employee Referral Bonus
* Paid Time off
* Mental health support with Talkspace
* Uniforms provided
* Pet discounts for medical care
* Full Time credentialed technicians eligible for Sign On Bonus

In accordance with the requirements of all applicable federal, state and local laws, we welcome and encourage diversity in the workplace regardless of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. All current positions require the ability to speak, read, and write English proficiently. Additional fluency in other languages is preferred but not required.*
