09ad122e30b18740a48e.title: Service Coordinator
09ad122e30b18740a48e.description:
At Home Instead, we believe great homecare starts with great relationships.

We aren't simply filling shifts. We are building lasting relationships, creating dependable care experiences, supporting families, and making it possible for older adults to remain safely and comfortably at home.

We are a small, close-knit office team with a big responsibility and an even bigger heart for what we do. Our days move quickly, our schedules are full, and our work matters. We take pride in being responsive, dependable, resourceful, and there for one another. We share responsibility in building an excellent client experience, step in when help is needed, take ownership of challenges, and understand that our collective success depends on how well we work together.

We are looking for a ***Service Coordinator*** who shares that commitment.

This is an opportunity for someone who genuinely loves working with people, thrives on solving problems, brings organization to a fast-paced environment, and finds purpose in making a meaningful difference every day.

**The Opportunity**

The Service Coordinator is a central part of our team and plays a critical role in creating dependable, consistent homecare experiences for our clients. This person is responsible for thoughtfully coordinating Care Professional (CP) schedules, managing staffing needs, responding to feedback, and supporting important human resources functions.

Beyond scheduling, this role helps build and maintain the relationships that are at the heart of our business. It requires someone who understands that every schedule represents a commitment to a client, a family, and a CP.

A last-minute call-off isn't just a shift to fill. It's an opportunity to demonstrate our commitment to a client, support a CP, and find a solution that works for everyone.

We move towards solutions quickly, manage a tremendous amount of activity, and hold ourselves and each other to high standards. The right person will enjoy that pace, anticipate what needs to happen next, and take pride in being someone the entire team can count on.

**What You'll Do**

**Coordinate Dependable, Relationship-Driven Care**

* Coordinate CP assignments based on client needs, care plans, skills, availability, and personal preferences.
* Proactively manage schedules to ensure consistent, dependable coverage for our clients.
* Handle call-offs, shift changes, and last-minute staffing challenges with urgency, resourcefulness, and sound judgment.
* Communicate schedules, changes, and expectations clearly and promptly to clients and CPs.
* Support clients and families with scheduling concerns, always keeping the relationship and continuity of care in mind.
* Build familiarity with our clients and CPs to make thoughtful assignments that encourage consistency and lasting relationships.
* Monitor scheduling efficiency, utilization, and overtime.
* Anticipate scheduling needs and identify potential challenges before they become problems.
* Provide on-call scheduling support as needed.

**Support and Care for Our Care Professionals**

* Track and manage Paid Time Off requests and balances.
* Maintain accurate employee benefit eligibility records and documentation.
* Help ensure CPs meet all applicable state, local, and franchise requirements.
* Assist with employment verifications, unemployment claims, workers' compensation claims, and incident reporting.
* Respond to CP questions and concerns with professionalism, fairness, and a genuine desire to help.
* Build positive working relationships with CPs and help create an environment where they feel supported, respected, and valued.

**Strengthen Our Team and Operations**

* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely employee and scheduling records.
* Monitor compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.
* Manage documentation related to benefits, compliance, claims, and PTO.
* Address internal complaints and feedback promptly, professionally, and constructively.
* Collaborate closely with Client Care, Human Resources, and the management team.
* Communicate proactively and keep teammates informed so that important details don't fall through the cracks.
* Take ownership of responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* Look for opportunities to improve processes, solve problems, and make our operation stronger.
* Be willing to step outside your defined responsibilities and help wherever the team needs you.

**The Person We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who brings more than organizational skills and scheduling experience. We want a person who genuinely cares about people, takes pride in their work, and understands that being part of a small team means everyone contributes to the client experience and success of the business.

You will thrive here if you:

* Love working in a people-oriented business and genuinely believe in the importance of the work we do.
* Are dependable, approachable, and someone others naturally enjoy working with.
* Have a strong internal drive to get things done and take initiative without waiting to be asked.
* Are comfortable taking ownership of problems and seeing them through to resolution.
* Enjoy a fast-moving environment where priorities change throughout the day.
* Are exceptionally organized and can manage multiple moving pieces without losing sight of the details.
* Think ahead, anticipate needs, pivot and change directions, and enjoy finding practical solutions.
* Communicate clearly, calmly, and thoughtfully, especially during high-pressure situations, conflict, or unexpected challenges..
* Have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to navigate challenging conversations with empathy, expertise, and good judgment.
* Are flexible and willing to jump in wherever needed, understanding that team success comes before individual job descriptions.
* Are receptive to feedback, willing to learn, and always looking for ways to improve.
* Bring a positive, can-do attitude and take pride in making a difference.
* Lead with humility, empathy, and respect, recognizing that how we treat people is just as important as the work we accomplish.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* College degree preferred, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience in scheduling, staffing coordination, customer service, human resources, or operations preferred.
* Knowledge of the senior care or homecare industry is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize competing demands.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, maintain confidentiality, and use sound judgment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive working relationships with employees, clients, families, colleagues, and community partners.
* Ability to work independently while remaining highly collaborative.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and general computer applications.
* Ability to learn and operate Home Instead technology systems.
* Professional demeanor, patience, and a congenial telephone presence.
* Willingness to work evenings or weekends as business needs require.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position in a professional office environment.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 45.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off

* Participate in committees and sub-committees as requested
* Continuously improve operations through actions including but not limited to encouragement and utilization of feedback from individuals supported, staff, families, peers and other stakeholders, response to audit results, implementation of established best practices, and identification and prevention of potential problems
* Share information and lessons learned toward continuous improvement with peers and administration for the benefit of all programs
* Create and foster a positive workplace culture of support, encouragement and growth by creating shared vision and clearly communicating that vision, by having open and transparent communication, by recognizing the accomplishments of those he/she leads, and by being aware of the training and development needs and aspirations of those he/she leads.

  + Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university AND 2 years of experience working directly with individuals with intellectual disabilities

At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $22 - $27 hourly. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Our Branch Coordinators positively impact the lives of patients and their caregivers, by phone and in person, delivering excellent customer service during each interaction. Working collaboratively with patients, providers and other team members, Branch Coordinators ensure orders are received and processed timely, efficiently, and accurately. Branch Coordinators play an important role in ensuring Apria is paid for the services we provide by obtaining all necessary documentation required to bill health insurance plans.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Act as first point of contact to patients arriving in person.
* Answer inbound calls from customers on a multi-line phone system; provide information to new and existing patients, troubleshoot common issues, work with the branch team and other departments to find appropriate resolutions and escalate queries or concerns when necessary.

* Work with sales team, referrals and/or patients to gather documentation/information needed to meet insurance guidelines. Requests health plan authorizations/information as required; either electronically or verbally.
* Review of new and recurring patient accounts, obtain all necessary documentation from the referral source to bill the individual health insurance plans, allowing our patients to maximize their available health plan benefits and to receive the much-needed care as soon as possible.
* Collect credit card payments and billing information, reconcile daily receivables, and submit to the lock box.
* Perform outbound customer satisfaction calls to patients and referrals.
* May conduct downloads of recording devices such as apnea monitors, oximeters, CPAP devices and other respiratory equipment.

Responsibilities:

The **Scheduling Coordinator** assists in participant care responsibilities by performing receptionist duties, escorting participants to exam rooms and scheduling and coordinating various appointments between the participant and providers. The Scheduling Coordinator also performs a variety of clerical duties and provides administrative support to all clinic functions.

**Essential Functions and Work Responsibilities**

**Functional Category: Participant Scheduling and Support**

**Estimated Percent of time Spent – 50%**

* Schedule appointments with external network specialists for consultations and procedures as ordered by PACE Primary Care Physicians (PCPs).
* Prioritize appointment scheduling based on Expected By Date and clinical urgency as directed by medical staff.
* Collaborate daily with clinical teams to manage participant flow and ensure timely access to care.
* Meet or exceed scheduling productivity standards set.
* Ensure all appointment data and updates are accurately documented in Epic (electronic medical record).
* Serve as a liaison between participants, caregivers, providers, and external specialist offices to coordinate care and resolve scheduling conflicts.
* Notify participants and families of appointment details, including date, time,
* Provide attentive, responsive, and professional service during all participant and provider interactions.
* Scheduling high complex medical appointments between participants and specialty providers.
* Coordinating referrals and specialty care services.
* Obtaining and tracking consultation notes and diagnostic testing results.
* Managing clinic-based scheduling workflows and participant care coordination activities.
* Performing front-office clinic support functions such as participant check-in and appointment management.
* Preparing and coordinating authorizations related to specialty referrals and services.
* Documenting scheduling activities and participant interactions within an EMR to support and maintain the participant's medical record.

**Functional Category: Internal Collaboration & Compliance**

**Estimated Percent of time Spent – 50%**

* Collaborate closely with the Interdisciplinary Team (IDT), Transportation Department, Adult Day Health Center (ADHC), and clinic staff to coordinate appointments, ensure appropriate support services are arranged, and align scheduling with participant care plans and operational priorities.

* Coordinate proactively with internal departments to manage schedule changes, transportation adjustments, medically necessary escorts, and coverage needs to prevent service disruptions.

**Qualifications**

Requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**REQUIRED**

Work Experience and Qualifications:

Applicants are considered until the position is filled.

**TEMPORARY TRAINING COORDINATOR (PART-TIME)**

**ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION**  
ALTA Language Services is the only 100% employee-owned company in our field. As employee owners, we work hard and go beyond words to perform each and every task with integrity and a passion to stay innovative. We share three core values that guide our work: **be kind, be resourceful, and get it done**. We’re a diverse group of smart, creative people who love our work and what we learn about other languages, countries, and cultures. We offer a flexible work environment that allows us to work remotely from anywhere in the US and competitive benefits, including healthcare and company stock.

ALTA participates in E-Verify.

**DESCRIPTION**  
**About the Job**

The Training Coordinator is responsible for communications, sales, student inquiries, online training events, and administrative tasks as assigned. This is a temporary position supporting our Training team, expected to begin November 2026 and last through approximately March2027. This position is part-time, Monday through Friday, with a maximum of 29 hours per week. Hours are not guaranteed.

**Responsibilities**

Customer Service:

* Answers training inquiries both telephonically and via email.
* Promotes and sells online course offerings.
* Provides a timely response to student requests for technical or general support.
* Troubleshoots common student issues related to course access, enrollment, course progress, completion, certificates, and other LMS functionality.
* Monitors social media accounts to ensure timely response to any inquiries or questions from potential students, current students, and alumni.
* Supports corporate client onboarding, enrollment, and progress tracking, including setting up client access in the Student Journey Management tool.

Scheduling:

* Assists Customer Operations Manager in coordinating and scheduling coaching services for online students.
* Maintains coach schedules in Scheduler and Zoom and sends timesheet reminders to coaches.

Data Entry & Administrative Tasks:

* Assists in enrolling customers in courses.
* Assigns exams and pretests in the testing portal, maintains the test results spreadsheet tracking pass/fail outcomes, and issues certificates.
* Assists Customer Operations Manager with LMS management, including routine course and student administration, troubleshooting, and uploading recorded content for live weekly sessions.
* Course Logistics: Coordinates the logistics of online training courses. Serves as liaison between ALTA and trainers, coaches and clients for logistical event needs.

Technology, AI & Automation:

* Uses AI tools to draft communications, summarize inquiries, create documentation, and troubleshoot issues, reviewing all output for accuracy and tone.
* Identifies repetitive tasks and recommends or builds automations (e.g., enrollment reminders, timesheet reminders, follow-up emails) to improve efficiency.
* Maintains accurate data across systems (LMS, ERP, testing portal, Student Journey Management tool, Notion) to support automated reporting and tracking.
* Follows ALTA guidelines for responsible AI use, including protecting student and client personal information.

Other duties as assigned.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Skills**

* Impeccable Customer Service
* Excellent organization and time management
* A “big picture” mentality
* Project Management
* Ability to multi-task with precision
* Ability to work well with diverse populations and accents
* Keen attention to detail
* Innovation and creativity
* Eagerness to grow and learn
* Strong technical aptitude; learns new software systems independently
* Comfort using AI tools in a professional environment
* Clear, professional written communication

**Tools and Technology**

Employees in this position are required to use the following tools as part of their core responsibilities:

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common online collaboration tools.
* Ability to learn and effectively use learning management systems and educational technology.

Note: Access to certain tools may be granted as systems are implemented. Employees must demonstrate the ability to use these tools efficiently and responsibly to complete assigned tasks.

Additional Skills:

* Ability to exercise sound professional judgment and maintain appropriate human oversight when using AI-enabled outputs.
* Follows ALTA guidelines for responsible AI use, including protecting student and client personal information.

Strong adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies as systems evolve.

**Education/Training**

Degree: Bachelor Degree

**Preferred Experience**

* Sales experience
* Experience with Moodle or another Learning Management System (LMS)
* Experience with Articulate 360 or other e-learning authoring tools
* Bilingual language skills
* Certificate from a 40-hour medical interpreter training course

**Salary**

Current pay range for the position of Training Coordinator: from $19.00 to $29.00 per hour. Actual pay depends on several factors, including but not limited to level of education, knowledge, skills, qualifications, certifications, previous experience in similar positions, market pay rates, comparable salaries, geographical location, jobs availability, budget availability, revenue etc.

Part-time employees are not eligible for ALTA sponsored benefits.

Remote

6d36958417005e235a85.title: Coordinator, Program Support (Part-Time, Temp)
6d36958417005e235a85.description:
**About LEE**

LEE is a nonpartisan network of leaders at all stages of life and career. We provide leadership development, coaching, career supports, and digital career products to support and inspire members to increase access and opportunity in their communities. At LEE, we equip members with the tools, platform resources, and industry knowledge they need to grow their career, expand their network, and take action to create change. LEE believes that effective leaders who are grounded in their values and experiences can make a difference in their communities. (wearelee.org)

LEE is an outcomes-oriented, tech-forward, entrepreneurial organization focused on growing its impact through investments in platform tools and digital engagement. We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work, and to offer generous compensation, a virtual work setting that includes flexible scheduling, and a competitive, values-driven benefits package.

LEE is in the midst of transitioning from primarily high-touch, in-person engagement to a scalable, tech-enabled marketplace model. As we build and implement new tools, we are seeking to hire staff who will leverage AI and automations to expand LEE’s reach. Relationships and human judgment remain critical, and your role will help us drive member support, engagement, and impact.

**Position Summary**

The Coordinator, Program Support is part of the Policy & Advocacy team reporting to the Vice President, Policy & Advocacy. This role serves as an operational anchor for fellowships, coaching, and digital learning programming, bridging streamlined digital workflows and automated intake systems with high-touch, empathetic support for LEE members and host organizations.

To reduce application cycle turnaround times and ensure seamless operational transitions for LEE members and partners engaged in career programming, the Coordinator will automate routine logistics, inbox triage, and data tracking across platforms like Salesforce, Asana, and Google Workspace. The ideal candidate possesses strong organizational skills, exceptional attention to detail, and a warm, responsive communication style.

The Coordinator, Program Support role is a part-time, temporary position for up to 20 hours per week with an anticipated end date of 12/15/2027.

**Position Location:** Flexible

**Travel Requirements:** 10% - national travel for annual staff conferences

**Responsibilities:**

**Program Operations - 60% ~12 hrs/ week**

* Configure and maintain application workflows and intake cycles for fellowship hosts and member pipelines, with a focus on centering participant experience and delivering shorter turnaround times for application launches
* Support virtual and in-person delivery of fellowships, coaching, and digital learning programming, leveraging automations in scheduling to improve efficiency
* Ensure programming participation and engagement by providing real-time status visibility across applicants, enabling staff to quickly remove barriers to participation
* Partner with Finance to monitor host payment and liaise with hosts to resolve outstanding balances
* Surface operational bottlenecks across various program cycles, piloting refined templates and digital workflows that build team delivery capacity
* Ensure accurate and timely data, leveraging automations and integrations to improve accuracy and efficiency of key records and systems (e.g., MOUs, invoices, surveys, data)

**Member Liaison and Support** - **30% ~ 6 hrs/ week**

* Act as the primary point of contact for member support, leveraging empathy and situational judgement to field member inquiries and facilitate high-quality member experiences across program continuums
* Manage various program inboxes and drive responsiveness by triaging needs and elevating liaising between staff and members
* Leverage AI and automations to provide assisted routing and drafted templates for member FAQs driving responsiveness and overall member satisfaction

**Special Projects - 10% ~2 hr/week**

* Engage in team-level, org-wide, or cross-team special projects as assigned by manager or designee
* Provide short-term coverage of other Coordinator-level duties during a leave, vacancy, or PTO

**Required Qualifications:**

* **Experience & Education:** Bachelor’s degree or commensurate professional experience (Equivalency standard: Without a Bachelor’s, an additional 4 years of relevant experience is required; with an Associate’s, an additional 2 years).
* **Professional Track Record:** 2+ years of professional experience in program support, administration, or similar roles.
* **Demonstrated Skills:** Experience managing logistics for in-person and virtual events/programming with strong attention to detail and the ability to draft effective, streamlined, and error-free communications.
* **Tech-Forward Mindset & AI Fluency:** Demonstrated baseline proficiency with modern digital productivity suites (specifically Google Workspace) and a demonstrated commitment to integrating AI tools into daily workflows to drive operational scale.
* **Human-Centered Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to build authentic, trust-centered relationships across diverse racial, socioeconomic, and political backgrounds.
* **Mission Commitment:** Passionate, demonstrated commitment to LEE’s mission, core values, and theory of systemic change for kids and communities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* **Systems Management:** Experience maintaining data systems (especially Salesforce) and/or project management tools, e.g., Asana
* **Civic Engagement Background:** Demonstrated interest or experience in policy, advocacy, or civic engagement

**Benefits and Pay**

The position level for this role is Coordinator and the corresponding hourly pay range for this position is $25.91 - $38.30. Pay is competitive and based upon relevant experience and cost of labor for your location. Learn more about compensation here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1kUbPtNQiPIjWA4xbEaEY08RLQ-ZeO49wd8dc1v3U\_s8/edit?usp=sharing. Note: This is a non-exempt position where employees are eligible for weekly overtime pay.

Please visit LEE's Careers Website FAQ Section for information on benefits that part-time temporary staff have access to, which include, but are not limited to, ten days of annual sick leave as well as a dollar for dollar match of up to 5% of your income into a 401(k) following 90 days of employment.

**Application Submission:**

The hiring team will prioritize review of completed applications, which include resume submission and the completion of a few short answer questions. We do not have an application deadline for this position, and we will review applications on a rolling basis. For additional information, please visit the Frequently Asked Questions section on LEE's Careers website: https://wearelee.org/who-we-are/careers/.

**Physical Requirements & Work Demands:**

* This position is primarily a sedentary role working with colleagues based around the country using remote technologies.
* The person in this position may need to occasionally move about inside the office to liaise with staff or access office equipment.
* Occasional evening and/or weekend work is required.

LEE is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, programs, and operations. As part of that commitment, LEE will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If a reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application process, please contact staffing@wearelee.org

*LEE bases employment and promotional opportunities upon individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to ancestry, race, gender, pregnancy, age, color, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, religion, creed, marital status, disability, medical condition, political affiliation, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic established under law.*

d490778c30b67d60d4ce.title: Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator
d490778c30b67d60d4ce.description:
Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator

\*\*Residential Window Cleaning | Remote \*\*

About the Role

Mauka Cleaning Co. is a residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving homeowners on Oahu.

We are looking for a reliable, organized, phone-savvy \*\*Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator\*\* to manage the customer journey from first contact through booking, follow-up, service coordination, and reactivation.

This is not a passive data-entry position. Your work will directly impact our booked revenue, schedule utilization, customer satisfaction, and company growth.

You must be available to work \*\*9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time.\*\*

Your mission is simple:

\*\*Keep the schedule full, customers informed, technicians supported, and the back office organized.\*\*

---

Key Responsibilities:

1. Inbound Sales, Reactivations and Lead Follow-Up

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and email.

- Qualify leads and provide basic estimates using company pricing tools and guidelines.

- Move leads through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Follow up with open estimates and unbooked leads using approved follow-up sequences.

- Reactivate past customers and older leads using approved campaigns and offers.

- Contact flexible customers to fill schedule gaps and pull jobs forward.

- Identify appropriate add-on services and recurring maintenance opportunities.

- Maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps for every lead and customer.

- Ask for the sale confidently and professionally.

-Use Housecall Pro and Slack on the daily

2. Customer Experience and Service Coordination

- Answer customer questions about services, pricing, availability, and scheduling.

- Send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates.

- Handle reschedules and cancellations professionally.

- Backfill canceled openings using the active sales pipeline.

- Support technicians with access instructions, customer notes, and schedule changes.

- Handle customer complaints calmly and document each issue accurately.

- Coordinate approved touch-ups, go-backs, refunds, and service resolutions.

- Follow up with satisfied customers and request Google reviews.

- Protect the customer experience from booking through completed service.

3. Administrative Operations

- Send internal updates and reminders to the field team.

- Record special instructions, access information, and job notes.

- Track technician bonuses and commissions based on completed jobs and upsells.

- Plan and document yard sign routes for technicians.

- Process approved refunds and document them correctly.

- Set up and track customer payment plans when approved.

- Monitor overdue invoices and conduct polite follow-up calls and messages.

- Keep calendars, customer records, and internal systems accurate and current.

---

\*Success Metrics\*

Your performance will be measured by:

- Speed to lead

- Estimate-to-sale conversion rate

- Reactivation calls and bookings

- Booked revenue and gross profit

- Schedule utilization

- Customer response time

- Cancellation recovery rate

- Review requests and customer satisfaction

- Accuracy of CRM notes and administrative records

We care about results, not just activity.

---

Requirements:

- Strong spoken and written English.

- A natural, confident, and professional phone presence.

- Comfortable making and receiving a high volume of calls and messages. \*\*If the phone ringing makes you want to hide under your desk, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple customers, leads, jobs, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists, and documented processes consistently.

- Comfortable asking for the sale and requesting customer reviews.

- Comfortable using email, calendars, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

- Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Able to work from a quiet, professional environment with no loud background noises, interruptions, or distractions during working hours.

- Must have a reliable, high-speed internet connection capable of supporting phone calls, video meetings, CRM software, and multiple online systems.

- Reliable availability

- Must have a reliable laptop to use on the daily along with a headset/mic to take calls on

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with residential window cleaning or exterior cleaning.

- Experience with customer reactivation or estimate follow-up.

- Experience coordinating field technicians.

- Experience requesting online reviews.

- Experience handling payment follow-up or basic accounts receivable.

---

Who This Role Isn’t For

This role is \*\*not\*\* a good fit if you:

- Dislike talking on the phone or avoid making outbound calls.

- Need constant supervision to stay productive.

- Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple customers, leads, and tasks.

- Prefer doing things your own way instead of following proven scripts and processes.

- Get discouraged by follow-up, rejection, or customers who need multiple touchpoints before booking.

- Are uncomfortable asking for the sale or requesting customer reviews.

- Frequently miss deadlines, forget follow-ups, or leave CRM notes incomplete.

- Are only looking for a quiet data-entry position. This is a customer-facing, revenue-producing role.

- Have frequent background noise, interruptions, or an unreliable internet connection.

- Cannot reliably work the required schedule.

\*\*If your ideal workday involves avoiding the phone, hiding from follow-up, and hoping the schedule fills itself, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

---

Compensation

-Base pay starting at $16/hr, with growth opportunities.

- Performance bonuses tied to:

- Revenue sold and collected

- Completed upsells

- Service plans sold

- Reactivated customers

- Other agreed-upon performance targets

You will receive training on our systems, scripts, pricing guidelines, and processes.

The right person can grow into a \*Customer Experience & Sales Manager\* by proving they can independently own the customer journey and consistently produce results.

If you are organized, competitive, dependable, and enjoy helping customers while closing business, we want to hear from you.

Pay: From $16.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

afdd1d0b5d92c8fde2b1.description:
**Inside Sales & Sales Operations Coordinator**

**Job Type:** Part-Time (Approximately 30 hours per week)  
**Schedule:** Flexible, with potential to transition to full-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Remote  
**Locations:** Arizona, USA | Venezuela | Colombia | Philippines | South Africa

**About the Position**

We are seeking an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented **Inside Sales & Sales Operations Coordinator** to support our growing sales team.

This position will play an important role in ensuring the smooth execution of daily sales operations, assisting Account Managers, coordinating customer and vendor communications, maintaining CRM records, and supporting order and contract administration.

Our organization provides a broad range of technology solutions and services. Therefore, familiarity with the technology industry, including IT products, software, cloud solutions, licensing, and technology services, is highly desirable.

The ideal candidate is dependable, resourceful, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and interested in developing a long-term career in sales operations.

Initially, this position will be approximately 30 hours per week, with the potential to transition into a full-time role as the organization grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Account Manager Support**

* Provide administrative and operational support to multiple Account Managers.
* Coordinate customer follow-ups, meetings, and sales activities.
* Track sales opportunities and ensure timely follow-through.
* Assist with scheduling and coordinating customer communications.

**2. Sales Administration**

* Prepare customer quotes, proposals, and sales documentation.
* Draft professional customer correspondence.
* Maintain accurate sales records and documentation.
* Assist with the preparation of sales presentations and related materials.

**3. CRM & Odoo Management**

* Maintain and update customer information within the CRM.
* Manage sales opportunities, activities, and pipeline records.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry.
* Support the implementation and ongoing improvement of Odoo processes.

**4. Order Management**

* Process customer orders and coordinate vendor purchase orders.
* Monitor order status and delivery timelines.
* Coordinate product availability and fulfillment.
* Track customer renewals and recurring services.

**5. Vendor Coordination**

* Communicate with technology vendors and distributors.
* Request and compare pricing, quotes, and product availability.
* Coordinate software licensing and renewal requirements.
* Follow up on purchase orders and vendor-related requests.

**6. Contract Administration**

* Maintain customer agreements and related documentation.
* Monitor contract expiration dates and renewal deadlines.
* Track licensing agreements and recurring service commitments.
* Ensure records are properly organized and updated.

**7. Sales Operations & Reporting**

* Assist with sales performance reports and pipeline tracking.
* Support commission tracking and sales administration.
* Monitor outstanding opportunities and pending action items.
* Help improve internal sales workflows and administrative processes.

**8. Customer Support Coordination**

* Coordinate sales-related customer requests.
* Ensure inquiries and action items are directed to the appropriate team members.
* Monitor outstanding requests and follow up to ensure completion.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with customers and internal teams.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Previous experience in sales administration, inside sales, sales coordination, or sales support.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Experience working with CRM platforms and maintaining customer databases.
* Ability to manage multiple Account Managers and competing priorities.
* Strong follow-up, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience in the technology, IT services, or software industry.
* Familiarity with cloud solutions, software licensing, IT products, or technology services.
* Experience with Odoo ERP or CRM.
* Experience coordinating vendor relationships and purchase orders.
* Understanding of sales pipelines, renewals, and commission tracking.

**Compensation & Working Hours**

c5c28a0156d0494b52a6.description:
**What we will offer you:**  
**Culture:**  Join a supportive and inclusive work environment where collaboration, respect, and open communication are at the core of everything we do.
  
  
**Competitive Compensation:**  We offer a highly competitive compensation and total rewards package, ensuring that your hard work and dedication are recognized and rewarded accordingly.
  
  
**Flexibility:**  We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer various flexible schedules to help you manage your personal and professional commitments effectively.
  
  
**Technology:**  Work with state-of-the-art tools and technologies that empower you to excel in your role and stay at the forefront of industry trends.
  
  
**Employee Assistance Programs:**  We care about you! You and your family will have access to LYRA, an industry leading platform that provides comprehensive support and a myriad of resources to help support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being.
  
  
**Opportunity:**  A continuous focus on professional development with many opportunities for training and career growth.
  
  
**Safety Focused:**  We care about you and have developed a 24/7 safety mindset that is showcased throughout every facet of the organization.
  
  
As a Service Coordinator, you will be a part of a collaborative team that prioritizes customer satisfaction and operational excellence. Your expertise will support us in meeting our Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while providing input towards the continuous improvement of our processes and procedures.
  
  
The Service Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and optimizing field service operations to deliver a safe, efficient, and exceptional customer experience. Acting as the central link between customers, service technicians, and operational leadership, the Service Coordinator plans and schedules service work, manages service demand, monitors work execution, and proactively communicates with customers throughout the service journey.
  
  
This role is accountable for maximizing technician productivity, maintaining schedule integrity, reducing service delays, and ensuring timely completion of installations, repairs, compliance work, inspections, and emergency response activities. The Service Coordinator plays a key role in supporting Superior's commitment to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to improve service delivery, workforce utilization, and overall service performance.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**  

* Schedule, coordinate, and monitor service technician activities, including installations, maintenance, repairs, inspections, compliance work, and emergency service calls.
* Manage technician schedules to optimize workforce utilization, travel efficiency, customer responsiveness, and service productivity.
* Proactively maintain a forward-looking service schedule, identifying capacity constraints and recommending solutions to minimize backlog and service delays.
* Coordinate with customers to schedule appointments, confirm service details, and ensure readiness for scheduled work. Ensure technicians have the necessary information, materials, permits, and documentation required to complete assigned work efficiently.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for service-related customer inquiries, requests, and concerns.
* Build customer confidence through proactive communication, responsiveness, and effective issue resolution. Escalate service risks, capacity issues, and customer concerns that may impact safety, service delivery, or customer satisfaction.
* Create, update, and maintain work orders, customer records, service documentation, and scheduling systems. Monitor work order progress and track service completion to ensure commitments are met.
* Follow up on outstanding service requests and aging work orders to ensure timely resolution and backlog reduction.
* Monitor service performance metrics including schedule adherence, service lead times, technician utilization, work order completion, and customer commitments.
* Perform other job duties as assigned.

**What you bring:**  

* HS Diploma or GED
* 1+ year of industry experience or a related customer service experience required.
* Experience working in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities, competing demands, and deadlines.
* Experience using scheduling, dispatch, CRM, ERP, or field service management systems is preferred.
* Strong customer-centric mindset with a commitment to delivering an exceptional customer experience.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with customers, technicians, and internal stakeholders.
* Problem-solving, decision-making, and critical-thinking abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and data-entry systems.
* Ability to build and maintain positive relationships.
* Legal Authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future for this job opening.

The hourly rate for this position is $20.00 - $24.00 per hour.
  
This role will be eligible for overtime pay once scheduled work week hours are met.
  
  
Here at Superior Plus Propane, we are an equal opportunity employer committed to the inclusion and accommodation of all individuals, we welcome all qualified candidates to apply. If you have an accommodation need during the recruitment & selection process, we encourage you to connect with us at sppcareers@superiorpluspropane.comto let us know how we can enhance your experience.

3ed4db3b76c49ef297d3.description:
**Position Summary:**

You are the voice of the practice. You need to be able to handle patient’s needs with grace and efficiency ensuring accuracy at all levels of contact. **Contacts:**

b013168712ce72bacd33.title: CSE Purchasing and Payroll Specialist
b013168712ce72bacd33.description:
Required Qualifications:

* BA/BS or a combination of related education and work experience to equal four years
* Must be able to pass competency-based testing upon completion of training.
* Documented problem-solving, attention to detail, and customer service skills.
* Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Transactional experience in payroll, I9, or the J1/H1B visa application process in higher ed or similar industry
* Experience with payroll systems and complex payroll transaction processing.
* Experience working in higher education.
* Experience with the University’s HRMS to include appointment entry.
* Experience with University payroll and budgets for a variety of appointments and funding sources.
* Experience with 9-over-12 appointments.
* Experience with Pcard reconciliation OR requisition processing.
* Knowledge of University policies, procedures, and systems.
* Ability to be highly organized, detailed-oriented, and capable of handling multiple projects simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.

This is a temporary position for 1 year, with the possibility of extension depending on the needs of the college.  
  
This position is a part of the College of Science and Engineering’s Payroll and Purchasing Support Team, and duties will cover process management and coordination in both purchasing and payroll support as needed by the college.

In a purchasing capacity, this position may be responsible for receiving purchasing requests directly from employees within departments, ensuring the correct purchasing method is being used, corresponding with, and providing guidance to the requestor to resolve issues, and reviewing the request in terms of departmental and University policy and procedure before submitting the request to the University’s financial operations team for entry into the financial system. This position will also include tracking and monitoring the progress of system statuses to ensure compliance with departmental and University deadlines as needed.

As a payroll specialist, this role may work directly within CSE departments to manage their internal payroll tasks and is responsible for tasks such as payroll on-boarding for new employees, I9 coordination, visa requests, coordinating appointments for graduate students and fellowships for each term, and reviewing payroll data on a regular basis.
  
  
Breakdown of Duties:

Purchasing (15-85%, depending on assignment)

* Management and review of ePurch tickets to include:
  + Appropriate purchasing method
  + Completeness (chart-field string, justification, purchase details)
  + Appropriate approvals have been received
  + Additional required forms completion
* TDX “Order Goods and Services” ticket submission to request purchasing entry by the FinOps team
* Non-employee expense reimbursements, to include:
  + Collection of receipts and any needed forms and documentation with the reimbursee
  + Coordination of approvals with departmental accounting staff
* PCard purchases on behalf of end users, including recurring PCard payments (e.g. cell phone plans, subscriptions, etc.) and ad hoc, as appropriate
* Point of contact for unit staff requesting purchases, to include:
  + ePurch training
  + Issue resolution
  + Consultation for purchasing policy and procedure, and appropriate purchasing method
* Point of contact for FinOps purchasing staff, Tax Management office, OGC, and other University offices, as the need arises through the purchasing process
* Point of contact for department accountants regarding purchases
* Attendance at unit finance staff meetings
* Monitor “Manage Requisitions” to ensure budget check completion and address returned requisitions
* Inbox management for unit purchasing email address
* Receipt entry in EFS
* Assist with vendor set up and supplier document preparation
* Coordinate creation of IT software and hardware quotes with CSE-IT as needed
* ePurch training and navigation guidance
* Purchasing training for new faculty and staff
* PCard transaction status monitoring/reporting to ensure timely reconciliation by FinOps

Additionally, some units may require support in the following areas:

* Check deposits
* Ad hoc Chrome River Navigator support
* Annual training for graduate students
* Non-PO voucher request submission

Payroll (15-85%, depending on assignment)

* Appointment coordination within the department, including direct collaboration with supervisors, faculty, accountants, and other administrative staff to hire employees across all job families, and modify/manage payroll appointments
  + For graduate appointments, this includes coordination with accountants, GPCs, and other faculty to determine the appropriate job code and percent appointments, and ensuring offer letters are sent pursuant to the GLU-UE contract
  + For faculty summer appointments, this includes coordinating with faculty and accountants to determine their percent appointment and appropriate distributions each pay period
  + For fellowships, this includes coordination with accountants, faculty, external fellowship providers, and various offices at the University (IBAF, provost’s office,etc.) to determine appropriate fellowship placement
  + For staff hires, this includes coordinating with the employee and their supervisor to ensure personnel data is gathered and entered into the appropriate data management system
* Time and absence administration
* Payroll pre-confirmation report review
* Payroll verification report review
* Pay forms completion for: payroll updates, stop pay requests, overpayment corrections, and off-cycle check requests
* I9 verification
* TDX submission for the following ticket types to the University’s HR-Ops center for processing:
  + Hire
  + End of Appointment
  + Mass Changes
  + Modify an Appointment
  + Person of Interest and UNS Fellowship
  + Update inactivated/suspended appointment
* Coordination of merit entry process to include faculty payroll actions (e.g. sabbaticals, return from SWB, etc.)
* Serve as point of contact for general employment questions from employees and supervisors within the department
* Serve as a point of contact for the PEAK central-ops payroll specialists
* HR approval of TDX tickets submitted by payroll coordinators, to include a review of:
  + Hiring approval
  + Salary approval
  + Approval for special pay scenarios
  + Completed I9 verification
  + That any required departmental approvals/reviews have been completed
  + That any collegiate review/approvals have been completed (remote work approval, concurrent GA/Fellowship approval form)
* Time and absence updates and exception reporting
* Appointment entry audits
* Expected job end date management
* I9 management
* Reporting, clean-up, and general data management

Additionally, some units may require support in the following areas:

* Offer letter creation for “unit-recruited” appointments (including graduate students)
* Visa management (under discussion)
* “Internal Billing Authorization” (FA864) forms for UNS fellowships
* “Graduate Assistant Health Plan Department Authorization Form” (GHAP) for fellowships
* TDX submission for the following ticket types:
  + Post: Coordinate with unit admin, CSE-HR, and supervisors to request position postings
  + Payroll Accounting: Determine the need for, and request, distribution and retro-distribution updates
* Complete and submit internal CSE approval request forms (as they exist in the future state):
  + Salary approval
  + Hiring approval
  + Concurrent GA/Fellowship approval form
  + Remote work approval form
* Background check TDX form submission for employees who need background checks not covered during the recruiting process
* Scholarship uploads

Work environment:

* Hybrid, 3 days on the East Bank of the Twin Cities campus, 2 days work from home eligible.

Work Schedule:

* Monday-Friday
* 40 hours per week

Please note, this position is not eligible for H-1B or Green Card sponsorship. This position does not offer a STEM OPT training program.

bc64753b378532eecfb3.title: Human Resources Assistant
bc64753b378532eecfb3.description:
**Department:** Human Resources

  

**Position Summary:**

The HR Assistant provides administrative, coordination, and operational support across Human Resources and Talent Acquisition. Working closely with the VP HR Manager and VP of Talent Acquisition, this role ensures the smooth execution of daily HR operations, recruiting, onboarding, employee engagement events, HRIS administration and department projects. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Create and maintain electronic and hard-copy employee and new hire files.
* Monitor candidate background check statuses and assist with tracking.
* Coordinate and schedule candidate interviews across departments.
* Assist with new hire orientation setup, including room reservations, attendee scheduling, and packet preparation.
* Perform regular employee file audits using checklists, follow up on missing documents, and log records in tracking spreadsheets.
* Audit medical/BenePoints records across spreadsheets and the HRIS platform.
* Audit departmental invoices and follow up on audit/open enrollment discrepancies.
* Conduct data entry and produce standard or customized reports within the HRIS.
* Provide calendar management, meeting coordination, and administrative support to the HR Generalist and Talent Acquisition teams.
* Provide back-up support to the Senior Administrative Assistant for the Executive Partner of Human Resources as needed.
* Partner with the HR Coordinator to plan and execute company events, employee engagement programs, and recognition drives.
* Track participation and completion rates for required HR programs and activities.
* Update and maintain designated HR web pages and tracking spreadsheets.
* Handle sensitive employee and applicant information with strict confidentiality.
* Perform general office maintenance, including scanning, filing, shredding, archiving, and organizing HR storage areas.
* Support HR research initiatives and special projects as needed.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

  

**Competencies**:

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies to perform the essential functions of this position.

* Ability to work with and handle confidential information – the individual has a proven track record of handling sensitive employee, candidate, and compensation records with strict discretion and adherence to privacy standards.
* Detail orientated—the individual pays close attention to all the small particulars when working on a task or project
* Great follow up skills—the individual has demonstrated ability to pursue ongoing projects to keep tasks moving along to completion.
* Problem solving—the individual identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner and gathers and analyzes information skillfully
* Interpersonal Skills—the individual maintains confidentiality, remains open to others' ideas, and exhibits willingness to try new things.
* Written Communication—the individual edits work for spelling and grammar, presents numerical data effectively and can read and interpret written information.
* Quality control—the individual demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Adaptability—the individual adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and can deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
* Dependability—the individual is consistently at work and on time, follows instructions, responds to management direction, and solicits feedback to improve performance.
* Safety and security—the individual actively promotes and personally observes safety and security procedures, and uses equipment and materials properly.

  

*Salary for this position ranges from $28.75 - $33.53 per hour. The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.*

All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, nationality, age, disability (physical or mental), marital or domestic partnership or Civil Union status, pregnancy, family medical history or genetic information, atypical cellular or blood trait, military service or any other status protected by law.*

c67f127c81f5067e34cc.title: Operations Coordinator, Crisis Communications Practice
c67f127c81f5067e34cc.description:
**Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator, Crisis Communications Practice, supports the billing, financial tracking and administrative operations of the firm’s growing base of crisis communications clients. This individual will help keep a growing practice organized, ensure accurate and timely client billing and provide dependable support to the crisis practice leader and counselors.

**Billing administration**

* Coordinate the monthly billing process for client invoices, managing deadlines, required reviews and client-specific billing instructions.
* Review timesheets and preliminary invoices for accuracy and completeness, using Harvest and Asana to verify project information and identify discrepancies.
* Follow up with counselors to clarify time entries, resolve billing questions and obtain required invoice approvals.
* Prepare and customize invoices, incorporate approved revisions and distribute final invoices promptly. Final invoice approval remains with the practice leader.
* Maintain accurate billing records and reconcile preliminary billing information with invoices issued, documenting approved adjustments and resolving discrepancies.
* Coordinate billing information and administrative follow-up with the firm’s bookkeepers, who handle payment reconciliation.

**Financial tracking and reporting**

* Maintain practice billing trackers and prepare regular financial summaries for the crisis practice leader.
* Track time and fees against client arrangements and flag over-servicing, billing exceptions and other items requiring review.
* Help the practice leader monitor financial performance by keeping records current, checking data and following up on missing information.

**Practice and counselor support**

* Assist the crisis practice leader with scheduling, meeting preparation, administrative follow-through and organization of practice resources.
* Coordinate counselor travel and meeting logistics as needed.
* Maintain organized client and project records, including billing contacts, signed agreements and administrative documentation.
* Provide limited direct client support for administrative matters, including W-9 requests, invoice copies and follow-up on outstanding invoices or unsigned agreements.
* Handle sensitive client and firm information with professionalism and discretion.
* Identify practical improvements to billing and administrative workflows and help implement agreed changes.
* Coordinate with the firm’s office administrator as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

Pay: $45,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Glassboro, NJ 08028

e876a13c514cf99b71c8.title: School Operations & HR Support Specialist
e876a13c514cf99b71c8.description:
**Job Description:** School Operations & HR Support Specialist

**Reports To :** Head of Human Resources

**Status :** Full-Time, Non-Exempt

**Takes Direction From :** Executive Team, Strategic Leadership Team & Designated Departmental Supervisors

**Calendar :** Administrative Calendar

**Position Summary**

The School Operations & Organizational Support Specialist provides flexible administrative, operational, and organizational support across all A Step Up Academy (ASUA) campuses, programs, and departments. This position is designed to serve as a shared organizational resource, supporting the day-to-day functions, projects, and administrative needs of multiple departments based on organizational priorities.

While administratively assigned to the Human Resources Department, this position is not limited to HR responsibilities. The Specialist may be assigned to support Human Resources, School Services, School Operations, Training and Onboarding, Finance, Procurement, Technology, and other administrative or program-related functions as determined by organizational needs.

The position requires an individual who can transition effectively between departments, learn different systems and processes, and provide reliable support in a variety of settings. Assignments may be ongoing, temporary, project-based, or responsive to immediate operational needs.

The Specialist serves as an additional layer of organizational support, helping departments maintain continuity, address administrative demands, complete assigned projects, and ensure that essential processes are carried out accurately and efficiently.

The successful candidate must demonstrate flexibility, initiative, professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and a willingness to take on responsibilities that may change from day to day. The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt to the needs of a growing and evolving organization is essential.

**Qualifications**

*Education & Experience*

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Education, Organizational Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum of two years of experience in administrative support, operations, education, human resources, customer service, or related organizational functions preferred.
* Experience working in an educational, nonprofit, healthcare, human services, or other highly regulated environment preferred.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, supervisors, or operational functions preferred.
* Familiarity with administrative systems, employee management systems, and digital recordkeeping platforms preferred.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and related administrative technologies.
* Willingness and ability to learn additional organizational systems, processes, and software as assignments require.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

***Organizational & Cross-Departmental Support***

* Provide administrative and operational support to departments and organizational functions as assigned.
* Serve as a flexible resource to address staffing gaps, temporary administrative needs, special projects, and fluctuations in departmental workloads.
* Assist with daily administrative responsibilities, including scheduling, correspondence, document preparation, data entry, recordkeeping, and communication.
* Support department leaders and designated supervisors with assigned projects, operational tasks, and organizational initiatives.
* Transition between departments and assignments while maintaining accuracy, productivity, and professionalism.
* Learn and follow department-specific procedures, systems, expectations, and confidentiality requirements.
* Assist with the implementation and maintenance of organizational processes and administrative workflows.
* Identify operational challenges and communicate opportunities for improved efficiency to the appropriate supervisor.
* Provide support across ASUA campuses and administrative locations based on organizational needs.

***Human Resources & Employee Support***

* Assist with onboarding documentation, employee clearances, personnel records, and new hire readiness.
* Provide administrative support for employee transactions, status changes, record updates, and offboarding processes.
* Assist employees with general administrative questions, forms, systems, and established HR procedures.
* Support HR communication, scheduling, documentation, compliance tracking, and departmental projects.
* Assist with the coordination of employee meetings, training requirements, and assigned follow-up activities.
* Provide onsite HR administrative support at school locations when assigned.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information and refer matters requiring HR interpretation or decision-making to authorized HR personnel.
* Support additional HR functions as directed by the Head of Human Resources or designated HR team members.

***School Services & Campus Administrative Support***

* Provide administrative assistance to School Services personnel and school leadership as assigned.
* Assist with student-related administrative processes, records, communications, and documentation within authorized responsibilities.
* Support the organization, tracking, and maintenance of school-related forms, records, and operational information.
* Assist with parent, guardian, transportation provider, and external stakeholder communications as directed.
* Provide administrative coverage or additional support during periods of increased activity, staff absences, or operational transitions.
* Assist with the coordination of school meetings, events, scheduling, and campus-based administrative activities.

3a637559eb08f687d6f7.title: Jr. Talent Acquisition Specialist (Contract)
3a637559eb08f687d6f7.description:
**Company Overview**

  

JGM is a national, self-perform industrial contractor and structural steel fabricator, built to take on the fast-track, high-complexity projects other companies turn away. Founded in 2001 and still family-led today, JGM operates AISC- and ASME-certified fabrication shops in Coatesville and Sinking Spring, PA, plus a national Construction Services team performing erection, rigging, hauling, and industrial construction for Fortune 500 clients across power generation, pharmaceutical, mining, steel and metals, infrastructure, and manufacturing.

We don't subcontract our workforce. We build it, direct-hire, from the shop floor to the field to the front office. Safety comes first in every role at JGM, not just on the job site, because taking care of our people is something we'll never compromise on. With real apprenticeship and leadership programs behind every role, JGM offers more than a job: it's a career with a company where family is our foundation and whatever it takes is how we get it done.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

Due to several large projects spanning our shop and field teams JGM is looking for a temporary Talent Acquisition Specialist to own the front end of our skilled-trades hiring pipeline — ironworkers, welders, fitters, laborers, and related field and shop roles. This role is the first real conversation a candidate has with JGM: you'll prescreen applicants against a standardized question set, confirm safety and compliance readiness, and package clean, consistent summaries that our experienced recruiters and hiring managers use to make the final hiring decision. Once a candidate is selected, you'll also handle the offer process and get their information into our systems correctly the first time.

***This is a 5 day a week, in office role, in Coatesville PA estimated through mid-March, with lunch provided very other Friday.***

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Candidate Prescreening:** Conduct structured phone/video prescreens for trades applicants using JGM's standardized question set for each role (ironworker, welder, fitter, laborer, etc.), covering certifications, experience, availability, pay expectations, and work eligibility. Must e comfortable contacting 20-30 candidates a day. This is not a "post and pray" recruiting role. The candidate flow is constant but is constantly moving so high-volume calling is critical to success in the role
* **Safety Questionnaire:** Send the safety questionnaire to every qualified candidate early in the process, track completion, and flag any responses that raise safety, compliance, or fit concerns before the candidate advances.
* **Prescreen Summaries:** Write clear, consistent prescreen summaries for each candidate — highlighting certifications, experience, safety questionnaire results, and any red flags — and route them to experienced recruiters and hiring managers so they can make an informed hiring decision quickly.
* **Offer Process:** Prepare and extend verbal and written offers once a hiring decision is made, coordinate start dates and pay/benefits details with the hiring manager and follow up until the offer is accepted or declined.
* **Resume & Data Entry:** Enter candidate resumes, prescreen notes, and offer status into the applicant tracking system (BambooHR) accurately and on the same day they're received, so the pipeline stays current for the whole team.
* **Candidate Experience:** Keep candidates informed and engaged at every step — timely responses, clear next steps, and professionalism — even for candidates who aren't moving forward.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with experienced recruiters and hiring managers to keep the standardized question sets and safety questionnaire current as role requirements evolve.
* **Reporting:** Tracks prescreen volume, pass-through rates, and time-to-summary, and report on pipeline health to the recruiting team.
* **Training:** Manage candidate training assignments and follow up through completion of OSHA 10 and all required Safety Skills training.
* **Pre-employment:** Manage candidate background checks and coordinate required drug screenings.
* Additional administrative projects as needed.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* !+ years in a customer focused role required. High outbound volume phone call experience is strongly preferred
* 1–2+ years of recruiting, HR coordination, or high-volume phone screening experience; experience with skilled trades or industrial/construction hiring a plus.
* Comfortable asking structured, consistent questions and accurately capturing candidate responses.
* Bilingual (Spanish) preferred.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (BambooHR or similar) preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to write a clean, objective summary that a recruiter can act on quickly.
* Proficient in use of Microsoft Suite
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; able to manage a high volume of candidates moving through the pipeline at once.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  

***You will learn more in months vs years at other companies, as you will be working with a team that will teach you, encourage you and challenge you to earn as you learn.***

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* General office environment conditions.

Job Duties:

* Within 24 hours of admission, ensure that resident’s face sheet is complete and accurately reflecting PHI contacts, independent travel privileges, motorized wheelchair use, alerts and escort communications.

* Learn, implement and monitor AMS methods; actively participate in AMS by attending Huddle board meetings and utlizing AMS concepts and tools for problem solving, work/process improvements and creating standard of work.

d97a16adc6f2a5975b4c.title: Patient Care Coordinator
d97a16adc6f2a5975b4c.description:
**Do you have 5 years plus of medical office experience and want to join an organization that values your dedication to patient care, recognizes your expertise, and supports your professional growth and long-term success? If so, we encourage you to apply today and learn more about joining our team in Philadelphia and Media PA .**

  

As a Patient Care Coordinator (PCC), you will be the welcoming face of our clinic, creating exceptional experiences for every patient who walks through our doors. In this role, you will oversee daily clinic operations, build strong patient relationships, understand and address patients' hearing healthcare needs, and help ensure the continued success and growth of the practice.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* Greet and screen patients to determine how we can best support them
* Answer questions about services and promotions
* Spot potential leads and keep patient flow running smoothly
* Manage scheduling, daily office tasks, and financial and administrative duties
* Handle insurance verification, inventory, and patient records
* Partner with clinic and home office teams to support operations
* Assist with marketing efforts, events, outreach, and patient retention activities

**Who Thrives in This Role**

* Eager learners whose career is centered around working in a medical practice
* Strong multi-taskers with solid problem-solving skills
* Punctual, reliable professionals
* Individuals who genuinely love helping others in the medical industry while running a thriving practice

**Why It’s Rewarding**

You’re not just managing an office, you’re making a meaningful difference by helping patients feel supported, understood, and cared for throughout their journey to better hearing health.

**Job Type:** Full Time 32 - 40 hours a week, 8:30 am - 4:30 pm, No Weekends

  

**Location:** Philadelphia and Media, PA. Must be able to commute to both clinics

  

**Compensation**: $19.00 - $22.00 an hour. - Higher compensation reflects the candidate's availability and willingness to travel to a 3rd location ( Cherry Hill, NJ ) one day per week.

* Pay is commensurate with experience and qualifications
* Monthly Bonus Opportunities

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Provide the first contact for patients who call or come in to schedule an appointment or inquire about our services.
* Screen calls, identify better hearing candidates and facilitate excellent service by providing the information necessary to secure an appointment.
* Schedule and confirm appointments and conduct outbound retention calls to patients.
* Coordinate provider’s schedule and ensure the smooth and efficient flow of patient care while in the office.
* Check patients in and out, collect and record payments, track revenue and accounting activities to include: end of day close, bank deposits, posting of charges, entering invoices, payments and insurance claim processing.
* Maintain all daily, weekly and monthly reports and tracking documents. Respond to home office requests in a timely manner.
* Verify patient information, billing/insurance data, collect and process documentation and maintain patient charts to include the filing of all patient records.
* Work with insurance and workers compensation agencies to facilitate authorizations and benefit verification.
* Responsible for a variety of administrative tasks such as typing, filing, office supply inventory, and mail.
* Verify the status of and checking in hearing aids and repairs and track/maintain product inventory.
* Work with the hearing care provider on grassroots marketing efforts that may include compiling physician packets, coordinating educational seminars, and sending recall letters.
* Track marketing calls and inquiries from initial contact through the point of sale
* Responsible to open and close the office on a daily basis and ensure the reception area is well maintained.
* Training support for other location front office staff, as may be appropriate.

**Education and Experience Requirements**:

* A minimum of 5 years of medical office management experience
* Experience with front desk in the hearing industry is a plus
* High school diploma or equivalent (GED)

  

**Required Skills:**

* Strong computer skills
* Experience with word processing and database software.
* Excellent interpersonal skills that allow effective working relationships with a diverse, patient, colleague, and vendor population. This includes listening, sales and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Basic understanding of accounting procedures and good math aptitude.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks within strict deadlines.
* Ability to input and track sales revenues and balance accounts daily and monthly.
* Detail oriented.
* Front desk medical experience required.

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to handle a busy office with interruptions, calls, walk-ins and direct the flow of the office with efficiency and grace.
* Must be able to pick up after an interruption to complete tasks that require focus.
* Must be able to lift boxes up to 20 pounds.

  

**Benefits**

We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package which includes:

* 401(k) with matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance -employer paid

* Hospital Indemnity
* STD & LTD
