ddc3306f87043e705bb8.title: Consult Coordinator I
ddc3306f87043e705bb8.description:
Posted Rate is for Consult Coordinator I. Experienced Consult Coordinators may be eligible for higher rates for II and III position levels.

#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Consult Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation, guiding them through the intake and pre-consultation stage of gender-affirming surgery. This role reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the Consult Coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position and does not involve clinical assessment, medical advice, or medical decision-making.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Review intake packets and referral submissions for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The Consult Coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Accurately document patient communication, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and practice policies, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

The essential functions listed are intended to describe the fundamental duties of the position. A qualified individual must be able to perform these functions with or without reasonable accommodation. The organization will engage in a timely, good-faith interactive process when an accommodation is requested or the need for accommodation is known.

#### **MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience may be considered.
* Experience: Experience in patient intake, patient coordination, healthcare administration, medical records, customer service, scheduling, or a similar patientfacing administrative role.
* Licensure/Certification: No specific license or certification required unless assigned by the organization.
* Knowledge/Skills: Strong written and verbal communication; ability to explain processes and documentation requirements clearly; strong attention to detail when reviewing documents for completeness and accuracy; strong organization and followthrough; ability to manage a high volume of inquiries and competing priorities; accurate documentation; comfort using electronic systems, email, phones, and practicemanagement tools; ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Other: Ability to provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support to patients and to comply with HIPAA, privacy, security, and organizational policies.

#### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in newpatient intake, referral coordination, or consultation scheduling in a medical office, surgical practice, or specialty care setting.
* Familiarity with insurance eligibility, referral and authorization requirements, financial counseling, or medical records request workflows.
* Familiarity with documentation commonly required for genderaffirming surgery, such as letters of support aligned with WPATH Standards of Care and payer criteria.
* Experience supporting transgender, nonbinary, or genderdiverse patients in a healthcare or communityservice setting.
* Experience using electronic health record, practicemanagement, CRM, or tasktracking systems.
* Bilingual or multilingual communication skills aligned with patient population needs.

#### **WORK SCHEDULE, LOCATION, AND TRAVEL**

* Schedule: MondayFriday, 7:30 a.m.4:30 p.m. Pacific, with flexibility as needed to meet patientservice, scheduling, and operational needs. Overtime must be approved in accordance with organizational policy.
* Location: Remote position. Regular availability during business hours is an essential function because the role supports timely response to new patient inquiries and coordination across departments.
* Travel: None or occasional local travel, if assigned for meetings, training, or operational support.

353bcd287161a3db128a.title: Assistant Construction Project Manager
353bcd287161a3db128a.description:
***FULL-TIME, ON-SITE POSITION — MEDIA, PA***

***Residential construction or skilled-trades experience required. This is not a remote, hybrid, IT, or software project management position.***

**Chimney Cricket** is a full-service chimney, fireplace, and hearth company serving homeowners throughout the greater Philadelphia region. Our work includes chimney restoration and masonry, fireplace installation, venting systems, gas and wood appliances, and other residential construction and home-service projects.

We are looking for an experienced **Project Operations Coordinator** to coordinate residential fireplace and hearth restoration and installation projects from approval through completion.

**This is not an entry-level administrative project coordinator position. We are specifically looking for someone with experience coordinating construction, remodeling, trades, or field-service projects.** The right candidate understands what it takes to move a physical project from a sold scope of work to a completed job—including scheduling crews, reviewing job requirements, coordinating materials and equipment, working with vendors, communicating with customers, and working with field techs to solve problems when conditions change.

The Project Operations Coordinator works closely with our Operations Manager, sales team, technicians, installers, vendors, and customers to make sure every project is properly prepared before a crew arrives and stays on track through completion.

**Construction Project Coordination**

You will manage the operational side of multiple active residential construction and installation projects. This requires understanding project scope, anticipating what crews need to complete the work, and identifying potential problems before they affect the schedule.

* Manage projects from sales approval through completion and closeout
* Review scopes of work, estimates, job documentation, photos, measurements, and project requirements
* Coordinate project readiness, deposits, scheduling, materials, equipment, and crew requirements
* Maintain communication between sales, customers, field crews, vendors, and management
* Track multiple active projects and proactively identify scheduling, material, or job-readiness issues
* Coordinate changes or unexpected field conditions that affect project execution
* Visit active job sites to review progress, quality, project conditions, customer satisfaction, and crew needs
* Help ensure crews arrive with the information, materials, equipment, and preparation necessary to complete the project successfully

**Project Administration & Closeout**

Strong documentation matters, but this position requires more than simply maintaining paperwork. You will use project documentation to understand what is happening in the field and help keep projects moving.

* Review technician paperwork, job notes, photos, and project documentation
* Monitor project labor and technician timesheets
* Ensure required project documentation is complete and accurate
* Track outstanding project items and follow them through resolution
* Coordinate project completion, closeout, and handoff to billing

**Purchasing & Material Coordination**

Construction experience is particularly valuable in this area. Our projects may require appliances, venting components, masonry materials, fabricated products, specialty parts, and other job-specific materials.

* Review project material and equipment requirements
* Order materials, venting, equipment, and specialty components
* Coordinate purchasing with manufacturers, distributors, and local suppliers
* Track purchase orders, lead times, backorders, and delivery dates
* Verify orders for accuracy before projects are staged
* Identify material issues that could affect project schedules
* Maintain organized purchasing and project records

**Safety Program Coordination**

Safety is one of Chimney Cricket's core values. This position also supports the Operations Manager in coordinating and maintaining our company safety program.

* Maintain company safety documentation, incident records, and OSHA logs
* Coordinate safety meetings, training sessions, and toolbox talks
* Track employee safety certifications and training requirements
* Maintain SDS, equipment, and other required safety documentation
* Assist with incident documentation and coordination with outside safety consultants

**Required Qualifications**

* **Minimum 2 years of experience coordinating residential construction, remodeling, installation, or skilled-trade field projects. Experience exclusively in IT, software, or corporate project management does not meet this requirement.**
* Experience coordinating **multiple active field projects** involving crews, schedules, materials, customers, vendors, and changing job-site conditions
* Working understanding of how residential construction or skilled-trade projects move from estimate/sale through planning, procurement, field execution, and completion
* Experience reviewing scopes of work, job documentation, material requirements, and project schedules
* Ability to anticipate project needs and identify missing information, materials, or job-readiness issues before sending a crew
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
* Confident communication with homeowners, field technicians, vendors, salespeople, and management
* Comfortable visiting active residential construction/job sites
* Proficient with business software, project-management systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred:

* Residential construction or remodeling
* HVAC
* Roofing
* Chimney, fireplace, or masonry
* Plumbing
* Electrical
* General contracting
* Specialty trades or home services

Additional preferred experience includes:

* Construction purchasing and material procurement
* Coordinating subcontractors and field crews
* Inventory or warehouse coordination
* Reading construction scopes, plans, specifications, or manufacturer documentation
* OSHA documentation, safety programs, or construction safety compliance

**Who Will Be Successful in This Role**

This position is a good fit for someone who has worked around construction projects long enough to understand that **the plan on paper and what happens in the field aren't always the same thing**.

You should be comfortable looking at a project and asking questions such as: Do we have everything the crew needs? Are the materials correct? Is the site actually ready? Are there access or scheduling issues? Is something missing from the scope? Does the customer understand what is happening? What could prevent us from completing this job as scheduled?

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply track problems after they happen—we want someone who **anticipates them and helps solve them before they affect the project.**

**Our Core Values**

* **RESPECT** – We are prepared, on time, and treat people right.
* **INTEGRITY** – We do what we say and own the outcome.
* **SAFETY** – We protect people, property, and the reputation of our company.
* **EXCELLENCE** – We pursue quality outcomes and continuous improvement.

At **Money Honey Financial**, we believe great financial service should feel personal, approachable, and empowering.

We're a growing, woman-owned accounting firm helping individuals and business owners navigate taxes, bookkeeping, and financial decisions with confidence. We take our work seriously, but we believe the experience of working with an accountant should feel anything but intimidating.

We're building something special, and we're looking for the right person to grow with us.

You'll be the friendly voice, organized mind, and dependable presence that helps keep our clients informed, supported, and confident throughout their experience with Money Honey.

From welcoming new clients to coordinating tax appointments and keeping important documents moving, you'll play a key role in ensuring our clients receive the exceptional service they deserve.

**This isn't a tax preparation position.** Instead, you'll work alongside our accountants and bookkeepers, helping create the seamless experience that allows our entire team to do its best work.

And because we're a growing firm, you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, improve processes, take ownership of projects, and grow professionally.

* Be a welcoming and professional first point of contact for clients by phone, email, and in person.

* Coordinate administrative aspects of client offboarding and transitions.

**Support our tax and bookkeeping operations**

* Prepare and coordinate administrative tax forms, including IRS authorization forms.
* Assist with IRS and state correspondence, document submissions, and tracking notices.
* Monitor administrative deadlines and keep the team informed of outstanding items.

**Help us create the Money Honey experience**

* Coordinate thoughtful client appreciation initiatives, including holiday gifts and special milestones.
* Identify opportunities to make our client communications and processes even better.
* Collaborate with our team to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
* Bring fresh ideas, positive energy, and a solutions-oriented mindset to the office.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

We're looking for someone who does more than complete a to-do list. Our ideal candidate takes ownership, anticipates needs, and finds satisfaction in keeping people and processes organized.

* Communicate professionally and warmly, even when handling difficult conversations.

* Have strong attention to detail and take pride in getting things right.
* Enjoy creating systems, improving processes, and finding more efficient ways to work.

**You don't need to know everything about taxes or accounting to succeed here.** We're happy to train someone who brings the right attitude, strong organizational skills, and a genuine commitment to client service.

Why Join Money Honey Financial?

We're not your traditional accounting firm, and that's intentional.

We're creating a workplace where professionalism meets personality, clients feel like people rather than numbers, and team members have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Here's what you can look forward to:**

* **Stability:** A permanent, year-round position with a growing firm.
* **Meaningful work:** You'll play an important role in helping entrepreneurs and individuals feel more confident about their finances.
* **A supportive team:** Work alongside a collaborative group that values communication, accountability, and helping one another succeed.
* **Professional development:** Receive hands-on training in our systems, processes, and accounting firm operations.
* **Room to grow:** As our firm expands, we want our team members to have opportunities to expand their skills and responsibilities.
* **A workplace with personality:** We believe you can deliver exceptional professional service while still being approachable, authentic, and human.

**Ready to Grow With Us?**

If you're organized, people-focused, proactive, and excited about joining a growing business where your work truly matters, we'd love to meet you.

**Come help us deliver the Money Honey experience.**

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

117347cd9bcdf4a6e0ad.description:
Description:

**ABOUT VISANTE**

We are relentless in solving the most complex challenges in health system pharmacy—designing **pharmacy footprints that meet our clients where they are today and position them to win tomorrow**. Our work delivers measurable financial gains, operational excellence, and an elevated patient experience.

We set ambitious goals, move with urgency, and create extraordinary value. Obsessed with client impact, we thrive in a collaborative, innovative culture where deep expertise turns insight into action. We’re proud of the results we deliver and the trust we earn—fueling sustained growth and exceptional client satisfaction.

**Our mission is to transform healthcare through pharmacy, and our vision is to reimagine pharmacy to improve lives.**

**ABOUT THE POSITION (Fully Remote)**

The Supervisor, Medication Access Specialist - Medical Benefit is a key member of Visante's managed services team and is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of medication access specialists supporting medical benefit services. Reporting to Visante leadership, the supervisor provides direct oversight of team members, including scheduling, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance management, and professional development to ensure a high-performing and engaged workforce.

This position serves as a subject matter expert in medical benefit access and reimbursement, benefits investigations, prior authorizations, coverage denials, patient assistance programs, and financial assistance resources. The supervisor provides guidance and support for complex patient access cases, escalated authorization requests, payer policy interpretation, and reimbursement challenges while promoting timely access to therapy.

Collaboration is critical to this role, as the supervisor works closely with clients, pharmacists, providers, clinic personnel, pharmacies, payers, and Visante team members to enhance operational workflows, improve patient access, and support successful treatment initiation. The supervisor monitors key performance indicators, quality outcomes, and operational trends to drive continuous improvement and maintain service excellence.

This role requires strong leadership abilities, expertise in medication reimbursement and medical benefit processes, excellent communication skills, and a commitment to advancing patient care through improved medication access and operational efficiency.

**Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily operations and staffing for assigned teams to ensure adequate resources meet client needs and project demands.
* Adjust staff schedules and address workflow gaps to maintain operational efficiency and service continuity.
* Assist with recruit, hire, evaluate, and retain personnel to support a high-performing and engaged team.
* Proactively address personnel issues and establish clear expectations for performance and workplace behavior.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and professional development to enhance staff success, accountability, and job satisfaction.
* Coordinate training initiatives, competency assessments, and quality review activities to strengthen team capabilities.
* Respond to client inquiries and triage requests promptly to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Monitor key performance indicators related to patient access, productivity, satisfaction, and workflow efficiency, implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure compliance with healthcare regulations, privacy requirements, and organizational policies, including completion of employee competencies.
* Review medication authorizations and determine appropriate actions based on patient, payer, and client needs.
* Conduct benefits investigations, assess coverage and out-of-pocket costs, and identify financial assistance options to reduce patient burden.
* Collaborate with clinics to obtain required documentation, submit prior authorizations, and support appeals for coverage denials.
* Communicate authorization determinations and next steps to patients, including coverage outcomes, financial assistance options, and pharmacy access pathways.
* Ensure accurate and timely documentation within client EMR systems and Visante tracking platforms in accordance with agreed-upon workflows.
* Support client onboarding, training, workflow optimization, and continuous process improvement while collaborating with Visante leadership and team members.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

**Education**

**Required:** High school diploma or equivalent

**Preferred:** An Associate Degree

**Experience**

**Required:** 3 years of experience working within healthcare or with pharmacy providers on medication access

**Preferred:** Minimum of 1 year experience supervising or managing a team, including staff scheduling, performance management, and professional development.

**Licensure**

**Required:** State Board of Pharmacy Technician registration obtained within 6 months of hire

**Preferred:** Active CPhT certification through either PTCB or NHA

**Skills and Abilities**

* Demonstration of good judgment, multi-tasking and meeting deadlines with a sense of urgency, and being able to prioritize
* Exhibits good judgment and ability to multi-task, prioritize, and meet deadlines with a sense of urgency in the face of competing demands.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and ability to cultivate strong client relationships.
* Proven analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Clear and concise communication, ensuring transparency within the team.
* Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.
* Possesses extensive knowledge of medication reimbursement and healthcare prior authorization/coding.
* Proficiency in Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Analyzes and disseminates information effectively, showcasing strong analytical skills.
* Excellent conflict resolution skills, fostering a positive team environment.
* Strong leadership skills, supervising a high-performing team, and fostering a culture of accountability.
* High attention to detail, ensuring thoroughness and efficiency in team deliverables.

**Compensation and Benefits:** ***We offer competitive salary and benefits for this full-time salaried role.***

Visante is, therefore, committed to maintaining an environment free of discrimination, harassment, and violence. This means there can be no deference because of age, religion or creed, gender, gender identity or expression, race, color, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws and regulations

**About Sagility**
------------------

Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

**Job title:**

Remote Customer Service Representative (Healthcare)

**Job Description:**

**Work From Home | Healthcare Coverage Review Representative**
==============================================================

**Build Your Career in Healthcare, From the Comfort of Home!**
--------------------------------------------------------------

  
  

**Are you passionate about helping others, solving problems, and making a difference in healthcare? Your next career opportunity could be with Sagility!**

  
  

At Sagility, we believe every interaction is an opportunity to make healthcare simpler, more accessible, and more personal. We're looking for motivated, detail-oriented professionals with healthcare and customer service experience to join our growing team of **Coverage Review Representatives**.

In this role, you'll help members, healthcare providers, and medical offices navigate prescription medication coverage, understand benefits, and obtain important information about prior authorizations.

  
  

If you enjoy helping people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to build your career with a healthcare industry leader, **we want to hear from you!**

  
  

**What Makes This Opportunity Great?**
--------------------------------------

* **100% Remote:** Work from home in an eligible U.S. location.
* **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week!
* **Competitive Compensation:** Earn $16.00 per hour during training and nesting, increasing to $16.50 per hour once in production.
* **Earn More During Training:** Qualify for performance incentives of up to an additional $2.00 per hour during training and nesting, bringing your potential earnings to **$18.00 per hour!**
* **Paid Training:** Receive two weeks of structured training followed by two weeks of supported, hands-on nesting.
* **Meaningful Work:** Help patients and healthcare providers navigate important medication coverage decisions.
* **Career Development:** Gain valuable experience in healthcare operations, pharmacy benefits, and coverage review.

*Performance incentives are based on meeting established quality, accuracy, attendance, and schedule adherence requirements. Additional details will be provided during training.*

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a Coverage Review Representative, you'll serve as a trusted resource for members, healthcare providers, and other healthcare professionals seeking information about prescription medication coverage.

Your daily responsibilities will include:

* Answer inbound calls from members, physicians' offices, and healthcare partners regarding prescription medication benefits and coverage.
* Verify member eligibility and determine medication coverage under applicable healthcare plans.
* Assist callers with understanding medication coverage options and prior authorization requirements.
* Provide updates on prior authorization requests and coordinate with appropriate departments.
* Review medication inquiries, documentation, and requests for additional information.
* Contact healthcare providers to obtain necessary information and support timely resolution.
* Accurately document interactions, update records, and enter information into multiple systems.
* Deliver professional, compassionate, and accurate customer service while meeting established quality and performance expectations.
  

  

**Your attention to detail and commitment to service will help make a meaningful difference in the healthcare experience.**

**What You'll Bring to the Team**
---------------------------------

  
  

We're looking for individuals who are dependable, adaptable, comfortable with technology, and committed to delivering exceptional service.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* At least 6 months of call center experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in healthcare, medical claims, or medical administration.
* At least 1 year of recent continuous employment with a previous employer.
* Working knowledge of medical and healthcare terminology.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent computer navigation, keyboarding, and data entry skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  

  

**Your Work Schedule & Training**
---------------------------------

  
  

**Business Hours:** MondayâFriday, 7:00 AMâ8:00 PM Central Time. Candidates must be available to work an assigned schedule within these hours.

**Training Schedule:** MondayâFriday, 7:30 AMâ4:00 PM Central Time.

**Training Program:**

* 2 weeks of instructor-led training.
* 2 weeks of supported nesting to help you transition into production.

**Important:** Full attendance is required during training, and candidates must commit to no planned time off during their first 90 days of employment.

  
  

**Work From Home Requirements**
-------------------------------

To be successful in this remote position, you'll need a dedicated, secure workspace and reliable technology.

**Internet Requirements:**

* Reliable, hardwired internet connection.
* Internet speeds exceeding 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.
* Ethernet connection required; Wi-Fi and mobile hotspots are not permitted.

**Equipment You Will Provide:**

* Monitor measuring 19 inches or larger with VGA or HDMI connectivity and the corresponding cable.
* USB wired mouse.
* Ethernet cable long enough to connect directly to your modem or router.
* Optional USB wired keyboard.

**Equipment Sagility Provides:**

* Workstation (laptop, desktop, or USB boot device, as applicable).
* USB webcam for the BHIVE platform.
* 4-port USB hub.
* USB wired headset with microphone.
  

  

**Our Virtual Workplace, BHIVE**

This position uses BHIVE, a virtual workplace platform designed to support remote team collaboration, communication, productivity, and time tracking.

BHIVE requires an active webcam positioned to provide a continuous profile view of your workspace, including your monitors, keyboard, head, shoulders, and hands throughout the workday.

Candidates must be comfortable working in this camera-enabled virtual environment.

  
  

**Ready to Make Your Next Career Move?**
----------------------------------------

**Your healthcare experience matters. Put it to work in a role where you can help others, develop valuable skills, and grow professionally all while working from home!**

  
  

**Don't wait for the perfect opportunity to find you. Take the next step toward your future with Sagility today!**

### **About Sagility**

Sagility is a leading healthcare business process management services provider dedicated to improving the experiences of healthcare members, patients, and providers.

By combining healthcare industry expertise, innovative technology, and compassionate service, we help our clients deliver better healthcare experiences.

At Sagility, our people make the difference. Join a team where your skills, dedication, and commitment to helping others can create a lasting impact.

  
  

**Your next chapter starts here. Apply today!**

  
  

**Sagility is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disability.**

  
  

**Location:**

United States of America

* Based on location, may perform scheduling, arrival, check-in, and applicable prescreening procedures.
* Based on location, may provide information and obtain signatures as required by regulatory agencies while in compliance with federal and state regulations as well as other accrediting bodies.
* Based on location, may perform document imaging.
* Based on location, may collect and post payments.
* Based on location and within established guidelines, determine the necessity for immediate attention and conditions of an emergent nature.
* Perform other duties as assigned. These may include but are not limited to maintaining a current knowledge base of department processes, protocols, and procedures; pursuing self-directed learning and continuing education opportunities; participating on committees, task forces, and work groups as determined by leadership.

4ff0f131b0a61515731e.title: Outreach and Claims Specialist - Remote/Hybrid Working Arrangements
4ff0f131b0a61515731e.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

**Please Note: The employment list from this posting will be used to fill other similarly situated positions in this class.**

**About the Colorado Department of State Treasury**  
The Colorado State Treasury is the constitutional custodian of the public's funds. The Treasury has to manage and account for tax dollars from when they are received until they are disbursed. The treasury staff is committed to safeguarding and managing the people's monies with the same diligence and care as they do their own.

**Vision**  
The Colorado State Treasury staff will continually strive to serve the residents of Colorado better. Central to this goal is the continued introduction and use of new technologies to provide improved access to services for both taxpayers and other Governmental agencies.

**Mission**  
Our mission is to safeguard, manage, and account for tax dollars from when they are received until they are disbursed with diligence and care.

**Why work for the Colorado Department of State Treasury?**
  
We are a values-driven organization committed to accountability, agility, collaboration, and respect.

We believe in outstanding customer service, an inclusive culture, continuous process improvement, and our role as a trusted and strategic partner. Recognizing that knowledgeable employees drive our success, we seek dedicated individuals who exhibit our shared values and passion for quality and excellence in all we do. In addition, we offer a great location and great benefits, which include:

* Medical and dental plans
* Strong, secure, yet flexible retirement plans including PERA Defined Benefit Plan or PERA Defined Contribution Plan plus pre-tax and ROTH 401K, and 457 plans
* Employee wellness programs
* Paid life insurance
* Short and long-term disability coverage
* Flexible work schedule and remote-work options
* No cost Eco Pass for all eligible State employees
* 11 paid holidays per year plus vacation and sick leave
* Some positions may qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. For more information go to https://dhr.colorado.gov/dhr-resources/student-loan-forgiveness-programs
* Training opportunities
* Variety of discounts on services and products available through the State of Colorado's Work-Life Employment Discount Program

**Description of Job**
----------------------

This position exists to support the Division’s goal of reuniting lost property with its rightful owner. In achieving this goal, the position will perform proactive outreach to unclaimed property owners by performing outreach activities; managing proactive check campaigns, to include staying within budget; processing returned checks and remailing those that are eligible; and to use external databases to find and contact property owners. This position also serves as backup to the Claims Section to process claims up to the approval threshold during times of high volume.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Proactive Outreach & Check Campaigns:**
  + Coordinates and delivers proactive outreach initiatives, including mass statutory email notifications and proactive check disbursements under RUUPA.
  + Reviews property and contact records in the Division’s database (KAPS) to assemble check batches, establish distribution schedules, and track expenses against the operating budget.
  + Collaborates with the Claims Manager, Communications team, and software vendor (Kelmar) to align mailing timelines, update website content, and balance incoming public call volumes.
* **Returned Check Management & Owner Research:**
  + Researches and resolves returned proactive checks and regular claims disbursements before the 6-month expiration deadline.
  + Conducts investigative research using public records, postal tools, and databases such as LexisNexis Accurint to locate verified contact information for property owners.
  + Contacts payees directly to obtain current information, prepares replacement documentation, and re-mails eligible checks.
  + Identifies root causes for returned mail and collaborates with software vendors to enhance tracking within the KAPS system.
* **Claims Processing & Public Representation:**
  + Evaluates claimant documentation, verifies proof of ownership, and approves eligible claims up to the approved threshold during high-volume periods.
  + Identifies missing documentation and communicates statutory requirements to claimants to resolve pending files.
  + Represents the Unclaimed Property Division at public outreach events, educating citizens about the program and assisting attendees with on-site searches and claim filings.

**Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment & Appeal Rights**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Five (5) years of professional experience in claims administration, claims processing and analysis, and/or reviewing documents for eligility in a regulatory environment. Part-time experience will be pro-rated. This experience must be demonstrated in your application to be considered for employment.

**OR**

A bachelor’s degree in business, arts, or a field relevant to the duties of this position **AND** One (1) year of professional experience in claims administration, claims processing and analysis, and/or reviewing documents for eligility in a regulatory environment.

  
  

**Substitutions**

A combination of related education and/or relevant experience in claims administration, claims processing and analysis, and/or reviewing documents for eligility in a regulatory environment equal to five (5) years

**Preferred qualifications that a successful candidate will demonstrate:**

* More than two years experience working in claims administration or claims processing.
* Experience providing technical assistance
* Experience providing customer service in a busy in-person or call center environment
* Experience working with compliance programs or other regulatory program
* Experience in databases

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong attention to detail
* Strong analytical skills
* Ability to effectively collaborate with internal and external customers
* Excellent verbal communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Strong problem solving
* Strong organizational skills
* Ability to work independently
* Aptitude to persist through repetitive work duties
* Ability to provide technical assistance

**Conditions of Employment:**

* A pre-employment background check will be conducted as part of the selection process.
* You MUST be a Colorado resident to apply for this position.

**How to Apply:**

**Check out this video on how to apply for the State of Colorado jobs**

***Important Note:****A Human Resources Analyst will only review the work experience/job duties sections of the online job application to determine whether you meet the minimum qualifications for the position for which you are applying. Cover letters and resumes WILL NOT be accepted in* *lieu* *of the official State of Colorado online application.* *Therefore, it is essential that you clearly document your work experience/job duties portion of your online application and the extent to which you possess the education, experience, minimum qualifications, and preferred qualifications as outlined in the job announcement.*

*It is also essential to thoroughly answer all supplemental questions (if listed), as your answers to them will be evaluated during this phase.*

*Only complete applications submitted by this announcement's closing date will be considered.* *Please submit properly completed documents by the closing date of this announcement to ensure your application is accepted**.*

**Application Checklist**:

An ideal application packet includes the following documents:

* A complete online application.
* Completed supplemental questionnaire.

**Your application will be reviewed against the minimum qualifications for the position. If your application demonstrates that you meet the minimum qualifications, you will be invited to the comparative analysis process described below.**

**Comparative Analysis:**

Colorado Revised Statutes require that state employees are hired and promoted through a comparative analysis. After you meet the minimum qualifications for the position and depending on the number of qualified candidates, the comparative analysis for this position may include all **or** part of the structured review of your application materials against the minimum and preferred qualifications of the position as posted in this job posting **or** other skills assessment to measure your job-related skills and competencies.

The top six ranking candidates will then be invited for an interview.

  

**APPEAL RIGHTS:**

If you receive notice that you have been eliminated from consideration for this position, you may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board or request a review by the State Personnel Director.

An appeal or review must be submitted on the official appeal form, signed by you or your representative. This form must be delivered to the State Personnel Board by email (dpa\_state.personnelboard@state.co.us), postmarked in US Mail or hand delivered (1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203), or faxed (303.866.5038) within ten (10) calendar days from your receipt of notice or acknowledgment of the Department's action.

For more information about the appeals process, the official appeal form, and how to deliver it to the State Personnel Board; go to spb.colorado.gov; contact the State Personnel Board for assistance at (303) 866-3300; or refer to 4 Colorado Code of Regulations (CCR) 801-1, State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, Chapter 8, Resolution of Appeals and Disputes, at spb.colorado.gov under Rules.

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

**Supplemental Information:**

*The State of Colorado believes that equity, diversity, and inclusion drive our success, and we encourage candidates from all identities, backgrounds, and abilities to apply. The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive, innovative work environments with employees who reflect our communities and enthusiastically serve them. Therefore, in all aspects of the employment process, we provide opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, a medical condition related to pregnancy, creed, ancestry, national origin, marital status, genetic information, or military status (with preference given to military veterans), or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.*  
*CST is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment, including completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or to perform essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to Janet Martin, Treasury ADAAA Coordinator, at 303-866-5460 or* *janet.martin@state.co.us**.*

By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Remote Housing Coordinator

**SCHEDULE: Sun 12:00 PM-5:00 PM EST; Mon, Tue, Thurs 11:00 AM-9:00 PM EST; Fri 12:00 PM-9:00 PM EST; Off Weds & Sat (Subject to change based off of business needs)**

**PRIMARY PURPOSE:** To coordinate customized temporary housing solutions for displaced policyholders in a fast-paced, service-driven environment. This role demands strong communication, research, negotiation, and multitasking skills to ensure insureds are matched with suitable like, kind, and quality accommodations. The Housing Coordinator serves as both a client advocate and housing specialist-blending empathetic support, strategic property research, and lease coordination to secure safe, comfortable, and comparable housing while delivering an elevated service experience with urgency and professionalism.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Support and promote Sedgwick’s mission, strategic vision, and value proposition to adjusters and policyholders.
* Serve as a key point of contact for policyholders during their relocation, ensuring consistent communication, clear expectations, and empathetic support.
* Qualify housing needs by gathering details about the insured’s lifestyle, household makeup, accessibility needs, pet considerations, and preferred amenities.
* Conduct detailed market research using listing platforms, vendor databases, and internal tools to locate viable, like-kind-and-quality housing options.
* Collaborate with corporate and independent housing vendors, landlords, and leasing agents to secure short-term rentals under time-sensitive circumstances.
* Apply negotiation skills to secure favorable lease terms, maximize policy benefits, and stay within Additional Living Expense (ALE) guidelines.
* Customize housing options that align with both policy coverage and the insured's expectations—balancing budget, availability, and quality.
* Maintain high touch service throughout the policyholder’s stay, proactively resolving issues and supporting lease extensions, furniture adjustments, and service needs.
* Draft and review lease agreements and related documents with attention to detail and policy compliance.
* Enter and maintain accurate data in housing databases, CRM tools, and internal platforms.
* Stay informed of local rental trends, landlord regulations, and insurance housing best practices to advise clients and partners effectively.
* Handle multiple claims and assignments at once with professionalism and urgency.
* Serves as the point of contact for VIP clientele.

**ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Performs other duties as assigned.
* Supports the organization's quality program(s).

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education & Licensing**  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent from an accredited college or university preferred.

**Experience**

Two (2) years experience in inside sales, customer service, or account management. Previous experience in insurance, temporary housing, corporate lodging, or real estate strongly preferred.

**Skills & Knowledge**

  

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; capable of calming distressed clients with professionalism and compassion.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to adapt tone and approach to diverse client situations.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access) and adept at learning new housing and CRM platforms.
* Advanced internet research capabilities to locate viable rental properties in limited markets.
* Detail-oriented and organized with strong documentation habits.
* Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* Negotiation and relationship management skills with vendors, property managers, and landlords.
* Solutions-oriented mindset with a focus on timely, proactive service delivery.
* Experience coordinating accommodations for high-net-worth clients or large-loss claims is a plus.
* Bi-lingual English/Spanish a plus.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
When applicable and appropriate, consideration will be given to reasonable accommodations.

* Prepare evidence packages, makes calls and draft letters as needed.

* Participate in meetings.

* HS Diploma or GED

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Knowledge of related NY state and federal regulations highly desirable
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office required

* Knowledge of claims payment process and claims data system (MHS)
* Ability to work both independently and as a team member
* Demonstrated ability to be deadline focused and to be flexible in order to adjust to priority changes

01bce139ded22e5552a3.description:
Do you enjoy unraveling tricky problems, simplifying complicated choices, and helping people find clarity? If you take pride in making someone’s day easier and want to support the people building the future of software, you will fit right in.

**About JetBrains**
-------------------

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

Our developer ecosystem is growing rapidly across the Americas. Licensing software across personal setups, fast-moving teams, and large organizations involves nuance, from choosing right-sized subscription models to managing smooth multi-year renewals. When customers reach out, they aren't looking for canned answers or corporate scripts – they need an authentic guide who understands their needs and removes friction.

In this role, you will own customer interactions end to end across licensing, billing, and account management. Working remotely within Pacific Standard Time (9:00 am to 5:00 pm PST), you will be the trusted human touchpoint for developers and procurement specialists alike. You will collaborate directly with our sales, engineering, and product support teams to resolve edge cases, spot recurring operational friction, and influence how we refine our workflows and self-serve systems.

Day to day, you will:

* Help customers navigate licensing tiers, account setup, quote requests, and subscription renewals across email, phone, and ticketing systems.
* Translate licensing models and company policies into straightforward, practical guidance tailored to customer goals.
* Maintain clean customer records in our CRM to ensure transparent handoffs and operational clarity across regions.
* Partner with engineering and sales teams to unpack complex customer inquiries and unblock time-sensitive issues.
* Identify patterns in recurring customer questions and suggest concrete improvements to our support documentation and workflows.
* Keep response times steady and quality high during major product releases and promotional cycles.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Clear, thoughtful communication in writing and conversation, with an ability to unpack complex topics simply.
* Natural curiosity about how software products and systems fit together.
* Sound judgment to prioritize tasks and make grounded decisions when handling competing requests.
* Comfort collaborating independently across distributed, multi-cultural teams and time zones.
* A steady, solutions-oriented mindset when helping people navigate confusing or stressful issues.
* A genuine commitment to quality, craft, and leaving processes better than you found them.

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* Demonstrated experience supporting customers through subscription management, order processing, billing inquiries, or account operations.
* Professional fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, enabling clear, empathetic support across our Americas community.
* Practical experience working with ticketing systems (such as Zendesk), modern productivity suites, and CRM platforms (such as Salesforce or HubSpot).
* The ability to understand and clearly explain multi-tier software licensing, subscription agreements, and purchasing workflows.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

You deliver timely, accurate, and context-aware solutions that protect long-term customer trust. Rather than rushing through tickets, you resolve root causes, spot operational bottlenecks early, and help refine internal workflows so our team and our customers both move faster.

**Why join JetBrains?**
-----------------------

* Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
* Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
* Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
* Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
* Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
* Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
* Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
* Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, send us your resume and a brief note about why you’d like to join our team.

==============================

* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with customers and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining a collaborative approach.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.
* High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience utilizing CRM systems and maintaining customer data.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**
==================

* Minimum of 2-4 years of experience in sales support, customer service, account management, administrative support, or related roles.
* Experience within the building products, construction, manufacturing, or window and door industry preferred.
* Proven experience supporting customer accounts and sales teams.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver outstanding customer service.

**Job Specific Requirements**
=============================

* Must be located within the Phoenix, Arizona or Denver, Colorado market.
* Ability to travel periodically to support regional meetings, customer visits, training events, and business needs in other territories as required.
* Ability to work remotely and maintain productivity in a home-office environment.

97b51041890e2101bd17.title: Member Flex Guide
97b51041890e2101bd17.description:
**Job Description**

***What to Expect When You Apply:***

We look forward to learning more about your experience! Here is a quick overview of what to expect after clicking "Apply":

* **Estimated Time:** 5–7 minutes to complete.
* **Information Needed:** Basic contact details, education level, and an up-to-date resume or work history details.
* **Accuracy Notice:** Please ensure all resume and employment information is complete and accurate, as background and employment details will be verified during the selection process.
* **Workday Account (Optional):** We encourage creating a Workday candidate account to track your application status, though it is not required to apply.
* **Next Steps & Hiring Roadmap:** Our Talent Acquisition team will review your submission. The hiring process typically includes 2–3 interview rounds.

***A bit about this role:***

As a Member Service Guide - Flex at Devoted Health, you will be a primary point of connection for our members — meeting them where they are, understanding what they need, and helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare with empathy, accuracy, and care.

Guides at Devoted work across a wide range of member-facing functions. Depending on where you are placed, your home base may focus on inbound service, proactive outreach, real-time digital support, or clinical administration.  
  
Regardless of your primary focus, every Guide is expected to seamlessly pivot and flex across different workflows as business or seasonal needs evolve. You may shift from inbound benefit service to proactive outbound clinical outreach, manage multiple digital chats, perform service recovery, or assist with clinical order updates. That flexibility isn’t a nice-to-have — it’s core to how this team operates and how we serve members well.

In every interaction — whether voice, video, SMS, chat, or digital messaging — you’ll bring our mission to life: treating every member like family. You’ll do this by actively listening, anticipating needs, breaking down complex information into clear and actionable guidance, and working alongside our AI Guide Assistant, a real-time tool designed to help you access information instantly so you can stay fully present and focused on the member.  
  
***You may be hired into one of the following job profiles:*** Inbound Member Service Guide, Outbound Member Service Guide, Care Access Guide, Digital Guide, Pharmacy Guide, Member Outreach Specialist, Community Guide or Grievance Specialist (Complaint Specialist)

***Responsibilities and impact:***

* Member Engagement and Support:
  + Engage with members across all channels (voice, digital, SMS, chat, video) with deep empathy, professionalism, and care.
  + Help members navigate benefits, find providers, schedule appointments, and translate complex healthcare information into clear, actionable terms.
  + Conduct proactive clinical outreach, effectively identifying escalation paths and collaborating with clinical staff.

* Operational Excellence:
  + Leverage data, internal systems, and an AI Guide Assistant to deliver fast, accurate, and fully documented solutions.
  + Adhere strictly to HIPAA guidelines, compliance regulations, and internal workflows.
  + Meet established productivity, quality, and output performance metrics and standards.
* Flexibility and Growth:
  + Flex between inbound, outbound, and cross-functional programs as seasonal business priorities evolve.
  + Adapt quickly to process, workflow, and technology updates with a solutions-oriented attitude.
  + Actively apply real-time feedback and coaching from peers and leadership to drive personal growth.

***Required skills and experience:***

* 1+ years of experience in a high-volume customer-facing role or fast-paced healthcare environment, with a proven track record of building trust and professional relationships.
* Genuine passion for improving the healthcare experience: you love to serve, you care deeply about people, and making a difference motivates you.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule based on business needs, including potential seasonal adjustments.
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills and high emotional intelligence: the ability to adapt your tone to any situation, and a natural gift for making people feel heard.
* Ability to de-escalate intense or emotionally charged interactions with empathy and composure, and to translate complex information into simple, actionable terms.
* Comfort working alongside AI-powered tools and digital platforms to streamline tasks and enhance the quality of member service.
* Flexibility and adaptability: you pivot quickly between priorities, operate effectively in gray areas, and embrace frequent process changes with a positive attitude.
* Strong multitasking ability: you can listen, talk, and type simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and presence.

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Experience in a contact center or call center environment.
* Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or Medicare Advantage — familiarity with benefits, scheduling, and medical terminology is a plus.
* Experience working in highly regulated environments, ideally with HIPAA guidelines and requirements.
* Proven ability to navigate multiple software platforms simultaneously while maintaining composure and accuracy.
* Experience using effective stress management techniques to maintain professionalism in emotionally demanding situations.
* A track record of applying feedback quickly and demonstrating visible growth in response to coaching.

***Hours of Operation & Scheduling Expectations:***

Our Member Services operation runs extended hours to ensure members can reach us when they need us.

**Please Note:** *Specific schedules are finalized and discussed at the time of a potential offer. The hours outlined below represent our overall call center coverage, so it is important to understand that a schedule within any of these operational windows may be required of you to meet business and member needs.*

**Operational Hours by Season:**

* April – September: Monday – Friday (8:00 AM – 2:00 AM ET) · Saturday (8:00 AM – 11:00 PM ET)
* October – November: Sunday – Saturday (8:00 AM – 2:00 AM ET)
* November – March: Sunday – Saturday (8:00 AM – 1:00 AM ET)

**Shift Details:**

* **Daily Schedule:** Your assigned shift will be 8.5 hours (inclusive of a 30-minute lunch break) and will fall within the seasonal hours listed above.
* **Flexibility:** Schedules are subject to change based on business needs, including potential seasonal adjustments to weekend availability.
* **Typical Shift Distribution:** While availability across all open hours is required, most shifts fall within standard daytime and early evening hours. Late-night shifts are limited and assigned based on operational volume.

***Salary:***$20-25 / hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium
* Generous paid time off
* $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend
* Stock options for all employees
* Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles
* Parental leave program
* 401K program
* And more....

* *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.*

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

  

We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by individuals purporting to represent Devoted Health. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for “start up costs” or “equipment”), or seek to collect sensitive personal information. These job postings and offers are **NOT**authorized by Devoted Health and Devoted is not responsible for fraudulent offers, personal information that you may have disclosed, or payments made to third parties purporting to represent Devoted. We have reported this matter and are cooperating with law enforcement agencies. Devoted Health will never ask for financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process.

df048ef2bf8e02661f3f.title: Financial Analyst
df048ef2bf8e02661f3f.description:
At Cogstate, we're advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate's assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we're supporting a multinational Alzheimer's trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we're not just imagining the future of brain health - we're building it.

That's why we're seeking a Financial Analyst, responsible for working with the 3 existing Clinical Trials Finance Team members to support the delivery of goals and objectives of the Clinical Trials division within Cogstate.

The role is required to be a subject matter expert in the pricing of all external request for proposals (RFP's), supporting Project Managers with the financial aspects of their projects and for creating internal monthly financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create Pricing for customer proposals based on RFP's received, internal inputs, and within company approved standards.
* Assist Project Managers in the creation or review of customer change in scope pricing (Change Orders)
* Coordinate with Business Development and provide regular updates on the financial details and contracting of all new proposals and change orders in development
* Coordination and development of all pricing & Forecast Trackers on newly signed projects, with ongoing support and analysis across all projects.
* Contract setup: set up of Project "Forecast Tracker" file and project codes in the Oracle Netsuite system
* Ongoing: Responsible for providing financial advice and assistance with monthly billing/forecasting to the Project Management team who manage the project portfolio
* Contract close down: financial reconciliation of the project billing at the end of a project
* Analyze financial data and provide forecasting support.
* Participate in constant review of customer profitability analysis to ensure key divisional KPIs are achieved
* Ongoing development and creation of reporting related to profitability, staff utilization and staff resourcing
* Provision of ad-hoc reporting as required for Marketing, Business Development and Clinical Trials Operations incorporating and utilizing data and information sourced from within Cogstate
* Monitor and analyze monthly divisional employee time reporting; identify and escalate areas of concern
* Assist Financial Accounting team in the consolidation of all forecasting on Clinical Trials studies, as well as estimates of future income and timing on all high probability and unsigned contracts in development

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Business, Management, or Finance
* MBA, CPA, CFA or Big 4 (highly desirable)
* At least 5 years of experience in analyzing financial data and producing high level reports.
* Must have Preferred knowledge of a variety of computer software applications with an advanced knowledge of Excel. Including but not limited VLOOKUP, index match, pivot tables
* At least 5 years of experience working within Clinical Trials, either as a vendor or sponsor. Must understand SOA's, screened vs. enrolled, vs. completed participants (highly desirable)
* Working knowledge of Oracle Netsuite (highly desirable)

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise**

* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to work autonomously while assisting daily operations of both Clinical Trials Operations and the Finance functions
* Self-motivated, with excellent time management skills.
* Computer skills to effectively use software to analyze financial information, identify trends and make forecasts

**What's In It For You**

* In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in Cogstate's short-term incentive (STI) bonus program, with a target bonus opportunity of 10% of annual base salary, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan.
* Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!
* Generous Paid Time-off: Cogstate employees receive 20 days of vacation leave, 10 days of personal leave and 10 paid public holidays.
* 401(k) Matching: As you invest in yourself and your future, Cogstate invests in you too: we match up to3% of your yearly salary in Cogstate's 401k program.
* Competitive Salary: We offer competitive base salaries plus additional earning opportunities based on the position.
* Health, Dental & Vision Coverage: We've invested in comprehensive health & dental insurance options with competitive company contributions to help when you need it most. We also offer free vision insurance for all full-time employees.
* Short-Term & Long Term Disability Life Insurance: 100% employer sponsored
* Pre-Tax Benefits: Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
* Learning & Development Opportunities: Cogstate offers a robust learning program from mentorships to assistance with programs to improve knowledge or obtain certifications in applicable areas of interest.

**Our Culture**  
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We're courageous and we deliver together. We're passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We're brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you're ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!
