1a6056051915c941e240.title: Sr. Claims Examiner, Casualty
1a6056051915c941e240.description:
**Summary / Objective**

The Senior Claims Examiner – Casualty handles moderately complex general liability claims across admitted and E&S lines. This role evaluates complex coverage matters, investigates loss facts, assigns defense counsel, assesses intricate damages, and negotiates and resolves matters with a high level of independence. The Senior Claims Examiner also trains and mentors less experienced claims examiners.

**Essential Duties & Functions**

* Handle complex casualty claims, including General Liability, Products, Life Sciences, Construction, and Supported Excess.
* Analyze coverage and communicate coverage positions to insureds and agents based on policy information, facts, and the allegations of each case.
* Investigate claims with policyholders, claimants, claimant attorneys, law enforcement, witnesses, agents, medical providers, and technical experts to evaluate liability, damages, and contribution potential.
* Ensure claims are handled timely; periodically evaluate liability and damages and establish proper indemnity and expense reserves.
* Prepare coverage position letters on matters in litigation without external assistance.
* Negotiate disposition of claims with insureds, claimants, and their representatives.
* Develop litigation plans and budgets with legal counsel on litigated matters; enforce panel counsel guidelines and control legal expenses to achieve appropriate resolution.
* Attend depositions, mediations, arbitrations, pre-trials, trials, and other legal proceedings as needed.
* Develop and execute a strategic file management plan that achieves optimal file resolution and business results.
* Escalate complex, high-severity, or coverage-sensitive issues to senior team members.
* Train and mentor less experienced claims examiners.
* Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

**LIO LIFE — What We Value**

The Customer Lens

* - Prioritizing our relationships, service, and needs of our customers.
Innovative Thinking* - Fostering an environment that empowers and sustains bold thinking and actions.
Balance* - Creating an inclusive, diverse, and holistic balance to meet our personal and professional needs.
Simplicity* - Striving for simplicity in our service, products, and processes.
Accountability* - Owning our results and learning from them.

**Qualifications**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Active listening and critical thinking skills
* Strong respect for confidentiality
* Advanced judgment and decision-making abilities
* Superior internal and external customer service skills
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate at any level, individually and within a team
* Strong analytical and project management skills – planning the work, working the plan
* Ability to prioritize and multi-task in a virtual, small-team, entrepreneurial environment

**Required Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree
* 5–10+ years of casualty claims experience
* Experience with GL claims; E&S exposure required
* State adjuster licensing

**Preferred Education and Experience**

* CPCU, AIS, and/or JD
* Substantial experience in construction defect (CD) and/or professional liability claims

**Additional Eligibility Requirements (Certificates, Licenses, Required/Preferred)**

* CPCU or AIS

**LIO Life — Our Benefits**

LIO offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance. Benefits are effective on your date of hire.

* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage.
* Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), and Dependent Care Assistance Program (DCAP).
* Employer-paid Life & AD&D, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.
* Voluntary Life & AD&D insurance.
* 401(k) Retirement Savings plan.
* Flexible Time Off.
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP).
* Voluntary Pet Insurance.
* Career development and growth opportunities.

**Work Environment**

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment.

**Position Type / Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time position. Expected days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. This position may require long hours and weekend work.

**Travel**

Occasional travel may be necessary for this position – to attend mediations, trials, or large property loss exposures.

**EEO Statement**

LIO Insurance provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

**Other Duties**

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

3c08fd25df75ad8d44e4.title: Inpatient Coder III - Per Diem: Remote
3c08fd25df75ad8d44e4.description:
**Hours:** Up to 30 hours per week. Assistance needed for month end, vacation coverage, etc. Flexibility with start/end time. Weekend coverage strongly preferred.

**Location:** 100% remote.

**Requirements:** Virtual orientation held on your start date (Monday, 8:30-5). Ability to conduct training during the hours of 6 AM to 6 PM (EST) M-F.

**Job Overview**

This position reviews medical records to assure accurate specificity of diagnoses and procedures for inpatient admissions. Effectively utilizes ICD-10 CM and PCS codes according to coding guidelines. Communicates effectively with providers and/or all appropriate staff regarding missing information such as diagnosis, procedure, and documentation issues, to ensure proper coding and reimbursement. Manages the creation of deficiencies, within Epic, for missing documentation. Works with leadership to review denial reports as well as participating in internal and external audits to ensure documentation, code capture, and billing are accurate and precise. Informs supervisor of unusual/problematic accounts, issues, concerns, and opportunities for improvement. Attends meetings and education sessions as requested with participation. Performs any other related duties as assigned.

**Job Description**

**Minimum Qualifications:**

1. High school diploma or equivalent.

2. Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) or Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT).

3. Three (3) years of ICD-10-CM and PCS coding experience

4. EMR experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Associates degree.

2. Five (5) years of Inpatient ICD-10-CM and PCS coding experience within a Teaching hospital or Level One Trauma Center.

3. Epic and CAC Experience

**Duties and Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities listed below are intended to describe the general nature of work and are not intended to be an all-inclusive list. Other duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

1. Verifies and abstracts clinical and demographic data from the patient record.

2. Performs chart audits prior to coding to ensure required documentation is complete and signed. Queries appropriate providers or departments when deficiencies prevent the start of the coding process.

3. Assigns accurately ICD-10 CM an ICD10 PCS codes, derived from medical record documentation for patient account.

4.Reviews reports with leadership to identify discrepancies.

5. Reviews audit lists regarding coding/billing changes, as well as denial reports.

6. Identifies and evaluates coding issues, summarizes findings for leadership, makes recommendations for course of action. Works actively with physicians to initiate corrections and resolve discrepancies in coding and documentation.

9. Ensures that all accounts are submitted accurately and in a timely manner.

10. Works collaboratively with Compliance, Educators, and Auditors

11. Ensures that all medical records are coded and abstracted within 72 hours of patient discharge.

12. Responsible to follow-up on assigned discharges for final coding.

13. Acts as a resource for answering coding questions from interdepartmental staff.

14. Documents results of all special project work and providing recommendations relating to special projects.

15. Attend meetings as necessary and participates on projects to ensure that all services are captured through codes.

16. Maintains good relationship with providers and office personnel to facilitate good communication in coding queries.

17. Promote excellent customer service. Identify and communicate problems and/or opportunities to improve processes with management.

18. Maintains collaborative, team relationships with peers and colleagues in order to effectively contribute to the working groups achievement of goals, and to help foster a positive work environment

19. Performs job junctions adhering to service principles with customer service focus of innovation, service excellence and teamwork to provide the highest quality care and service to our patients, families, colleagues and community.

20. Participates in coding audits coding staff in order to maintain quality standards and offer feedback to management

21. Works closely with the DRG Validator to maintain high coding standards.

**Physical Requirements:**

1. Sedentary role which requires sitting most of the time, occasional standing & walking. Mental requirements will be intense at times with involvement in many concurrent multi-faceted projects.

2. Manual dexterity using fine hand manipulation to operate computer keyboard.

3. Ability to see computer screen and reports.

**Skills & Abilities:**

1. Excellent organizational skills and able to balance working on multiple tasks and provide timely follow through.

2. Effective interpersonal and communication skills.

3. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

4. Ability to communicate verbally, by phone or virtually, with colleagues and medical staff.

5. Knowledge of Excel and basic computer skills.

6. Working knowledge of ICD- 10-CM, ICD 10- PCS, and CPT coding system, DRG, APG, , Government and Commercial payor policies, Coding Clinic, disease processes, medical terminology, anatomy and physiology.

7. Ability to read and write in the English language.

**Job Profile** **Summary**

This role focuses on activities related to revenue cycle operations such as billing, collections, and payment processing. In addition, this role focuses on performing the following Health Information Management duties: Responsible for the accuracy, maintenance, security, and confidentiality of patient's health information. An organizational related support or service (administrative or clerical) role or a role that focuses on support of daily business activities (e.g., technical, clinical, non-clinical) operating in a “hands on” environment. The majority of time is spent in the delivery of support services or activities, typically under supervision. A senior level role that requires broad knowledge of operational procedures and tools obtained through extensive work experience and may require vocational or technical education. Works under limited supervision for routine situations, provides assistance and training to lower level employees, and problems typically are not routine and require analysis to understand.

At Tufts Medicine, we want every individual to feel valued for the skills and experience they bring. Our compensation philosophy is designed to offer fair, competitive pay that attracts, retains, and motivates highly talented individuals, while rewarding the important work you do every day.

The base pay ranges reflect the minimum qualifications for the role. Individual offers are determined using a comprehensive approach that considers relevant experience, certifications, education, skills, and internal equity to ensure compensation is fair, consistent, and aligned with our business goals.

Beyond base pay, Tufts Medicine provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package that supports your health, financial security, and career growth—one of the many ways we invest in you so you can thrive both at work and outside of it.

**Pay Range****:**

**Elevate PFS Holdings, Inc.** has an excellent career opportunity available for an **OOS Claims Specialist** **Team Lead.** This position will be **remote.** The schedule for this **Full-Time** role is **Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM**.

Elevate provides revenue cycle solutions to hospitals and physicians throughout the United States. This includes AR support for Out-of-State Medicaid accounts. The purpose of this position is conduct Medicaid eligibility, authorization, enrollment and payment posting functions.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Confirm eligibility and authorization requirements for Medicaid patients.
* Submit authorization requests to Medicaid payers and perform appropriate follow up to ensure authorization requests are resolved in a timely manner.
* Perform manual data entry of patient accounts and or claim forms.
* Gather and maintain credentials from hospitals and physicians.
* Coordinate with hospitals and physicians to accurately complete Medicaid enrollment applications.
* Submit hospital and physician enrollment applications to Medicaid payers and complete timely follow up to ensure applications process correctly.
* Manage and comply with client and Medicaid enrollment guidelines.
* Update enrollment status, documentation and information in software system.
* Provide strong customer service to clients and provide responses to client inquiries within 24 hours.

* Review Medicaid payments for accuracy and submit payment information to the cash posting team.
* Facilitate timely payment from Medicaid payers.
* Work in compliance with state and federal guidelines, including HIPAA and FDCPA.

* Monitor status of each account and communicate effectively with management, clients and other parties regarding the status of the accounts.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS**

* Working knowledge of ICD9, CPT codes, HIPAA, HCPCS and Medicaid preferred.
* 2 plus years of Medicaid experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Ability to multi-task.
* Critical thinking and strong attention to detail.
* Required computer skills: must have experience with data entry and word processing, be capable of operating routine office equipment, possess a working knowledge of MS Office applications, and understand how to navigate through multiple web-based applications.
* Remote and Hybrid positions require a home internet connection that meets the company’s upload and download speed criteria
* Remote and Hybrid positions require a home internet connection that meets the company’s upload and download speed criteria.

**EDI Specialist**

**Remote**

**Company Overview:** AMSURG is an independent leader in ambulatory surgery center services, operating a network of more than 250 surgery centers nationwide. In partnership with physicians and health systems, the organization delivers high-quality care for patients across a diverse spectrum of medical specialties, including gastroenterology, ophthalmology and orthopedics. To learn more about AMSURG, visit www.amsurg.com.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The EDI Specialist I supports the implementation, configuration, enrollment, and maintenance of Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) processes for ambulatory surgery centers and physician practices. This role is responsible for executing standard payer enrollments, maintaining configuration data, monitoring claim activity, and providing first-level troubleshooting support under established procedures and guidance.

The EDI Specialist I develops foundational expertise in revenue cycle management systems, payer connectivity, and clearinghouse operations while contributing to successful implementations and operational stability.

**Work Schedule:** Remote First

**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**EDI Enrollment & Configuration**

* Complete standard clearinghouse and payer enrollment activities.
* Assist with establishing payer connectivity for implementations.
* Maintain billing system configuration data including:
* + Payer master files
  + Provider records
  + Libraries
  + Electronic and paper claim setup
* Monitor enrollment progress and escalate delays or issues.

**Implementation Support**

* Participate in implementation discovery and data gathering activities.
* Support project build tasks according to established standards.
* Assist with post-go-live monitoring of claims and electronic remittance activity.
* Document implementation activities and outcomes.

**Issue Resolution**

* Perform initial analysis of payer rejections and clearinghouse errors.
* Resolve routine claim submission and ERA issues.
* Escalate complex payer or configuration issues appropriately.
* Support Service Desk and operations teams with EDI-related inquiries.

**Documentation & Testing**

* Maintain process documentation and user guides.
* Participate in testing activities within non-production environments.
* Validate build accuracy and identify potential issues.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential responsibility satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and/or abilities required.

* Basic understanding of healthcare revenue cycle processes.
* Working knowledge of EDI transactions including 837 and 835.
* Understanding of payer enrollment workflows.
* Strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to learn technical systems quickly.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.

**Education/Experience:**

* Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 1-3 years of experience in:
* Experience with practice management systems preferred.
* Exposure to clearinghouses and payer enrollment processes preferred.

**Success Measures**

* Timely completion of enrollments.
* Accurate configuration maintenance.
* Effective resolution of routine EDI issues.
* Achievement of implementation milestones.
* High-quality documentation and testing support.

0a598f68fc987677fb53.description:
Looking for a chance to make a meaningful difference in the oncology space? Taiho Oncology is on a mission: to improve the lives of patients with cancer, their families, and caregivers. Our “People first” approach means we also highly value our employees, who work relentlessly to help execute our mission. Taiho’s success is founded on ensuring we always act with accountability, collaboration, and trust. By following these guiding principles, we earn and maintain the confidence of patients, the global healthcare community, collaborators and partners, and each other. Together, we are working on cutting-edge science and growing our portfolio and pipeline across a range of tumor types to address the ongoing and evolving needs of patients. Advanced technology, a world-class clinical development organization, and state-of-the-art facilities: these and other resources empower us to innovate and touch the lives of more and more patients. It’s our work, our passion, and our legacy. We invite you to join us.
  
  
**Hybrid:** 3-days per week on-site
  
Employee Value Proposition
  
​​​​​​​​​At Taiho Oncology, the compassion we practice for our patients extends to our team, empowering and motivating them to do their best work for those who need it most. This is an opportunity to contribute to Quality Assurance activities in a dynamic, collaborative, and global cross-functional environment.​​
  
  
**Position Summary:**  
​​​​​​​​​The Manager, Quality Assurance Operations – Vendor & Audit Management is responsible for the day-to-day execution and administration of the Quality Assurance vendor and audit management program under the strategic direction of the Director, Quality Assurance Operations. The position manages operational audit activities and associated records within TrackWise Digital (TWD), supporting the audit lifecycle from initiation and scheduling through reporting, CAPA follow-up, and closure. The Manager works with internal stakeholders, auditors, vendors, and Quality colleagues to ensure activities are completed accurately, consistently, and in accordance with applicable procedures and regulatory expectations.
  
  
**Performance Objectives:**  
​​Audit Management
  

* ​Coordinate the operational lifecycle of assigned GxP audits, including vendor audits and other Quality audits.
* ​Schedule audits and coordinate logistics with auditors, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* ​Support audit preparation by collecting relevant documentation and ensuring required information is available.
* ​Maintain audit records and track activities through report issuance, response, CAPA management, follow-up, and closure.
* ​Monitor commitments and due dates and follow up with responsible stakeholders to support timely completion.
* ​Escalate significant compliance concerns, overdue activities, and emerging risks to the Director and appropriate Quality leadership.

​TrackWise Digital Administration
  

* ​Perform day-to-day data entry and record maintenance for vendor and audit management activities in TWD.
* ​Create and maintain accurate audit and vendor records and supporting documentation.
* ​Track assigned actions, CAPAs, due dates, status changes, and closure activities in TWD.
* ​Perform routine data-quality checks to support the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of records.
* ​Support generation of audit and vendor management data for periodic reporting, metrics, trending, and management review.
* ​Identify data or workflow issues and escalate them to the appropriate Quality stakeholders.

​Vendor Quality Management
  

* ​Execute assigned activities within the risk-based vendor management program.
* ​Coordinate the collection and maintenance of vendor quality documentation.
* ​Support vendor qualification, periodic review, audit, and ongoing oversight activities as assigned.
* ​Track vendor-related quality issues, CAPAs, commitments, and follow-up activities.
* ​Maintain documentation supporting vendor qualification and oversight decisions.
* ​Work with internal stakeholders to obtain information required for vendor quality oversight and escalate vendor quality concerns and trends.

​Quality and Compliance Support
  

* ​Support compliance with applicable GxP requirements, company policies, SOPs, and quality standards.
* Assist with preparation and maintenance of procedures, work instructions, and other controlled documents related to vendor and audit management.
* Identify potential compliance issues and escalate them through appropriate Quality channels.
* Support inspection and regulatory authority activities related to assigned vendor and audit records, as needed.
* Participate in cross-functional and global Quality initiatives as assigned.​

**Education/Certification Requirements:**  

* ​​​​​​​​​​Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, technical, quality, or related discipline​

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Approximately 7 or more years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, Quality Assurance, auditing, vendor management, or related GxP experience preferred
* Experience supporting or managing GxP audits is strongly preferred.
* ​Experience working within an electronic quality management system; TrackWise Digital experience preferred.
* ​Experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment.
* ​Working knowledge of GxP requirements and Quality Assurance principles.
* ​Understanding of audit lifecycle management, including planning, reporting, CAPA follow-up, and closure.
* ​Strong organizational and project-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent activities and deadlines.
* ​Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate and complete quality records.
* ​Ability to identify potential compliance concerns, apply sound judgment, and escalate appropriately.
* ​Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* ​Ability to work effectively with vendors, auditors, Quality personnel, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* ​Problem-solving and risk-analysis skills and the ability to interpret scientific, technical, procedural, and regulatory information.
* ​Proficiency in electronic quality systems and structured quality data management.​

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $131,750- $155,000 annually. This pay range is based on the market range for positions of this type. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including annual bonus/incentive comp plans, potential long term incentive plan, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if a candidate/employee receives an offer of employment.
  
If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

fc443c4c163b355ce064.title: Workforce Development Learning Partner
fc443c4c163b355ce064.description:
Overview:

Responsible for serving as an elevated learning leader and execution partner within Workforce Development, bridging day-to-day training execution and formal program ownership. This role partners with the Senior Manager of Workforce Development, Program Manager, Operations leaders, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), site leadership, and cross-functional partners to assess learning needs; design, facilitate, and continuously improve technical and leadership development programs; strengthen facilitator capability; and support consistent program execution and sustainment. The role provides peer leadership and coaching to WFD Specialists, uses learner and program data to improve effectiveness, and helps translate field operations knowledge into practical learning experiences aligned with safety, quality, productivity, and organizational goals.

**Location & Travel Details:** This position is able to be remote with 40-50% throughout the US.

**Company Overview**

MasTec Renewables, comprised of Wanzek Construction, IEA Constructors, and White Construction, combines over 20 years of experience in renewable energy construction. Depending on your position and project, you may work for one or more of our companies over your career with us. Join one of the largest construction firms in the country (Engineering News-Record [ENR]: #1 in Power, #17 Top 50 Domestic Heavy Contractors, #20 Transportation Contractor).
  
  
We embrace diverse perspectives among our employees and across all levels of our business, including our suppliers, community partners, and clients. We have built a multidimensional workforce that brings valuable differences in perspectives, work ethics, and approaches to our organization. By collaborating across departments, we foster innovation and encourage everyone—from interns to executives—to share their ideas and make an impact. Our goal is to create a respectful work environment where all employees feel valued, included, and empowered to become innovative leaders in our industry.  
  
The MasTec Renewables market sector is part of the MasTec Clean Energy & Infrastructure business segment. MasTec’s Clean Energy & Infrastructure (CE&I) segment generates over $4.5 billion in annual revenue, providing construction services across industrial, renewables and infrastructure sectors. Our renewables sector focuses on solar, wind and battery storage. Sustainability and safety are foundational to our culture and influence everything we do.
  
  
MasTec, a minority-owned Fortune 500 company, has shaped the construction industry for more than 90 years. With over 35,000 employees and 400 offices nationwide, we provide flexibility and career growth in dynamic work environments.

**Recruitment Video:** **https://youtu.be/64du25Mfnx0?si=nnq4QyS7zgEej7dA**

  
Responsibilities:

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Build trust and work collaboratively with all levels of the organization, including staff, craft, Operations leaders, SMEs, site leadership, and cross-functional partners
* Partner with the Senior Manager of Workforce Development, Program Manager, Operations leaders, and SMEs to identify learning needs and translate operational requirements into effective learning strategies
* Utilize assessment data, learner feedback, performance insights, field observations, and program metrics to identify learning gaps, recommend solutions, evaluate effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with SMEs and instructional design resources to develop and maintain learning objectives, curriculum, presentations, facilitator guides, checklists, activities, assessments, and other course materials
* Integrate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational processes, safety, quality, and productivity expectations into training curriculum
* Lead facilitator and SME readiness through rehearsals, observations, coaching, feedback, delivery standards, and ongoing facilitator development
* Facilitate in-person, virtual, field-based, and train-the-trainer programs, adapting delivery to learner and business needs
* Provide execution leadership and operational support for New Hire Onboarding and other established WFD programs, serving as a key partner in the delivery of formal development programs to ensure program quality, consistency, and sustainment, while overall program ownership remains with the Program Manager
* Coordinate recurring learning series and program delivery activities, including content readiness, facilitator coordination, learner engagement, and post-session follow-through
* Support career path training matrices and development pathways across key field and project roles
* Provide mentoring, quality review, guidance, and informal peer leadership to WFD Specialists
* Collaborate with the LMS Administrator to house, assign, report, and track learning content, attendance, assessments, and retraining requirements
* Partner with the Training Coordinator on program logistics, scheduling, learner communications, materials, room or site readiness, and other delivery support
* Maintain current knowledge of Talent Development practices and construction/field operations to ensure learning programs remain practical, relevant, and effective
* Maintain appropriate training records, documentation, and program data and support consistent reporting requirements
* Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

**Education and Work Experience Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Education/Adult Learning, Communications, Construction Management, or related field preferred
* Three+ years of experience in workforce training, learning and development, or construction field operations, including coordinating learning programs, supporting facilitators, managing delivery schedules, and analyzing learner performance and training effectiveness
* Experience developing and implementing learning programs, and facilitating curriculum design discussions with SMEs and Operations leadership
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:**

* Take reasonable care of your own and others’ health and safety and of those who may be affected by the day-to-day delivery of this role by taking personal responsibility for working toward the Company’s Zero Injury principles
* Ability to lead defined program components with limited oversight and work toward full program ownership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with advanced public speaking and facilitation capability
* Ability to lead performance consulting and learning-needs discussions and collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders at all organizational levels
* Advanced facilitation skills with the ability to adjust techniques, learning goals, and delivery approaches based on participant and business needs
* Strong curriculum development and instructional design capability, including the ability to create practical learning experiences aligned with field operations
* Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, multimedia training platforms, LMS platforms, and data analysis/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI)
* Knowledge of field operations within construction or industrial environments and ability to translate technical concepts into effective learning experiences
* Adaptable, creative problem solver with strong judgment, professionalism, confidentiality, and a continuous improvement mindset
* Knowledge of leadership and personality assessment tools (e.g. DiSC, Strengths, Korn Ferry, Hogan) and the ability to interpret assessment results to support individual, team, and leadership development initiatives.
* Ability to travel to jobsites and training centers as needed; travel expectation is approximately 40-50% based on program and business needs

**What's in it for You**

Financial Wellbeing

* Compensation $76,000 - $95,000 / year, commensurate with experience
* Competitive pay with ongoing performance review and merit increase
* 401(k) with company match & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Flexible spending account (Healthcare & Dependent care)
* Bonus Eligible

Health & Wellness

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance (plan choice) - coverage for spouse, domestic partner, and children
* Diabetes Management, Telehealth Coverage, Prescription Drug Plan, Pet Insurance, Weight Management Drug Discount
* Discounted National Gym Membership Network

Family & Lifestyle

* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, Bereavement Leave
* Military Leave, including Benefits Continuation
* Employee Assistance Program

Planning for the Unexpected

* Short and long-term disability, life insurance, and accidental death & dismemberment
* Voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity coverage
* Emergency Travel Assistance Program
* Group legal plan

*Position may be subject to pre-employment screening, which may include background check and drug testing. Accessibility: If you need accommodation as part of the employment process, contact ceicareers@mastec.com. Due to the high volume of applications received, we are unable to respond to individual requests regarding application status. Please log into your candidate profile for up-to-date information.*

*MasTec, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. The Company's policy is not to unlawfully discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military status, or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The Company also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also MasTec's policy to comply with all applicable state, federal and local laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.*

***Disclaimer: MasTec and our Subsidiaries will never ask prospective employees for any form of payment or money transfer as part of job application or onboarding. We do not ask prospective employees for information about credit cards or personal passwords, and it does not require applicants to purchase equipment or software. Ensure that all recruiter email addresses end in @mastec.com or @talent.icims.com. If you suspect you are the target of a scam, we advise you to contact your local law enforcement agency and report fraud at*** ***https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/******.***

**Remote Inbound Customer Service Representative**
==================================================

**Disabled Veteran Solutions (DVS)**

**Position:** Full-Time | Scheduled Inbound Customer Support  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday | Assigned 8-hour shifts between 8:00 AM and 9:00 PM Eastern

**Build a Career Where Professionalism, Reliability, and Service Matter**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Disabled Veteran Solutions (DVS) is hiring dependable, technically skilled Customer Service Representatives to support essential programs serving individuals and communities nationwide.

We're looking for experienced customer service professionals who are confident managing inbound calls, navigating multiple computer systems, solving problems, and providing accurate, compassionate assistance.

**This is a structured, performance-driven remote call center position-not a flexible, work-at-your-own-pace opportunity.**

If you're someone who takes pride in being dependable, communicating professionally, and delivering excellent service, we'd love to learn more about you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As an Inbound Customer Service Representative, you will:

* Handle inbound customer calls with professionalism, patience, and efficiency.
* Research customer inquiries and provide accurate information using multiple computer applications.
* Perform basic technical troubleshooting and create support tickets when needed.
* Schedule appointments and assist customers with service-related processes.

* Conduct follow-up calls when necessary.
* Follow established procedures, privacy requirements, and quality standards.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous customer service experience in a professional, customer-facing environment.

* Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively with English-speaking customers, both verbally and in writing.

* Dependability and ability to maintain a consistent work schedule.
* Ability to work independently while remaining engaged with a remote team.
* Ability to complete applicable pre-employment screening and credentialing requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of high-volume inbound call center experience.
* Previous remote customer service or technical support experience.
* Experience supporting healthcare, insurance, financial services, or government-related programs.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, CRM systems, and web-based customer service applications.
* Bilingual communication skills (English/Spanish).

**Remote Work Requirements**
----------------------------

Successful candidates must be able to maintain:

* Reliable high-speed internet with a wired Ethernet connection; Wi-Fi alone does not meet the connection requirement.
* A professional, private workspace suitable for handling confidential customer information.
* The ability to remain focused, available, and engaged throughout assigned working hours.
* The ability to meet established technical and connectivity standards.

**Training, SchedulingAttendance**
----------------------------------

DVS provides structured training to help new employees build the knowledge and skills needed for success.

**Initial Paid Training**

* Duration: First two weeks.
* Schedule: 9:00 AM–4:30 PM Eastern, Monday–Friday.
* Attendance is 100% required for all scheduled training sessions.

**Regular Work Schedule**

* Full-time position.
* Assigned shifts within Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern.

Consistent attendance, punctuality, and active participation are essential to success in this position.

**Pre-Employment Requirements**
-------------------------------

Selected candidates will be required to complete applicable pre-employment requirements, which may include:

* Criminal background screening.
* Drug screening.
* Employment documentation and verification.

**Why Join Disabled Veteran Solutions?**
----------------------------------------

DVS is a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business committed to delivering exceptional service while creating meaningful employment opportunities.

When you join our team, you'll be part of an organization that values:

* **Professionalism:** Taking pride in doing the job well.
* **Teamwork:** Working alongside colleagues who support one another.

**Ready to Join Our Team?**
---------------------------

If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

cb64cbef39b592d853b9.title: Medical Accuracy Reviewer
cb64cbef39b592d853b9.description:
**THE POSITION**  
  
LiveWorld is seeking detail-oriented Medical Accuracy Reviewers to support the quality and accuracy of medically related customer interactions across social and digital channels. This specialized Social Media Agent role is responsible for reviewing medically related content for accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established guidelines before final delivery.

The Medical Accuracy Reviewer performs quality assurance reviews, identifies potential medical inaccuracies, prepares written summary reports, and escalates issues according to established procedures. This role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong written communication skills, and the ability to accurately interpret medical reference materials.

This is a remote, hourly, part-time position. Flexibility is required as schedules may include evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays based on business needs. LiveWorld's goal is to develop long-term team members with specialized language and medical expertise who can support a variety of healthcare programs.  
  
**ABOUT LIVEWORLD**  
  
LiveWorld is a Human-Led, AI-Powered intelligence systems company. We deliver solutions spanning intelligence systems, digital marketing, content moderation services, and software helping brands engage effectively with their audiences. With deep expertise in healthcare and pharma, LiveWorld combines compliance, engagement, and insight solutions to transform customer relationships through social and digital experiences.  
  
With over 30 years of making connections, we leverage our social media DNA to deliver continuous learning through AI-based intelligence systems and emotion-driven behavior change through digital campaigns with a human touch. LiveWorld clients include the number one brands in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, and financial/travel services. LiveWorld is headquartered in Campbell, California, with an additional office in New York City. Come join our award-winning company.
  
  
We are a remote-centric company with a culture and processes intentionally designed to support virtual work. We believe flexibility and accountability can coexist, and we have built a highly collaborative environment where team members remain connected and engaged. Working remotely at LiveWorld requires self-discipline, strong communication, and active participation. Team members are expected to thrive in a remote environment, actively engage with colleagues and clients, participate in virtual meetings with video, and contribute meaningfully to team collaboration.  
  
Our culture is built around **Collaborative** **Velocity**, our operating philosophy centered on contribution, accountability, alignment, trust, and teamwork.
  
  
**JOB** **OVERVIEW**  
  
Reporting to the Agent Operations and Quality Management Director, the Medical Accuracy Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the quality and medical accuracy of customer interactions and related documentation before information is finalized or delivered.

Working within established guidelines and approved reference materials, this position reviews transcripts for medical accuracy, performs quality assurance evaluations, prepares written summary reports, and identifies situations requiring escalation. The role works collaboratively with cross-functional teams while maintaining strict quality standards, confidentiality, and compliance requirements.  
Success in this role requires excellent analytical skills, strong reading comprehension, exceptional written communication, sound judgment, and the ability to consistently apply medical guidance in a fast-paced remote environment.  
  
**CORE RESPONSIBILIT****I****ES**

* Review transcripts and written customer interactions for medical accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Verify information using approved medical reference materials and documented procedures.
* Perform quality assurance reviews on completed transcript evaluations.
* Prepare clear, concise, and accurate written summary reports at the end of each shift.
* Identify inconsistencies, potential risks, or medically significant information requiring escalation.
* Escalate issues according to established company procedures.
* Apply established guidelines consistently while maintaining productivity and quality expectations.
* Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information and follow all company policies.
* Accurately document review findings and maintain required records.
* Collaborate with internal teams to support continuous quality improvement.

  

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum 18 years of age.
* Two to three years of experience in healthcare, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, pharmacy, nursing, clinical support, or a related medical field.
* Strong understanding of medical terminology and the ability to accurately interpret medical documentation and reference materials.
* Ability to understand and apply medication-related information, including dosing instructions, administration guidance, storage requirements, contraindications, precautions, drug interactions, and potential side effects.
* Excellent written communication skills with strong grammar, spelling, punctuation, and professional writing ability.
* Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.
* Ability to make consistent decisions while following established procedures and guidelines.
* Strong keyboarding and computer navigation skills.
* Ability to work across multiple software applications simultaneously.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining productivity and quality standards.
* Demonstrated professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment.

  

**STRONGLY PREFERRED**

* Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety, or Medical Affairs experience.
* Physicians, Nurses, Pharmacists, Pharmacy Technicians, or other healthcare professionals are encouraged to apply (current licensure not required).
* Previous online moderation, engagement, or digital customer service experience.
* Previous work-from-home experience.

* Experience with social media management or engagement platforms such as LiveWorld, Salesforce, Sprinklr, Khoros, or similar systems.
* Experience supporting pharmaceutical or healthcare organizations.
* Fluency in one or more additional languages.

  

**EDUCATION**

* College degree preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant healthcare experience will be considered.

  

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Reliable high-speed internet connection.
* Reliable telephone access (landline preferred during training).
* Quiet, secure home office environment.
* Desktop or laptop computer required. Tablets and mobile devices are not suitable for this position.
* Ability to work scheduled shifts independently in a remote environment.

  

**LANGUAGE FLUENCY REQUIREMENTS**

* All applicants must be fluent in English.
* Some positions require fluency in one or more additional languages.
* Language fluency testing and writing assessments are required for all hourly positions.
* LiveWorld defines fluency as native or near-native proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking.
* Current recruiting languages: French, Italian and Japanese.

  

**JOB BENEFITS**

* Work from home
* Flexible scheduling
* Dynamic and collaborative remote work environment
* Opportunity to learn new skills and further develop existing expertise
* Opportunity to support leading healthcare and non-healthcare brands
* Exposure to regulated healthcare communications and digital engagement

  

**HOW TO APPLY****:**  
  
For U.S. Residents:  
http://liveworldweb.wpenginepowered.com/HR/US/  
For Non-U.S. Residents:  
http://liveworldweb.wpenginepowered.com/HR/NONUS/

**Mobile Security Supervisor**

**Wage**: $21.60/ hour

**Required Experience:**

* Driver's license required
* 1+ year of Supervisor Experience Required
* 1+ year of security experience required

**JOB SUMMARY:**

Provides field supervision of Securitas Mobile personnel in patrol, inspection, shared guarding and/or response operations; provides patrol and response service as needed.

Distinguishing Characteristics: Primary job function is supervision of guarding personnel in patrol/inspection operations.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* The functions listed describe the business purpose of this job. Specific duties or tasks may vary and be documented separately. The employee might not be required to perform all functions listed. Additional duties may be assigned, and functions may be modified, according to business necessity.
* All assigned duties or tasks are deemed to be part of the essential functions, unless such duties or tasks are unrelated to the functions listed, in which case they are deemed to be other (non-essential) functions.
* Employees are held accountable for successful job performance. Job performance standards may be documented separately, and may include functions, objectives, duties or tasks not specifically listed herein.
* In performing functions, duties or tasks, employees are required to know and follow safe work practices, and to be aware of company policies and procedures related to job safety, including safety rules and regulations. Employees are required to notify superiors upon becoming aware of unsafe working conditions.
* All functions, duties or tasks are to be carried out in an honest, ethical and professional manner, and to be performed in conformance with applicable company policies and procedures. In the event of uncertainty or lack of knowledge of company policies and procedures, employees are required to request clarification or explanations from superiors or authorized company representatives.

* Supervises guards and other personnel in patrol, inspection, shared guarding and/or response operations; ensures that personnel deliver high quality service; evaluates service quality and initiates any necessary corrective action in a timely manner.
* Meets with Branch management and/or client representatives for status updates and to address any actual or potential problems; provides support during client start-ups; provides input to security planning, assessments and surveys; reviews orders and communicates requirements and changes to affected personnel.
* Participates in and coordinates with Branch management regarding the orientation, training, development and retention of high caliber staff; ensures that each staff member is treated with dignity and respect.
* Assigns and directs work; coaches employees, and carries out disciplinary actions, as necessary; supports staff as appropriate in carrying out their respective responsibilities; refers problematic issues to Branch management.
* Maintains a positive, professional environment in full compliance with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures; acts to ensure that staff members understand and comply with applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures.
* Communicates and coordinates with Branch management regarding scheduling, staffing, equipment, record keeping, and related matters, to ensure smooth delivery of services; meets with Branch management and other supervisory personnel to discuss customer service, initiatives, personnel matters, and related issues.
* Inspects patrol routes and sites as assigned to ensure adequate coverage and compliance with orders, contracts and directives; visits client representatives to ensure that they remain satisfied with services provided; covers vacant routes or assignments as necessary.
* Reviews client and company required reports for accuracy and timeliness; assists in preparing and submitting payroll information.
* Performs tasks and duties of a similar nature and scope as required for assigned office.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AT ENTRY**

Additional qualifications may be specified and receive preference, depending upon the nature of the position.

**MINIMUM HIRING STANDARDS:**

* Must be at least 18 years of age.
* Must have a reliable means of communication (i.e., pager or phone).
* Must have a reliable means of transportation (public or private).
* Must have the legal right to work in the United States.
* Must have the ability to speak, read, and write English.
* Must have a High School Diploma or GED.
* Must be willing to participate in the Company’s pre-employment screening process, including drug screen and background investigation.

Education/Experience: High School Diploma or G.E.D. and 2 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job, as determined by the company.

Competencies (as demonstrated through experience, training, and/or testing):

* May be required to hold and continue to meet the requirements for any applicable state, county and municipal license for Security Officers.
* Knowledge of security operations with an emphasis on patrol, inspection and response services.
* Knowledge of supervisory practices and procedures.
* Ability to provide positive direction and motivate performance.
* Understanding of a variety of security and safety devices and controls.
* Ability to learn quickly and carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagrammatic form.
* Ability to track and maintain schedule assignments.
* Ability to be an effective team member.
* Ability to maintain professional composure when dealing with unusual circumstances.
* Courteous telephone manner.
* Ability to adapt to various sites and changes in post procedures.
* Ability to write routine correspondence, including logs and reports.
* Good organizational skills.
* Strong customer service and results orientation.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients, at various social levels and across diverse cultures.

**WORKING CONDITIONS** (Physical/Mental Demands):

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to perform effectively all essential functions. In addition to other demands, the demands of the job include:

* Maintaining composure in dealing with authorities, executives, clients, staff and the public, occasionally under conditions of urgency and in pressure situations.
* May be exposed to stressful situations, such as challenging individuals who are in or approaching an unauthorized area.
* Must undergo and meet company standards for background and reference checks, controlled substance testing, and behavioral selection survey, in addition to any mandatory licensing requirements.
* Directing and disciplining staff in a positive manner.
* May be required to work overtime without advance notice.
* Required ability to handle multiple tasks concurrently.
* Keyboarding, basic computer usage and operating controls.
* Seeing, hearing, speaking, and writing clearly in order to communicate with employees and clients, observe and report incidents, and direct others.
* Frequent sitting, standing and walking, which may be required for long periods of time, and may involve climbing stairs and walking up inclines and on uneven terrain.
* Occasional reaching with hands and arms, stooping, kneeling, crouching and crawling.
* Frequent lifting and/or moving up to 10 pounds and occasionally up to 25 pounds.
* Close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus.
* Regular use of vehicle for the performance of duties.
* On occasion may be required to perform stressful and physical activity.
* Depending upon assignment may be exposed to inclement weather or be required to work in environments or under conditions that require the use of protective gear and devices and/or awareness of personal safety and safety of others.
* May be exposed to or required to handle sensitive and confidential information.

**Make an Impact at Securitas USA**

Securitas USA employees come from all walks of life, bringing a variety of skills, experiences, and perspectives. United by a shared purpose, we help make the world a safer place. We provide security services to meet the unique needs of our clients to help safeguard their people and assets.

At Securitas USA, our core values are the foundation of everything we do. Represented by the three red dots in our logo, **Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness** guide how we serve our clients, support our colleagues, and engage with our communities.

**Integrity**  
We act with honesty, accountability, and professionalism in everything we do, and we foster a culture where transparency, respect, and ethical behavior are expected.

**Vigilance**  
We stay alert, aware, and attentive to our surroundings. Through observing and reporting, our employees help identify potential risks and respond to situations that may impact safety and security.

**Helpfulness**  
We are approachable and service-oriented, whether assisting a client, colleague, or member of the community.

Securitas USA is committed to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodation: Securitas USA is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Securitas USA will take steps to assure the people with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact PrivacyRequests@securitasinc.com.

**Join Our Team at MasterCorp, Inc.!**  
At MasterCorp, Inc., we provide exceptional service and innovative solutions in the hospitality industry. Our dynamic and inclusive workplace fosters growth, creativity, and the opportunity to make an impact. We are looking for passionate and driven individuals to join our team and help us continue to deliver outstanding results for our clients.

**Position is located in Williamsburg, VA - Relocation assistance provided.**

**Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.**

The Director of Housekeeping (DOH) will oversee MasterCorp site/sites of resort within assigned division. The DOH is responsible for providing leadership, motivation, accountability and development of MasterCorp Associates within the assigned site and ensuring the assigned site/sites is consistently meeting quality and timeliness standards along with budget objectives. In addition, they will develop and maintain a professional and effective relationship with resort management, vendors and service providers to MasterCorp and develop and maintain a high level of communication and spirit of partnership with site management team, regional and corporate personnel. * **Develops Talent** – Develops people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
* **Financial Acumen** – Interprets and applies understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.
* **Plans and Aligns** – Plans and prioritizes work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.
* **Organizational Savvy** – Maneuvers comfortably through complex policy, process, and people-related organization dynamics.
* **Customer Focus –** Builds strong customer relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions.
* **Drives Results –** Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances.

**Essential Functions:**

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

df1fdabef6f9cca4f289.title: Senior QA Engineer
df1fdabef6f9cca4f289.description:
Gryphon empowers marketing, customer service, and sales organizations to deliver meaningful revenue growth, an enhanced customer experience, and essential risk mitigation by seamlessly balancing regulatory compliance with business-specific objectives in every interaction.

Gryphon ONE is a comprehensive platform that empowers revenue organizations and customer teams with intelligent, fully compliant solutions that enable enterprises to increase revenue, mitigate risk, and provide personalized customer support. With robust communication compliance measures, Gryphon ONE ensures that every customer interaction adheres to industry regulations.

**General:**

As a QA Engineer reporting to our QA Lead, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products. Our engineering team practices AI-driven, spec-driven development, and our QA practice works the same way. LLMs like Claude are core working tools for us, not occasional helpers. We use them to analyze business rules, generate test cases and test data, build automated coverage, and find gaps in what we’ve tested. You’ll work alongside developers, product managers, and architects throughout the development cycle, not at the end of it. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of quality and brings strong testing judgment to AI-assisted work, treating AI output as a starting point to verify rather than a finished product.

**Responsibilities:**

Use LLMs (e.g., Claude) to analyze specifications, business rules, and regulatory requirements, and translate them into structured test plans and test cases.

* Generate manual and automated tests with AI assistance, then review, correct, and refine the output so it is accurate, meaningful, and maintainable.

* Use AI to generate realistic, rules-driven test data, including edge cases, boundary conditions, and compliance scenarios.

* Use AI to analyze test coverage against specs and business rules, to identify gaps, redundancies, and untested risk areas.

* Build and refine reusable prompts, workflows, and context (e.g., spec templates, rule summaries) that make AI-assisted testing repeatable across the team.

* Apply test design techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, and black-box/white-box testing, both directly and to evaluate the quality of AI-generated tests.

* Maintain automated test suites for frontend (e.g., Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) and backend/API testing (e.g., Postman, REST Assured) and keep them running reliably in CI/CD pipelines.

* Test complex business and regulatory rule logic, working with the QA Lead, developers, and architects on test harnesses and on making components more testable (“glass box”).

* Develop and maintain “last mile” smoke tests and end-to-end validations that reflect real customer workflows and expectations.

* Perform database validation using SQL and support performance testing as needed.

* Participate in Root Cause Analysis and document and track defects clearly.

* Engage early in the development cycle by validating and challenging requirements and deliverables rather than rubber-stamping them and raise gaps and risks before code is written.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* 2–4 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing.

* Demonstrated hands-on use of LLMs in testing workflows beyond Q&A, such as generating test cases, test data, or automated tests from specs, or analyzing test coverage. Be prepared to walk us through real examples.

* Strong judgment in evaluating AI-generated output, including spotting incorrect assertions, missing scenarios, invented logic, and tests that pass without proving anything.

* Working knowledge of test design techniques and testing strategies.

* Experience with both manual and automated testing.

* Proficiency in at least one programming language (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#) with the ability to read, review, debug, and modify automated test code.

* Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, X-ray).

* Experience with Git and SQL.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience building prompt libraries, AI-assisted test workflows, or agentic tools (e.g., Claude Code) for QA.

* Experience with spec-driven development or testing rules engines and decisioning systems in regulated domains.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and testing in cloud-native environments.

* Strong exploratory testing skills and a passion for uncovering edge cases.

* Familiarity with test automation design patterns (e.g., Page Object Model).

* Proactive in identifying quality risks and suggesting process improvements.

* A strong sense of curiosity and a mindset geared toward engaging with complex challenges and continuous learning.

**Compensation:**

The target compensation range for this role is $110-125k, along with a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and other employee programs.

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without the attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.*

2b9c883d915f308c5c93.title: QA/QC Project Manager
2b9c883d915f308c5c93.description:
Position Summary

The OSP Project Manager directs and supervises all work required on long-haul fiber network projects. This position executes the technical direction provided by management and implements changes when needed regarding route engineering, permitting, right-of-way, construction, and splicing/testing scope, deliverables, schedule, and budget for the project. The OSP Project Manager is responsible for nurturing a positive client interface and providing all project details to the client in a timely manner. This will include managing both internal staff as well as external Vendors and coordinating through project phases (engineering, permitting, construction, and as-built delivery) to ensure the long-haul fiber route is delivered on schedule and to specification. We are looking for a self-motivated and detail-orientated individual with a strong work ethic who balances technical knowledge with rigorous organizational oversight and effective communication to ensure a successful project delivery to our clients. We are offering an opportunity for a driven OSP Project Manager to join us progress their professional career along with our organization to help position Network Connex as the “go to” vendor within the Telecom / Outside-Plant (OSP) Industry.

Key Responsibilities

OSP Engineering Oversight / Quality Framework Development  

* Responsible for accuracy and content of the OSP engineering drawings created (including for permit, for construction and as-builts).
* Understanding of outside plant (OSP) construction activities, including aerial and underground placement, directional boring, splicing, and testing, across multi-state route segments.
* Identify and manage long-haul-specific project risks, including weather delays, land access disputes, and environmental or cultural resource clearances.
* Foster the use of new/innovative concepts in the development of project designs and proposals, while assisting in staff training to learn/teach best technical practices
* Collaborate with team to build upon Internal Standards to ensure all Engineering Deliverables meet these internal requirements and the needs of our Customers.
* Ensure use of internal QA/QC manuals and inspection checklists for OSP design (FTTH, Long Haul, etc.) and construction.
* Perform regular Engineering Audits to ensure all our OSP engineering drawings adhere to telecom/utility standards (e.g., NESC, FOA) as well Permitting/Regulatory correspondence (DOT/County/City/RUS).
* Support all Redline Revisions with specific reasoning based on client requirements, agency regulations, or field/construction feedback. Document reoccurring issues to ensure these are addressed within Internal Standard Documentation.

Project Management / Vendor & Client Management  

* Serve as the client primary Point of Contact (POC) on assigned projects, attend all necessary meetings to keep them informed, communicate issues/scope questions needing client feedback, and respond to their overall needs.
* Responsible for scheduling, forecasting, and tracking the project deliverables. Accountable to deliver on the deployment of workflow scheduling, project execution, delivery within budget, and quality of all project elements.
* Effectively be able to create OSP Engineering Drawings, manage resource planning, set & track goals, implement process improvement, and submit timely project reporting.
* Prepare/Authorize/Endorse project related contracts, proposals, documents etc.
* Manage route engineering, permitting, and right-of-way/easement acquisition for long-haul fiber segments, including coordination with state DOTs, railroads, and utility companies for crossing and joint-use agreements.
* Track and manage make-ready engineering and pole attachment processes in coordination with utility and joint-use partners.
* Maintain accurate as-built documentation, GIS mapping, and fiber route records to ensure data integrity across the project lifecycle.
* Review and Approve all project schedules, budgets, work plans, invoices, and QC/QA documentation
* Build and expand relationships with key clients within the market by listening/understanding their needs and implementing process/schedule changes accordingly.
* Maintain open and positive working relationships and enhance the image of the company for the development of additional business opportunities.
* Manage project workloads with strategic use of our Engineering Vendor(s) to assist with internal staffing resources.
* Manage Vendor(s) to assure that that they are consistently completing work within the specific time periods requested while ensuring accuracy, completeness, quality, and thoroughness,
* Provide necessary Quality Framework and Feedback to our Vendor(s) via a comprehensive Review Process doctored selectively to customer specifications and internal requirements.
* Ensure Vendor(s) that that they are updating Project Management Tools on a daily basis to reflect precise statuses and revised forecasting.
* Submit Purchase Order (PO} requests to clients, work with clients to obtain PO, track work completed to invoice against PO, and regularly report to management.
* Be in constant communication with Leadership with reporting progress of Vendor contracted work/projects.

Technical Design/Engineering Support

* Apply previous OSP Engineering experience, Internal Quality Standards, and telecom/utility regulations to provide insight on design questions: best build environment, handhole/manhole placements, conduit routing, etc.
* Identify design conflicts and resolve proactively with expedited design-related decisions based on changing field conditions, customer needs, or financial constraints.
* Provide technical assistance with Permitting/Regulatory correspondence (DOT/County/City/RR)
* Know when to seek assistance or escalate unresolved questions to Engineering leadership to collaborate together on a resolution.

Required Qualifications

* 3+ years’ experience within the Telecommunications Industry (Long-Haul Fiber/OSP Engineering and Construction) or working in similar capacity is required.
* In-depth knowledge of OSP fiber design, construction, permitting, and fiber standards.
* Familiarity with typical CAD standards within the civil engineering industry.
* Prior Project Managing Experience including Customer/Client interfacing.
* Strong attention to detail, works with precision/efficiency, and shows a commitment to quality.
* Proven ability to analyze financial reports and budgets to plan the course of the work effectively.
* Possesses understanding of telecom and utility standards (NESC, RUS, DOT, municipal standards).
* Ability to read and interpret engineering plans, profiles, and utility records.
* Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite Software Programs.
* Proven experience leading, motivating, and communicating consistently with employees and clients.
* Maintains high-level time management and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil/Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Business Administration/Management, Construction Management, or equivalent field experience
* 5+ years’ experience within the Telecommunications Industry (OSP Background Preferred) or 10+ years’ experience with Project Management Role.
* Engineer-In-Training or Professional Engineer desired
* Previous AutoCAD Experience to prepare drawings: Preferably using \*\*Autodesk Civil 3D\*\*
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a plus
* Knowledge of MOT/TCP requirements and right-of-way permitting.
* Prior involvement with OSP Construction, Installation, Maintenance, Break-Fix, etc.
* Experience working in multi-jurisdictional state environments.
* Basic understanding or experience with using GIS-Data or Esri based Platforms
* Possesses extensive knowledge of the network infrastructure specific to FTTH projects

Physical Requirements:

* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Located or willing to locate to the Texas Mega Region Vicinity (DAL-SAN-HOU Triangle)
